A related question may be: What about a reductive physicalist physicist who wants to explain the physical by reference to infinite regress or things with zero structure? Obviously for such situations there is the distinction of reductive physicalist and non-reductive physicalist. So, the reductive physicalist who rejects the reality and effectiveness of what he studies behaves in parallel with the physicalist evolutionist. For the arguments against reductive physicalism are see part 1.1.2.2.1. 
Question 64. 
Is the distinction between physicalist and God-fashioned evolution an epistemological consideration? 
Answer 64. 
No. Because we talk about real and distinct effects of life forms. So physicalist evolution commits errors related to the ontology of life forms, their rise, and their nature.
Question 65. 
Is not evolution necessarily reductive since it explains life in terms of mutations and natural selection?
Answer 65. 
As we will see in the following, reduction does not work regarding evolution and biology. Also, as explained in part 1.1.2.2.1, it does not work even for physics.
When evolution talks about mutations, it talks about distinct wholes in the realm of molecules and atoms. When it talks about natural selection and survival, it cannot take these as isolated from consciousness, qualia, free will power, reasoning power which are intrinsic to life.
We will see further details which show that the reduction which is considered by some as a fundamental aspect of evolution, is lethal to evolution. If evolution is true, the only internally consistent form of evolution may be a holistic one which recognizes the wholes and holistic properties at all layers under the control and guidance of the Fashioner.
1.4.2.2.8.4.3 The Difference Between Physicalist Evolution and God-Fashioned Evolution
To understand this distinction let us see an example:
Let us suppose that: 
- The first state S1 at the physical layer PL (S1@PL) causes the second state S2 at the physical layer (S2@PL), 
- The first state at the biological layer BL (S1@BL) which supervenes on S1@PL causes second state S2 at the biological layer BL (S2@BL) which supervenes on S2@PL; 
- All states at any layer represent a structure observed by the observer of the respective layer. If for example substances, properties and state of atoms at S1@PL are �sufficient� to explain why we have S2@BL, then there is no effect of the layer of organs, purposes, struggles, survival, selection of living things at state 1 (S1@BL) on S2@BL. 
If S1@PL is not sufficient to explain S2@BL, then according to physicalism what is the additional thing that causes S2@BL? 
Under physicalist evolution, all spatial connections of organs are instantiated in atoms. If there is an effect of S1@BL distinct from and on top of S1@PL, then do the atoms at the physical layer swerve from their courses, from what the laws of physics entail? Does for example free will power make them swerve? Does this power arise outside of physical laws? Or was it always present in the atoms, but then when a life formed it got into action? Is there a distinction between life and non-life? If not, does physicalist evolution explain the physics just as an approximation at a different layer? The example of free will power may be extended to other irreducible properties such as logical conclusions, consciousness, morals.
According to the above analysis, we can have three alternative frameworks related to the holistic and physicalist evolution: 
(1) Either upper layers originate partial or whole effectiveness and are coeffective with the lower layer, while things at the different layers may have their properties and effects, 
(2) Or the lower layer acts both for itself and on behalf of and being aware of the upper layer and having purposes that can be defined in terms of upper layers, or 
(3) Things at PL behave on their own and coincidentally, and when they are looked at from BL they look as if there are beings at BL. 
(2) and (3) are scenarios of physicalist evolution. Neither (2) nor (3) is plausible: (2) requires infinite number of transcendent and ambiguous parts of the limited universe which would not only cooperate with other parts, but also, be aware of things at higher layers and behave simultaneously to sustain and operate in a synchronized way many overlapping things at many layers. (3) is mathematically impossible since if it was true, and even if we coincidentally survive we would have seen at least numerous instances in our layer where things would not keep their unities and consistencies; also, if it was true, then we would admit that our science is reliable just by chance, hence that it is not reliable and not a true science; plus, if (3) was true, then the relata and relations used to explain life forms would just coincidentally have explanatory power which would not be a true explanatory power. Both (2) and (3) suffer from problems related to ASBEs explained in part 1.1.2.2.6, problems related to reductive physicalism explained in part 1.1.2.2.1, and other problems related to the properties of Allah. Hence, only (1) is possible.
Note that the above is a limited analysis. We have taken the physical layer as one layer. However, obviously it has many layers, such as molecules, atoms, sub-atomic particles� Furthermore, as explained in part 1.1.2.2.1, according to reductive physicalism, they should go until an ambiguous layer of ASBEs. Hence, in any case, PL can be effective only if it is ascribed a holistic transcendence, since any thing at any layer will necessarily consist of parts, because it cannot have zero extension and in any case it is part of a whole.
So, even if for a moment we accept that the physicalist evolution is true, and the physical is at its bottom, we will see again that it indispensably has a holistic aspect.
In God-fashioned evolution the distinctly effective life form for example using his free will tries to survive and survives. In the holistic case the evolutionary mechanisms may be distinctly effective hence we can say that there is God-fashioned evolution. Since in God-fashioned evolution there may be distinct effectiveness at many layers then we can recognize the ontological and epistemological reality of for example mutations. In physicalist evolution, we can recognize neither ontological nor epistemological reality of entities, beings and processes like free will power, consciousness, knowledge, morals, purpose reasoning that are some of the irreducible distinctly effective properties at the level of human beings. Animals also have at least some of these properties. These properties are not reducible to the spatiotemporal movements and other behaviors. 
Within God-fashioned evolution, there may be sovereign wholes at many layers. These wholes may have some autonomy and distinct effectiveness. However, it does not claim that all sovereign wholes or life forms are necessarily the result of God-fashioned evolution. Things at different layers may affect or influence the distinct effectiveness of other wholes at different layers.
A key difference of God-fashioned evolution from physicalist evolution is the presence of purposeless random mutations within physicalist evolution. In God-fashioned evolution the mutations are under Allah's control; they happen either in accordance with His will, design, plan, or under His permission. Reduction basis may also theoretically be purposeful under God-fashioned evolution. 
Question 66. 
What about an emergentist type of evolution? An evolution in parallel with non-reductive physicalism would recognize the allegedly emergent properties as consciousness and would also be compatible with physicalism.
Answer 66. 
The non-reductive physicalism is examined in part 1.1.2.2.10 which explains why it is incoherent and false. On the other hand, non-reductive version of physicalism is too weak to support evolution. Emergent properties in non-reductive physicalism are essentially ineffective and epiphenomenal. For example, some emergentist physicalists say that the consciousness is an emergent property; yet they do not believe that it has any distinct effect. If it had an effect which is not reducible to the spatiotemporal, then they would need to explain the distinct source of that effect. Yet, for them the universe has a causal closure, in other words, what is in it is spatiotemporally sufficient to explain whatever happens and exists in it. Hence, an emergentist interpretation of evolution would not be essentially different than reductionist physicalist evolution.
Question 67. 
What is the difference between creationism and God-fashioned evolution?
Answer 67. 
The word �creationist� as used in this book covers also those who believe that God creates or may create through God-fashioned evolution while He can also create through other methods. Some use that word for those who believe that God does not create through evolution. But there is no reason for this use, since there is no reason that prevents God from creating through God-fashioned evolution. However, some groups like �young earth creationists� may reject partially or fully that God may create any traits through evolutionary processes.
Question 68. 
Cannot God create through physicalist evolution?
Answer 68. 
Physicalist evolution as explained in this book means the rise of species through purposeless or random mutations and other random events that allegedly happen at a reduction basis where purpose is absent. Hence, God�s creating through physicalist evolution would be contradictory.
1.4.2.2.8.5 Assessment on the Physicalist and God-Fashioned Evolution
If evolution is used in the context of God, it enters into the scope of religion. In this situation, the definition of evolution may be constructed such that either (1) it rules out God as its cause or sustainer, or (2) it requires God, or (3) it is possible that it happens with God or without God. In all three cases, evolution will be defined as a fully or partially religious term. If (1) is true, then it is a religious statement since it claims the non-involvement of God in evolution. (2) claims that it is no substitute instead of God. (3) makes a positive claim that the life forms are no evidence for God because of the positive claim that the evolution may allegedly be happening without God.
Some evolutionists may argue that (1) and (3) are no religious claims since they simply state that the matter is sufficient for life. However, if it is so, then we can create a simulated world -which would be possible if everything consists of matter- wherein some simulated beings who evolved exactly as in our universe will be thinking like these evolutionists. Because since the matter and its spatiotemporal relations are sufficient to make us reach that conclusion, then we have all that is necessary to create an exact simulation wherein beings may reason exactly as we do. If this is true, then the beings in the simulation who conclude that there is no need or evidence for purposeful higher beings for their being are wrong unless we reject the concept of �purpose� entirely. So, to claim (1) or (3) requires some philosophical, religious and other reasons related to God and His existence or non-existence, and just recognizing what we see as self-sufficient brute facts is not sufficient. Therefore, (1) and (3) are religious in nature.
Consequently, whenever evolution is used for or against God, it necessarily has religious components.
In Christianity and Judaism, where things can go on while God takes rest, the only argument for God with respect to life can be the very small likelihood of evolution as a cause of the species we observe. Because the background of probability does not need God in order to keep its existence, since a quasi-deistic god concept is adopted; the apologetics of those religions try to show why the background needs God by using separate arguments. But they may be saying (i) �that the background is not possible to exist without God creating and sustaining it, but even if for the sake of the argument we suppose that the background happens without God, then it is very improbable that the complexity of life arises without a Creator�. However, if (ii) �things can go on happening while God does not sustain them�, then (i) and (ii) will be contradicting each other, and the argument becomes one that is based on low probabilities.
So, let us see the broader implications of physicalist evolution and the reasons for its falsity.
1.4.2.2.8.5.1 Physicalist Evolution is False
When someone uses evolution as an argument against Allah, he uses implicitly or explicitly the physicalist evolution. 
If evolution is true as a God-fashioned evolution, then its evidences are important elements of the proof of Allah. Someone who truly recognizes the irreducible elements of God-fashioned evolution as defined in this book and who is rational and consistent, would necessarily believe in God. Because if units of life are not reducible to the spatiotemporal, then there would be a need for a sustainer beyond the spatiotemporal.
So, in the context of this book, it is indispensable to have a good understanding of why physicalist evolution is false. Its falsity is due to many bad formulations, inconsistencies, contradictions, ambiguities, gaps, circularities, and fallacies. 
Since these are very extensive, this study will attempt only to give the key issues. Note that this study will focus on the conclusive logical and empirical aspects of physicalist evolution and not focus on the issues like missing links between the species. 
There are many arguments against physicalist evolution like missing links, improbability of the complex structures of life, Cambrian explosion. These are convincing counter arguments against physicalist evolution for many. However, although these issues are also important, they may be insufficiently conclusive against the ambiguous and arbitrary theory of physicalist evolution which makes claims about millions of years ago based on randomness which is assisted by another ambiguous theory of multiverse. Therefore, here this part will show clear contradictions and shortcomings of physicalist evolution, and refute the alleged evidences for it as the fossil record, retroviral sequences, DNA allignment � showing  their irrelevance, hence, it will show conclusively that physicalist evolution is false.
1.4.2.2.8.5.1.1 The Physicalist Reduction Basis Layer is Contradictory
When we look at the universe, we see that certain things can be explained by other things: for example, a goat walking toward the grass sees the grass because it has eyes that receives the light waves/ photons; and it has a brain that processes the related signals. Its eyes has lenses that adjust the light waves/ photons toward the light sensitive cells. We can continue the explanation by adding into it the components of cells, its macromolecules, the atoms within the molecules and so on. Theoretically, firstly, maybe we can go like this infinitely as long as we learn more and more details about what we discover in which case there is no true basis for reduction. Or secondly, we may stop at a certain layer below which there is no further layer upon which the higher layers are built. A reductive approach will give us these two main alternatives. The first alternative is not feasible in a physicalist understanding since it leads to infinite regress where there is no layer that has any ontological distinctly effective reality upon which other layers are built.
So, let us make our list of reductive scenarios in accordance with the second alternative above. However, note that we will revisit the infinite regress-related alternative whenever relevant.
Let us imagine a very large space and upon it numerous billiard balls in different colors. Let us suppose that they constitute a reduction basis layer more fundamental than atoms and anything we know. The balls move in accordance with equations such as � the equations are just to concretize the point, hence knowing them in detail is not necessary �:
Momentum: p = m � v 
Conservation of momentum: m1v1i + m2v2i = m1v1f + m2v2f
Conservation of kinetic energy: (1/2)m1v1i^2 + (1/2)m2v2i^2 = (1/2)m1v1f^2 + (1/2)m2v2f^2
Where p, m, v, i, f mean respectively �momentum�, �mass�, �velocity�, �initial�, and �final�.
Let us also imagine that we look at the balls from a certain point of view and we see that at certain regions they look like living beings that eat, move, reproduce, and die. For example, a goat moves toward a certain plant and eats it.
Let us work on this example to analyze in a simplified way the life layer and the physics layer in our real world:
If the movement of the goat toward the plant overlaps with the behavior of the balls that constitute it, then we can explain this through certain scenarios: (1) the balls behave according to much more complex equations in and of themselves, hence, though they are not aware of the goat, they mechanistically cause the movement of the goat, its organs, and other components, (2) simple billiard balls behave according to the simple equations above without targetting the goat�s behavior overlapping with their behaviors, but by coincidence there is overlapping between the behaviors of the balls� and the behaviors of the goat, its organs, and other components, (3) the balls cause this perfect overlapping by targeting this overlapping and causing the behavior of goat and its components, (4) the goat controls and makes the lower level things overlap with its goals where the layers are reduced to the upper layer, (5) there is a common cause which makes them overlap, (6) there are different situations with different combinations where sometimes some of them control the others.
The balls above, correspond to the fundamental things at the reduction basis level � from now on, the term allegedly self-sufficient spatiotemporal bottom elements (ASBEs) will be used instead of or interchangeably with �things at the reduction basis level� �.
So, let us now examine briefly the above exhaustive list of theoretical scenarios in accordance with the above example. In the later parts we will see many related further points.
1. Scenario (1): Things at the Reduction Basis Level are Necessarily Complex Enough to Form Aggregates Mechanistically at Many Upper Layers, Including the Life Layer.
In this reductive scenario, we have an aggregate like a goat that has parts and sub-parts. For example, we detect that it is seeing thanks to its eyes, and its eyes make it see thanks to their lenses, light sensitive cells, and other components� Those components consist of macromolecules, micromolecules, atoms, protons, neutrons, quarks, and so on that we can detect or not detect. But as the goat ultimately consists of atoms, its eyes consist of atoms, and its light sensitive cells consist of atoms, whatever is the consituent of the bottom level, everything at the upper levels consist of those constituents. The behaviors of those constituents cause the epiphenomenal behaviors of the things at the upper levels, and the behaviors of those constituents also overlap with the behaviors of the things at the upper levels. However, although those constituents are distributed all around the universe, they do not come together in all regions of the universe in the same way. But whenever they come together in specific ways they can constitute specific things at the upper layers like the atoms of hydrogen and oxygen form a water molecule coming together under certain circumstances. However, as the formation of the water molecule by the hydrogen and oxygen atoms is possible only by each atom having certain structures and properties, likewise, the things at the reduction basis level must also have certain structures and properties. It is obvious that if the hydrogen and oxygen atoms were as simple as billiard balls, they could not form a water molecule, and hence if the things at the reduction basis were as simple as the billiard balls, they could not form water molecules and other aggregates.
In scenario (1), we detect the behaviors and properties of the components and we allegedly can relate consistently the aggregates down to their components, and if we had the means to measure and observe, we can trace them down to the things at the reduction basis level. These relations are presupposed to be stable and true as an axiom.
     i. Flaw 1: If Things at the Reduction Basis are Complex, Then They do not Belong to the Reduction Basis Layer.
At first sight, scenario (1) seems to be the scenario which explains the reductive aspect of the real life physicalist evolution theory in a consistent, monistic, and complete manner. However, it embodies big contradictions and limitations: As briefly indicated above in the example of the components of the water molecule, the things at the reduction basis level must have a complex structure. But if it has a complex structure, this will be a demonstration that that thing is epiphenomenal and not a distinctly effective thing at the reduction basis level. If a component of that thing has a structure, then that component cannot be the thing at the reduction basis level either. Furthermore, if there are different kinds of distinctly effective things at the reduction basis level, then the differentiations between them will entail that they are epiphenomenal and that there must be fundamental and distinctly effective things at a more fundamental level. Hence, this will either lead us to infinite regress, or we will have to recognize that a structureless thing at the reduction basis level is distinctly effective. Therefore, this contradiction invalidates the enterprise of the physicalist evolution to explain the complex by the simple. 
Moreover, this is not the only contradiction that invalidates it; there are many other defects that further invalidate it. The other flaws related to this point will be given under relevant parts.
     ii. Flaw 2: ASBEs Cannot Have Structure Except Coincidentally.
Why would ASBEs have �any� structure at all? 
Scenario 1 seems as if it explains the life forms based on a mechanistic and precise manner. However, the distinctly effective things that both ontologically and epistemologically underlie the physicalist evolution are the ASBEs. And to justify the mechanistic explanation of the physicalist evolution, the ASBEs must have a structure. 
To have a structure, there must be some kind of transcendence that makes the components of the structure relatable to the other components and to the space, time, other dimensions. The coincidental rise of such ASBEs invalidates any endeavor to explain mechanistically and scientifically multiple layers and the relationships between them. A structure requires a transcendence, but transcendence invalidates the reductive aspect of a reductive mechanistic explanation.
A reductive physicalist approach is incompatible with the transcendence that is necessary for the existence of any structure. For further details, see or revisit part 1.2.
We should also take into account that even if we assume the possibility of obtaining "any" structure of ASBEs through an extremely fortunate coincidence, as mentioned in the title, this coincidence still requires fundamental relationships in order for us to begin discussing any sort of coincidental order.
Question 69. 
Are the quarks the ASBEs? 
Answer 69. 
There are many types of quarks with different masses. So, we cannot say that they are the ASBEs. Plus the quarks are considered as excitations in specific fields, hence, those fields may be more fundamental than the quarks.
     iii. Flaw 3: ASBEs Cannot Have a Specific Structure Except Coincidentally.
To underlie the mechanistic and allegedly scientific explanations of physicalist evolution, ASBEs must not only have a structure, but they also must have a specific structure. Because any structure cannot underlie the life layer as a reduction basis.
But why do the ASBEs have the specific structure that they have? If the structures they have is not connected to the aggregates and systems at the upper layers, then those structures are happening just randomly. It is necessary that the structures of the ASBEs are strictly compliant with many upper layers that relate to life. When we reject any purpose and transcendence, then the components of the ASBEs are relatively positioned just randomly. If this randomness is true, then any explanation at any layer also happens randomly; because any relationship within an upper layer, and in between upper layers are all necessarily supervenient upon and/or reducible to the layer of ASBEs. 
This undermines also the claim of physicalist evolution of being scientific, in other words, it undermines any repeatability, measurability, testability, predictibility related to physicalist evolution. Because if the ASBEs are structured randomly, then there is no other layer which can serve as a necessity or as an alternative to chance.
     iv. Flaw 4: ASBEs Cannot be Initially Distributed as They Were Distributed Except Coincidentally.
Why would they be initially distributed as they were distributed? Note that if an �initial� distribution is rejected, then we have the alternatives of either infinite regress, or a distribution through spacetime; in the latter situation, the same problem will be just aggravated so as to include the spacetime, and it will bring in further problems related to determinism and indeterminism addressed in the relevant parts of this book. 
To underlie the mechanistic and allegedly scientific explanations of the physicalist evolution, the ASBEs not only must have specific internal structure, but also they need each to be positioned in a way that will result in the formation of life forms. There may be infinitely many distributions of ASBEs that will not result in the formation of living beings, compared to the set of the distributions of ASBEs that will not result in the rise of living beings.
     v. Flaw 5: ASBEs Need to be Structured all in the Same Way, but They Cannot be Structured all in the Same way Except Coincidentally.
Why would each ASBE be structured in the same way?
If the ASBEs have each a different structure, then this will mean that they are not ASBEs. Because, this would mean that they have more basic components which make each ASBE different than another ASBE. In this case, there will be a primary contradiction. 
Moreover, even if we suppose that somehow ASBEs have the same structure each, then this will have happened by coincidence, since even though the opposite creates the above contradiction, such a contradiction cannot explain the �rise� of the �same� structure of the ASBEs. 
So, if transcendence regarding the similarity is discarded, then the only alternative left is a very coincidence though this coincidence needs in any case a transcendence so that we may even talk about any calculation of a related probability.
If all these are answered by randomness, then the mechanistic explanation of the life forms based on reduction is invalidated. Because then all the connections at the upper layers happen by coincidence, not by structurally or sequentially causal relations. Because all the connections at the upper layers are just views of the distributions, trajectories, and behaviors of the ASBEs.
Note that these are not related to a probability. Because the difference of having a structure or not is not like the distribution of an existent in one way or another or another, it is like existing with structure or not existing with structure it is something that may exist only with a contingent structure.
     vi. Other Flaws
Protons, electrons, neutrons, atoms� move, bind, detach� according to laws of physics and at our layer we see that aggregates of those entities which got together in a more favorable way keep lasting. So, if the particles bind like a cell, a tooth, a leg, a stomach� then that aggregate of goat will last more. Obviously, if we have the balls that can do all those kinds of behaviors then we can get any kind of aggregate which can perform any behavior. But can those particles behave that way without any feedback or feedforward from the layer of the goat? Can an ASBE behave in such complex ways? Even behaving as in the simple equations related to billiard balls above necessitate some kind of transcendence. And can we conceive that the behaviors of the billiard balls cause the behavior of the goat? In part 1.4.2.2.8.5.1.2.1 an example about the nucleotide�s relationship to transcendence is given. The specifically related parts, examine this point further; however, let us just note here that ASBEs as simple as billiard balls will not allow us have complex bonds and structures like those we get thanks to the carbon atoms.  
So, if the reductive aspect of the physicalist evolution is true, (1) what kind of complexity and transcendence �can� we have at the layer of the reduction basis? (2) And what degree of transcendence do we �need� there in order to have the actual complex systems at the life layer?
The first question has been answered in part 1.1.2.2.6. That part explained in detail that ASBEs cannot exist. But let us suppose that they can exist. Could they behave other than following certain trajectories that are entailed by the past influences and the geometry of spacetime as we see in the basic laws of physics which look like the formulations of classical or quantum physics? There is a limitation to that complexity, and if there is a complexity beyond a certain level, then we will need to find out lower level components of the ASBEs since a higher level complexity at the level of ASBEs is unacceptable because this will necessitate logically and empirically breaking down the ASBE into its components. Therefore, ASBE must be even simpler than the billiard balls. 
On the other hand, even if we suppose that the ASBEs are complex, what are the implications in terms of physicalist evolution if we suppose that their complex spatiotemporal properties are true and actual? Even if the ASBEs are so complex as to be fully equal to the physical movements of the life forms that they constitute, if a complete knowledge about the ASBEs is not sufficient to predict the unitary properties of life forms, like consciousness, knowledge, free will power, identity, economics, politics� we will not be able to use scenario (6) as a possible scenario. For example, if there is no transcendence at the foundational ASBEs, then we cannot have a real perception of a perfect circle. As another example, the idea wherein I transcend the future like �if I get caught by the lion I will get killed or injured and my kids will become orphans� is not possible if my entire existence that consists of ASBEs is no more than masses moving according to the trajectories entailed by the laws of physics. In such a case I will not be more than an approximation and an explanation about me based on a reductive explanation that uses the ASBEs will not be a good explanation. This explanation will be like an explanation that will be explained below where a horse in the clouds is explained by the molecules of the cloud: That horse is not a horse even if the atoms of the cloud move such that the horse looks like running, eating, reproducing. The things at the reduction basis layer would move the same way no matter whether it constitutes a horse or not.
The flaws related to irreducible properties of living beings will be examined in detail in the specific later parts.
2. Scenario (2): Simple Billiard Ball-Like Things at The Reduction Basis Level Cause the Aggregates at the Upper Levels Coincidentally � but These Things Cannot be Simple Based on Empirical Observations �. 
The previous part examined the scenario where the ASBEs are complex and the key flaws related to their complexity. We saw that the complexity of ASBEs would contradict their ASBEness. Hence, due to the necessary simplicity of ASBEs, we could not accept the scenario 1. If a complex structure of the ASBE is not compatible with the ASBE�s being with its being undifferentiated ultimate reduction basis, then is it possible that the ASBEs as simple as billiard balls or simpler serve as the reduction basis of complex aggregates at the upper layers, including the life layer? Do the balls behave without targetting the overlapping of goat�s behavior with their behaviors, but is there by coincidence an overlapping between the balls� and goat�s behaviors?  
The simplicity of ASBEs would create a gap such that we cannot get the complexity of the life layer, since based simply on the behavior of the billiard balls we cannot get the metabolism, reproduction and so on necessary for the life layer. Moreover, even if we grant that the ASBEs be complex as a brute fact, for reasons such as irreducible properties like consciousness, we cannot accept that the substance and behaviors of ASBEs be equal to the substance and behaviors at the life layer; this same problem also applies to the simple billiard ball-like ASBEs scenario.
If the ASBEs are simple like billiard balls, then can we have the complex structures in the life forms? Or if the ASBEs are like chairs, or pens, can we have the complex structures of the life forms and their systems? We cannot. If we cannot, and if we observe that there are these complex structures and systems, then according to this scenario 2, we observe that there are such systems, but in fact what we observe must be like the shape of a running horse in the clouds. What we observe as a running horse (in the clouds) is in fact an illusion and the cause of the illusion is the coincidental specific distribution of the particles of the cloud. What we observe is then not related to the mechanisms of the ASBEs, but to just a coincidental running horse-like distribution of the particles of the clouds.  
If the ASBEs were like simple billiard balls, they could not cause the life that we observe. For example, they cannot cause the covalent and non-covalent bonds, and many different kinds of chemical reactions... The bonds between the ASBEs must be sustainable for a considerable amount of time, but the elastic collisions of very simple billiard balls would not correspond to the chemical bonds and would not cause the sustainable structures and sub-structures necessary for life. Also, if the ultimate bottom is like billiard balls then the occasional shapes would be just coincidental. Additionally, the repeated events of life forms like replications would not happen or would have infinitesimally small probability if the ASBEs were like simple billiard balls. 
So, it is not possible to conceive of any kind of billiard ball-like simple ASBE that would allow the rise of the layers of the universe that we observe. But to analyze further the implications of such ASBEs let us suppose that it is possible.
Even if the ASBEs had the complex structures, they would need to be positioned in special positions in order to be able to produce the complex life forms. For example, if ASBEs were positioned very distantly one from another, they would not be able to produce the complex life forms. Moreover, there is no necessity for the structure of the ASBEs to be the way they are under scenario 1. 
In scenario 1 there are just the complex movements of the ASBEs. And there is no two distinctly effective layers which may diverge, there is just one layer. Because the behaviors of ASBEs are so complex and convenient that they fully explain the behaviors and all other things of the life forms. So, the goat in the above example is no more than the complex movements of the ASBEs, hence there is not even the problem of approximateness of life forms, since even if some ASBEs diverged from the goat, then the goat would allegedly equal all ASBEs that constitute the goat plus the diverging ASBE. 
Also, when we say that the species of goat evolved, then we would mean that something that �we� perceived changed, although our perception is no more than the movements of molecules. However, in fact a true goat has its distinct identity and consciousness, and even if we perceived it or not it would be true, and our perception is just a trivial perception, only useful regarding our predictions which may be useful to the aggregate of �human beings�. Is a real goat reducible to the particles? If it is not, then the above construct of the physicalist evolution collapses, in other words, scenario 1 does not work and we come to the scenario 2 that is fully based on coincidence to see whether it saves physicalist evolution. In scenario 2 there is no goat-specific connections that can be used as explanation for goat-related connections; however, those connections are only related to its superficial shape. If the goat is not recognized as fully equal to the molecules, then the questions �why does the behavior of the goat overlap with that of molecules, why do not they diverge� need to be answered. And according to physicalist evolution, the answer seems to be coincidence under scenario 2.
The use of the �divergence� between the lower layer and the higher layer, supposes that the two layers are real. But for physicalist evolution that essentially looks like eliminative evolution, there are not two layers. So, we can even say that the physicalist evolution just studies the lower layers that are within the regions of life; however, since it claims to explain the higher layer of life, it cannot consistently claim to be eliminative. If it is eliminative, then for example, life, death would not be some events at the life layer but names of events at the molecular or atomic layers seen from an arbitrary perspective. Consequently, when physicalist evolution says that a new species arose, this would be just a wording to represent the new structure of the molecules at the molecular layer and lower layers. In this situation, the discussion about the divergence between the life layer and the atomic layer becomes useless. The human beings and the other life forms become just names given to certain aggregates of atoms and other particles. So, survival would be just the continuation of a certain aggregate. Evolution would be just a change in certain aggregates. There would not be even an approximation of a human being or of any other life form. But in reality, there is the goat as a distinct being that has its feelings, properties, and identity distinct from the layer of the molecules.
In scenario 1, we supposed that the ASBEs are complex, and briefly saw the implications of complex ASBEs where the complex spatiotemporal behaviors of ASBEs fully overlap with the spatiotemporal behaviors of the life forms as the overlapping of the parts of a machine with the behavior of the machine. We also saw the implications of the situation where spatiotemporal behaviors of ASBEs overlap with the spatiotemporal behaviors of a whole, while the identity and certain transcendent behaviors and properties of the ASBEs diverge from the identity and transcendent behaviors and properties of the living being they are part of. 
But since the complexity of ASBEs lead to infinite regress and other big problems as explained in part 1.1.2.2.6, let us now see whether a machine-like127 overlapping between the parts and wholes of living beings is possible if the ultimate parts are simple as the billiard balls; whether we can get a full spatiotemporal overlapping between the wholes of living beings and their ultimate parts if the parts are simple as the billiard balls. Is it possible to have the complex systems of life forms with ASBEs simpler than the billiard balls? If not, what degree of transcendence we need in order to have the actual complex systems at the life layer? Can we have aggregates which look like goats and display goat behaviors with billiard ball-like simple particles using scenarios given earlier?
If the ASBEs are recognized to be complex ambiguously and without limitation, like a dependent variable of the complex life forms, then any organization, complex structure can be claimed to be arising randomly, by chance, without guidance, at least in some regions within the universe or multiverse. 
However, even in that situation there would be problems related to identity and irreducible properties. At this point, it is necessary to emphasize that the billiard ball is extremely complex if we examine it in detail. Plus, the equations given above do not include the real life situation where they have many complex aspects like the angular momentum. Therefore, when we mentioned certain things that may not happen based on simple billiard balls, we may imagine that certain things may happen based on simple billiard balls; however, it is even hard to imagine purely simple billiard balls and anything that they may cause at their upper levels. 
Hence, while the reduction scenario 1 with complex ASBEs does not work because of the necessary simplicity of the things at the bottom level and because of the infinite regress, the reduction scenario 2 where there are simple ASBEs at the bottom does not work either because of the impossibility of having the empirically observed complex life forms based on simple ASBEs.
In scenario 1, the feet of the horse functions such that the horse may run away from a predator, so that the unity of the horse is supported. Now let us contrast that with an analogy of a horse shape in the clouds which corresponds to scenorio 2 where instead of cells, the horse shape is supposed to be reducible to the water molecules � that are supposed to correspond to simple ASBEs, though in fact the water molecules are much more complex than the billiard balls �. In scenario 2, the feet of the horse does not support the integrity of the horse except for the feet directly being there. Likewise, the teeth of the horse in scenario 1 has allegedly a function of supporting the wholeness of the horse by enabling it to eat food, however, the teeth in the scenario 2 has no such connection to the whole of the horse. Here, when we say the whole of the horse, this means that the teeth supports the feet, the brain, the muscles and other parts of the horse to keep functioning.
As an important consequence of the truth of a true horse, we can observe that a true horse�s distinct unity is supported and confirmed by many components from many perspectives: if we look from the back, from the front, from the bottom, from near, from far, or by doing detailed experiments we can confirm that the horse is a real and distinct thing. However, when we look at the horse shape in the clouds from a specific angle and from a specific distance we can see that it looks like that, but when we look from numerous different angles, we may not be able to see a horse, or if we do experiments to confirm its distinct truth, we will not be able to confirm. Similarly, if we want to check whether the components of that horse shape in the clouds is linked to a distinct reality of a horse, we will see that the only thing that the components of that horse support are themselves and the cloud, rather than the horse and its continuity through space, time and its other properties like consciousness that we observe with respect to a true horse.
Since in scenario 2 the only function of the teeth is to directly be there without supporting anything regarding the other organs of the horse, without necessary connections to the other parts of the horse, it does not need to have numerous functions, hence it does not need to have a specific structure and sub-structures. Like the paint in a drawing of a horse does not need to be like DNA and perform complicated functions like being a blueprint for the production of the relevant proteins. So, �simple� type of molecules like water molecule are sufficient to have a running horse shape in the clouds, or the simple type of billiard balls are sufficient to form a running horse shape in the clouds.
Consequently, although the molecules of the cloud can support a horse shape coincidentally, they cannot support a true horse by having numerous modes, and connections to different parts of the horse and components of the horse.
In scenario 2, it is impossible to have a complete and consistent causal chain backwards sequentially in time, and downwards  in the layers structurally from the running behavior of the horse. It is the balls or molecules in the foot of the horse that move according to laws of physics no matter whether they are part of the horse or not. In scenario 1, we might theoretically go backwards at least up to a certain point and see that the cells of the horse move, chemical reactions contract and extend the muscles, electrons move to carry signals through the nerves. The properties and structure of a true horse are very special and the formation of a true horse is not a matter of low probability compared to the horse in the clouds: We can imagine many billiard ball-like structures at the bottom, which are not able to cause a true horse. A consistent cascade of relations are necessary to make the physicalist evolution true. But if physicalist evolution is true, then all is at the end of the day the behavior of ASBEs at the bottom. Nothing in any layer and no layer within the cascade has any distinctly effective power; so it becomes key to find out the nature and reality of the ASBEs. 
In scenario 1 we can explain why a being behaves a certain way like the brain; how and why the brain behaves a certain way; how and why a brain cell behaves a certain way; how and why an enzyme in that cell behaves a certain way� In scenario 2, regarding the goat in the billiard balls, the explanation boils down to the positions of the billiard balls, although there are certain sophistications necessary about some properties of the billiard balls, but since they are supposed to be simple we omit the latter. So, the positions of the billiard balls are explained by randomness. In scenario 1 also, although we explain many things through layers, at the end of the day, the key explanation is about the ASBEs; and hence the positions of the ASBEs and the positions of the constituents of the ASBEs. In scenario 2 the randomness overweighs the relations.
To cause so many layers to behave simultaneously in consistent ways without any divergence, ASBEs must be extremely sophisticated; plus this sophistication must overlap with a very special structure since we can think of many sophisticated ASBEs which would not cause many consistent layers built upon them. If for example the ASBEs were like moving clips we could not have the stars and planetary systems � note that if the ASBEs are the bottom elements, no change is possible within each ASBE no matter what the conditions are, because if there is a change, then it would not be the bottom element �.
Under reductive physicalism, we cannot have two different trajectories at two levels, because behaviors at any layers are reducible to a reduction basis layer. It is also impossible that the thing at the reduction basis layer should take into account epiphenomenal things at non-effective upper layers since it is not transcendent and it cannot have a goal of forming those relations at those upper layers. For example, while the moon orbits around the Earth and the Sun in a helix-like trajectory, individual atoms on the moon would exert complex multi-directional motions related to the combined effects of the moon's rotation around the Earth, the Sun, and the center of our galaxy. Even a specific motion at a certain time may be the opposite of another specific motion of itself in terms of direction.  So, an atom on the moon moves both around the earth and around the sun, and both trajectories constitute different lines, although in actuality they constitute the resultant vector(s) as if all the related information related to that movement and its equations are embodied within that atom. So, things at the reduction basis behaving such that to form numerous patterns at the upper layers and having the necessary transcendent powers in and of themselves is impossible.
In scenario 2 it is impossible to get something other than an illusion of life, because if there is not some coincidental event, there is no coming together of ASBEs to look like a living being or a species, and if the physicalist evolution is true, then there would be high probability that the ASBEs were distributed such that there is no distribution that looks like life from a certain perspective. Important questions in this regard are �what makes scenario 1 an illusion  as opposed to the scenario 1?�, �what makes it an illusion such that it is different than scenario 1?�, �what makes scenario 1 different than scenario 2?�, �in what case it would not be an illusion?�
In fact, if physicalist evolution is true, then life in both scenarios is an illusion. The only difference is that in scenario 1 there is not only a simple coincidence like the apparent shape of the horse in the clouds, but there is a much less probable event like the deeper coincidental connections among the layers near to the life layer. So, while regarding the horse shape in the clouds the eyes and ears of the horse are the result of the coincidental symmetry and patterns displayed by the coincidental ordering of the water molecules, regarding the scenario 1, the coincidence has been so lucky that we can also relate the shape of the eyes to the aggregates of different atoms which look like for instance light sensitive cells. However, in the scenario 1 also we have nothing more than a cloud of ASBEs that move in accordance with the laws of physics. So, the difference between the two is only a difference in degree.  
Both scenario 1 and scenario 2 happen because of the coincidental special spatiotemporal distributions of ASBEs within certain regions of the spacetime. But the probability of obtaining scenario 1 is much lower compared to the low probability necessary for scenario 2. 
In scenario 2, for example, the parts of the horse�s hoofs move in harmony randomly. But in fact they are not connected. But they look connected. They just coincidentally look connected. In scenario 1 they are connected, but in fact again each part followed its own trajectory and randomly they look connected. In both scenarios, parts may have caused other parts to be in certain places. The difference between the two scenarios is just a difference of degree. In scenario 2 a billiard ball cannot cause a bond between two parts, in scenario 1 it seems to be able to. But in scenario 1 also it does not do anything of its own, it just follows its trajectory that comes from near big bang. So, the explanations about scenario 2 apply also to scenario 1.
Law-like or pattern-like behavior and coincidental behavior are incompatible if one is supposed to be fully reducible to the other. Even if we see a pattern at a certain level, it will negate and diverge from a coincidental behavior at another level. A pattern at the higher layer will destroy a pattern at the lower layer, if they interact. Likewise, an autonomous behavior at a certain layer is incompatible with fully random or law-like pattern at another layer if one is supposed to be reducible to the other. In the actual life, if a chemical disturbs our health we are deactivating it as a whole agent at the upper layer or the chemical may win; there is interaction. 
3. Scenario (3): The balls cause this perfect overlapping by targeting this overlapping and causing the behavior of goat and its components. 
This is just a theoretical scenario since according to physicalist evolution, the balls cannot cause this perfect overlapping by targeting this overlapping since they are simple and cannot transcend the above layers. Otherwise the higher layers would be embodied within the lower layers, and the lower layers would be transcending the upper layers.
4. Scenario (4): The goat controls and makes the lower level things overlap with its goals where thte layers are reduced to the upper layer.
This is also just a theoretical scenario. Because the higher level aggregate cannot control the lower level things since it is reducible to the lower layers according to physicalist evolution.
5. Scenario (5): There is a common cause which makes them overlap. 
This is also only a theoretical scenario for physicalist evolution. Because there cannot be a common cause which makes them overlap, since a common cause that would transcend multiple layers would be against the reductive aspect of the physicalist evolution.
6. Scenario (6): There are different situations with different combinations where sometimes some of them control the others.
This is also only a theoretical scenario for physicalist evolution. Because it is a combination of the previous three scenarios that cannot be acceptable for physicalist evolution for the above reasons.
1.4.2.2.8.5.1.2 Physicalist Evolution Rejects the Distinct Existence and Effectiveness of the Relata of the Life Layer.
Physicalist evolution tries to explain wholes that it does not recognize.
What is life? What is a living being? What is struggle to survive? What is free will? What is consciousness? What is an agent? As living beings, we recognize these by our experiences. The nature and content of our explanations depend on �how� we define what we explain. 
Some see life as a special spatial temporal set of positions of things, distribution of particles, like the special positions of colored billiard balls.
If this is the case then the explanation will consist of an initial state, the laws/ patterns according to which things move, and the cause(s) of this state and those laws/ patterns. 
Again, if this is the case, then the contents of what is explained by reduction to another layer will be ineffective and supervenient upon the initial state and laws. In this case, the explanations that consist of the living things and high-level components of life will only be approximations hence they will be fundamentally wrong and incomplete. In this respect, for example if I say "the child ate chocolate because he loves chocolate, will be wrong and an incomplete explanation". Because his love of chocolate is only an approximation which is incompletely defined since the real cause is the processes that go on at some allegedly unknowable subatomic level in his brain and things that happened at some unknowable point in the past. The same would be true for an explanation as �the mouse escaped in order to survive� where the mouse, its escape, and its survival would be only epiphenomenal and inconsequential. 
If the ontological reality is fully an ambiguous reduction basis, then the truth will be unknowable and also there will be no being who can have such capacity to know and nothing to be known. This is because of the impossibilities related to the allegedly self-sufficient spatiotemporal bottom elements (ASBEs), infinite regress, circularity... If the ontological reality is like this, then our search for truth is no more than something like a random movement of billiard balls with zero distinct effectiveness. For some, we just have an illusion of having an effective effort to find the truth and of benefiting practically from this search in new scientific practices.
But if the case is that life with properties like consciousness, qualia, reason, free will power, is a distinct and irreducible reality, then the explanation provided in terms of life and its high-level components (as the organs, DNA, proteins...) will be real and effective contents of our knowledge. The above-mentioned love of chocolate will be at least partially a distinct and effective content of knowledge on top of what is going on at the level of brain atoms and the child's past. In this case, our quest for knowledge will have produced in principle a concrete, complete, and essentially correct outcome, even though in details there may be some missing points. 
The same applies for explanations related to evolution. If the ontology is like in the latter, then an analysis related to natural selection may be considered as a work which really contributes to the accumulation of knowledge. Otherwise, if a gray ball came next to a black ball, and a white ball came next to the gray ball and if I explain the coming of the white ball based on the order of the shades of the other two balls, I will be wrong since the explanation will be misleading and wrong as the effective cause. The colors of the two first balls have no effect on the coming of the white ball next to them, if the balls just move randomly in accordance with their shapes and their random initial state.
The rejection of the distinct effectiveness of the things at the life layer will result in the following contradictions and problems:
1.4.2.2.8.5.1.2.1 The Reduction of Life and the Recognition of Life-Related Wholes Are Contradictory
Physicalist evolution theory maintains that the particles behave the way they do because of the laws of physics and that they are indifferent about what happens at the life level such as our reasoning or free will power. Hence, according to it, nothing at the layer of life forms changes the flow of events that happen in accordance with the laws of physics at the layer of particles. So, for example, if a goat runs away from a lion, actually the effective mechanics are not really that of a running away or that of a survival; the effective mechanics are just the atoms of the goat and of the lion and other particles merely moving in accordance with the laws or forces of physics such as the gravity or the electromagnetic force.
Another example is as follows: Does a pregnant cat on TV screen give birth to the kitten on the screen? No, it is the pixels and the electronics of the TV and electricity flow that cause the next set of pictures, without being related to the previous picture. We can also make animals that do not exist at all give birth to other animals simply by manipulating the pixels and related bits. Physicalist evolution theory says on one hand that this example of pixels is true, but on the other it also says that the survival motivation, and natural selection are also effective. So, in one way it argues both that reduction is true, and that reduction is not true. It tries to have the cake and eat it too. Can it be consistent if it claims that the pixels might randomly produce the movie of the kittens being born? No, because it argues for the reality of distinctly effective processes as natural selection. 
If "we" produce evolution in a computer simulation, is it evolution? If a man in an animation evolves, is this evolution? That man does not have any effective reality. But under physicalist evolution, in one way, he does not have to have effective reality for the evolution to occur; the ASBEs draw and animate the life forms. So, under physicalist evolution in one way, one may say that there is evolution in that situation. One may argue that in that simulation the human being does not have a brain, lungs, metabolism. But one may counter argue that the software allows to zoom in and see that he has brain, lungs, metabolism. The reply will be that he does not have real brain, lungs� And the reply to that may  be �what is real other than that?�, since in any case, if physicalist evolution is true, then the human being would be reducible to the atoms and other particles like the pixels or bits of the screen and computer.
According to the reductive aspect inherent in the physicalist evolution, the alleged self-sufficient spatiotemporal bottom elements (ASBEs) correspond to the pixels and circuits of the computer, and the movements of the species correspond to what is seen on the screen in the simulation. There is no real evolution in what we see on the screen, since they are perceptions of zeros and ones in the computer. If we want to predict what will happen next, would we get correct prediction if we use the circuits, electricity flow of the computer, or what we see on the screen? Obviously, if physicalist evolution is true, then what we see on the screen will be less correct compared to the hardware. Because what we see on the screen in this example has nothing to do with the motives for survival; it entirely depends on how the computer has been programmed and other states related to the parts of the computer: if the computer crashes, the screen will be blank no matter whether the picture on the screen entailed the rise of a new species or not. 
Hence, evolution as a reductionist theory is fundamentally inconsistent and contradictory. Because, it tries to reduce the biological to the ASBEs, while it also tries to explain the biological by the biological, yet, it also admits that the physical laws and biological relationships are totally different. It is like saying that what we see on the screen has motives to survive even though there is an underlying computer program which just manages the pixels. 
Is this is like saying �if you press the gas pedal, the car will move� while we know that pressing the gas pedal means in fact causing the fuel go to the engine and many other physical and chemical processes? And is biology just an approximation like that? Obviously, pressing the gas pedal in and of itself is not what makes the car move. If we press the gas pedal while there is no gas, the car will not move. Likewise, if there was no qualia, consciousness, free will power, would life be the same? According to the physicalist evolution theory, yes: The atoms and other particles would do what the laws of physics entail in any case; and these particles do not have qualia and transcendence.
Then accordingly we would say that a living organism is just a continuation of the trajectories of ASBEs in another layer. An animal giving birth is just a view or perception of the trajectories of the allegedly effective ASBEs. When I say �give me the book�, 'giving', 'book', 'me' are nothing but illusory views of the underlying trajectories. Hence physicalist evolution explains nothing, it does not even describe anything effective. Regarding life, we cannot explain things based on the acts of ASBEs, as based on the pixels we cannot explain the essence of the birth of the kitten. 
For example, if a mutation is not distinctly effective and it is reducible to the behavior and trajectories of atoms, sub-atomic particles (and ultimately ASBEs), then using it as an explanation or as if it causes something in and of itself is irrational -here we assume that there is no randomness such that a particle diverges from its trajectory in a way to negate the laws of physics-. Hence, the physicalist evolution becomes irrational. But on the other hand, if mutation is distinctly effective without being reduced to its parts (for example if some mutations are driven by God or by His free will to create certain species or if the whole of the related living organism causes certain mutations) then physicalist evolution fails and God-fashioned evolution is true. To understand from another perspective, let us imagine here that each nitrogenous base of the DNA molecule is a computer (or a smart agent), each base being the distinctly effective. Then can we say that the mutation causes something? No, because then the mutation would be only a trivial intermediary state of the nitrogenous bases. And the physicalist evolution would be like saying �passing through Europe causes going from Istanbul to the Atlantic ocean�. Obviously, what causes going from Istanbul to the Atlantic Ocean may be a plane or a train, not an intermediary stage such as moving through Europe. 
If there are sovereign wholes at higher layers then physicalist evolution is false because sovereign wholes at the higher layers entail distinctly and additionally effective things which are irreducible to things in lower layers. There are distinctly and additionally sovereign things at higher layers, because ASBEs are false as explained in part 1.1.2.2.6, hence there may be sovereign wholes at any layer.
We should note that the physicalist evolution in any case uses also distinctly effective things in the life layer as its components: It says that life forms try to survive, the less fit gets eliminated, species arise� And on the other hand, it says that things happen because of what happens at lower layers such as the layers of molecules and atoms. Hence, it contradicts itself.

But in fact it is the atoms electrons and so on which just move according to the laws of physics.
As another example, imagine a horse shape in the clouds. Obviously, if we explain by reduction, we cannot say that we can establish a theory based on the apparent movements of the horses. If the processes in the cells of life forms are happening randomly then the things at the life layer cannot be different in kind hence there will be no higher level distinct relations at the life layer. What is effective would be the chemical reactions only and the covalent and non-covalent bonds and other movements (deterministic or indeterministic), while the aggregates at the life layer and their behaviors such as 'fighting for resources', trying to survive, price demand supply relations, escaping from predators,... have no effect. 1. That Which is Allegedly �Explained� by the Physicalist Evolution Theory Consists of Sovereign Wholes. 
The physicalist evolution recognizes and tries to explain certain wholes and their properties such as life forms and species. But also, it reduces them to the matter. So, for example when the free will power as a property of human beings is reduced to the behavior of atoms, the human being becomes devoid of a true freedom of will; the same is applicable for the reasoning power, the struggle for survival as well. Hence, the reductive explanation annihilates that which is explained; in other words, if such a power does not exist except as an illusion, and hence if a being qualified with a real free will or survival power does not exist, then the physicalist evolution becomes contradictory. Because if it tries to explain these properties and the beings which have them, then they must distinctly exist; but if they are no more than the behavior of atoms, then they can not distinctly exist. 
The physicalist evolutionist may argue saying �if we say that the rock falls, there is no additional reality stated on top of saying that the atoms of the rock fall�. However, when we say for example that the human being has consciousness, consciousness is a distinct property that we normally do not ascribe to the atoms. In this sense, physicalist evolution is contradictory. Moreover, a physicist who explains the behavior of an atom by some kind of other particle upon which that atom supervenes, and who claims that by studying the atom he in fact studies indirectly that other particle, has no support for his reductionism and for his presupposition that that other particle is superior in kind to that atom such that that atom is epiphenomenal: after all, that particle would also supervene upon another type of particle if the principles of reductionism are true.
Hence, the contradiction of physicalist evolution is not limited to what it the tries to explain. Physicalist evolution is also contradictory in what it uses as an explanation: the atom that he uses as an explanation is not an irreducible thing; and if reductiveness is entailed by the nature of things, then the atom also must be reducible. So, the atom also must not have a distinct and effective reality of its own, and instead of the atom, there must be something else which is effective. And the same rejection must also be true about that something else.
These constitute not only logical and internal contradictions as explained above, but also produce empirical contradictions: The claim that the consciousness is reducible to the atoms contradicts the fact that we experience consciousness. I will give further details about consciousness and free will power in parts 1.1.2.2.3.3, 1.1.2.2.1.4, and part 1.6 respectively.

2. �What is Used as Explanation� by Physicalist Evolution Theory Consists of Irreducible Wholes
Physicalist evolution tries to explain life forms by reducing them to simpler things such as molecules, atoms or sub-atomic particles... Yet, if these are all reducible to other things, then the physicalist evolution will have explained nothing and will face the problem of infinite regress. On the other hand, if there are irreducible things at a certain ultimate layer, the physicalist evolution will have solved the problem of infinite regress to a certain degree, but this time it will have the problem of irreducibility and irreducible wholes which are ever the only distinctly effective things and which never evolve. Hence, evolution becomes just the movements of those irreducible things, and the physicalist evolutionist will be calling evolution something the walk of an animal and something like change in spatial position, rather than the change in the species related to that animal.
If for example the atoms are the distinctly effective things and if physicalist evolution concedes this, then their epiphenomenal behavior entailed by the initial state, will not have an effect of creating the distinct unity of a human being or of another being, and other distinct unities such as consciousness, identity, free will power, reasoning power� Likewise, if the trajectories and spatial distributions are effects of the initial state of the ASBEs, then these epiphenomenal trajectories are not expected to produce such unities.
Again, in this way, the physicalist evolution will have reduced the reasoning power of the human being to the particles, and will have denied itself, because then there is no unity of the agent, which is necessary for comparison, for relating one thing to another, and for using the laws of logic and empirical observations. 
The physicalist evolution tries at least partially to explain things like qualia, consciousness, free will power, transcendence by reducing them to particles. While the fashioning of God explains the consciousness, transcendence, reasoning power, free will power, the physicalist evolution explains them by denying them and their distinct effectiveness. The first thing and the biggest and most certain thing we know is that our consciousness is real above the spatiotemporal. Physicalist evolution rejects this empirical fact without any reason and based on unquestioned brute facts.
Physicalist evolution recognizes species as things that have distinct behaviors. But if species are merely the behaviors and trajectories of ASBEs, then it will have explained the epiphenomenal behaviors of the �ASBEs� behaviors�.
The spatiotemporal positions at a moment would be epiphenomenal if the physicalist evolution studies the trajectories of allegedly effective ASBEs. 
If I shake a box of clips and if they get stuck in an orderly manner, did they evolve? Did the clips that got stuck and their aggregates that got stuck evolve? If there is evolution here, what is that which evolved, the clips? If I shake again, and some more clips get stuck to the parts which got stuck before, has there been a further evolution? What is that which evolved? The previous parts which got stuck, or the second bigger group, or the individual clips which got stuck? Or the entire set of clips? Obviously, each aggregate is directly linked to the clips since the aggregates are not distinctly effective real things compared to the clips. Any such aggregate does not depend effectively upon a previous aggregate, but upon the clips and the initial state of the clips. Even if a certain aggregate may be preceded by another type of aggregate, any aggregate can be fully explained without any reference to any previous aggregate, except to the initial state that may or may not contain any combined aggregate; if we consider uncombined aggregates as well, then the initial state may be just a distribution of ASBEs in space or other medium which would not be within the scope of physicalist evolution.
Let us assume that the parts which get stuck with a strength above a certain level get better stuck when I shake, and the ones under that level get detached when I shake. So, one group of parts which get stuck above that level, get bigger when I shake. Then is this evolution? According to the reductive aspect of physicalist evolution, this should be considered evolution, since life forms are reducible to their particles, and since �random mutation� is just the key means of the physicalist evolution along with �natural selection� which is also a central part of the formation of new forms. The problem here is, what is new? First aggregate? Second aggregate? Is a new spatial distribution of puzzle parts a new form? If so, then we should consider each movement an evolutionary process. 
Note that if physicalist evolution is true, then each clip or each part of the puzzle is also an aggregate. Hence, by explaining an aggregate that the clips or puzzle parts constitute, we will have explained nothing, and we will not have reached an ontological basis.
Moreover, if there were no clips and their relations or if we knew nothing about them but we knew their constituting particles' properties and trajectories would we be able to determine their future positions? If we knew all about the parts of the clips, then we would not be identifying any additional cause by defining the clips and the relations between the clips. 
Can we say that the stability through time and the potential of stability of an aggregate is the key aspect of physicalist evolution? In this case, the units of the puzzle and their inherent stabilities would be existing as the initial stability, hence, what is explained by physicalist evolution would be existing at the very beginning. Similarly, we would have considered a rock as the outcome or as the basis of physicalist evolution as well. On the other hand, the space as a dimension that connects the parts of the puzzle is also in this respect an initial source of stability which does not need physicalist evolution as defined above.
Can we say: If the ASBE is in a certain position relatively to another ASBE, then it can produce another state; so, the spatial positions of ASBEs in an organism create a new potential non-existent in the ASBE, and this potential is that which evolves? If this was the case, there would be no physicalist evolution within the ASBE, the evolution would be in the relative states of ASBEs, unless the organism adds a distinct, irreducible potential from itself. The organism does not produce under physicalist evolution a distinct and irreducible potential of itself. But, if for example we caused the wheels of a car not contact the ground, has the car devolved since it cannot move? No, the car has in itself the potential to move. This potential is turning its wheels. And if they touch the ground then it will move. Touching the ground is not an inherent element of the car. Its being positioned so as to touch the ground is not producing a new power for the car; and it does not produce a new power for the ground. Both the car and the ground have their intrinsic potentials and under certain states they actualize their potentials. Space has the uniting function, but this is an actual function of the space as long as they are within the same space even though the car does not touch the ground, hence, this function of the space is not of the car nor of the ground. In any case, even if the space is considered as elements of the car and of the ground, then they have it inherently no matter where they are, no matter whether they touch each other or not. So, if spatial positions are the distinctive elements of physicalist evolution, then they are not related only to life.
If the organisms are considered just as views and acts of ASBEs then there is no trade-off between physicalist evolution and God as the cause, even though physicalist evolution is presented as an argument against the existence of God -though still physicalist evolution would have its many other problems -. Because in that case, the organisms would not be things with potentials and distinct effects, and they would be trivial; hence, the ASBEs would allegedly be the very things with potentials. An alleged trade-off would be then between ASBEs and spacetime, because ASBEs would also be reducible to something spatiotemporal under reductive physicalism which is the foundation of physicalist evolution. Consequently, in any case such an alleged trade-off would be between two spatiotemporal things; and all of those things would in any case need the One Self-Sufficient Allah as the explanations related to the property of self-sufficiency in part 1.1 and the property of unity in part 1.2 clarify in detail.
1.4.2.2.8.5.1.2.2 Under Physicalist Evolution, an Effective Separation Between Individual Life Forms is Impossible and Unjustified.
Under physicalist evolution, the ASBEs in the initial state extend into the future; likewise, the atoms and many other parts which constitute the life forms extend beyond the future without undergoing a fundamental change when the life form ends; hence, if physicalist evolution is true, separating the living beings as separate beings by distinctly effective borders is impossible and unjustified.
According to deterministic reductive physicalism, the initial state of the universe contains allegedly all data about the future and the past128. If a law is defined as gravity for example, it is connected to ds/dt (spatial change over time change) so it contains the future hence there is no possibility of saying a non-existent and undivided thing evolved and appeared; our saying that the future has not happened yet, and it will be fully and absolutely new is meaningless since because of our limitations we are locked within a time bracket and this does not affect the nature of the overall reality. Under physicalist evolution, it is also impossible and unjustified to �separate� a living thing as a distinct being from the extension of laws and range of ASBEs. 
Can an ASBE be constituted without a time dimension and without an extension in time? If yes, then the ASBE is passive and has no effect in future. If no, then what exists in the future is an extension of the ASBEs; hence, it is not subject to evolution but deterministically it constitutes a whole and the same thing is being only epistemologically divided for our understanding, it is not an ontological basis, and it does not provide us with a room for any distinctly effective new or evolved species.
The problem of identifying the boundaries of evolving things and directly related processes arises both vertically as it relates to how complex the life forms or their components may be, and horizontally as it relates to how big a life form, a species, life realm, or an aggregate can be. If distinct effectiveness belong to the atoms or ASBEs, then for example RNA is just an epiphenomenal aggregate constituted by the atoms or ASBEs. Then again RNAs are just the spatial distributions of atoms or ASBEs. Then RNAs are not the things that evolve. They are just regions within the future states of the universe of atoms or ASBEs. And a region cannot evolve because a region that evolves cannot be differentiated from another region which does not evolve. A region can be an atom, some atoms, the entire set of atoms or ASBEs, or an atom may be part of a cloud and part of a horse shape in the cloud.
