So if we take a region or an aggregate it's layer, or it's boundaries or it's identity is/are not clear. Are computers and other machines part of evolution since as a whole they are part of complexity and development especially if determinism is true?  If a region or aggregate of atoms constitute two aggregates/ shapes of a horse and a lion where an atom is part of two aggregates, it is not possible to conclusively say that that point is part of a true lion or of a true horse. Because there is nothing like consciousness or free will which unites any one of them.
Also, it is not clear how big is the time bracket which defines the ASBE, and it is not clear how in terms of time an ASBE would be delimited in time. Furthermore, there is also a transcendent determination of the spatial distribution of things, and it is not clear how the ASBEs which constitute a life form would be delimited in terms of space. To give an example, imagine that you see the shape of a horse among the clouds; on what basis would you delimit the atoms which constitute that shape objectively and scientifically beyond your objective perception? Moreover, if there is no such delimitations for parts of life forms, then there is a giant whole which in any case behaves such that there are life forms, and not only that, which behaves also as if its parts are aware of other parts. Hence, if physicalist evolution is true and living organisms are not distinctly effective, there would allegedly be a giant whole since everything would be acting as if they are aware of all else. So, the evolution of relatively tiny things is a smaller question; there allegedly would be a giant organism in the initial state entailed by the impossibility of infinite regress. If the additional things the alleged physicalist evolutionary processes produced were spatially connected wholes, then at the beginning this whole would already be existent and encompassing all life forms at all times. Else, we would just have a huge aggregate of particles which produce the illusion that there are distinct life forms which look as if they evolve and exercise life functions and transcendent properties like consciousness.
But then the problem would be how the individual life forms, or the species can be taken as separately, as divided from the rest of the existence and other individual life forms and species. This requires a transcendent power who is aware of the distinctions, and who has a consciousness so that He can allocate consciousness to individual life forms. Physicalist evolution cannot explain the separation of individual life forms from other life forms and from other things.
1.4.2.2.8.5.1.2.3 Change in the Spatial Distribution of Things is not Evolution
Is evolution just a change in the spatial distribution of particles that look like a change in the allele frequency? Or is it a process whereby new irreducible beings arise with their irreducible properties?
What is the mover of evolution? Do we really have units specifically identified through properties such as consciousness, and distinct autonomy through free will power? Obviously, as we directly and empirically experience there are such units. And without the recognition of such specific units, the evolution will be undefinable, redundant, ineffective, and meaningless as a distinct theory. 
The physicalist evolution theory is contradictory and internally inconsistent in saying that all these life-related things are effective while also saying that they are reducible to things that we do not know. Because if they are reducible to things like ASBEs that we do not know, then we do not know either that they are predictable. For instance, they may be like billiard balls which randomly give us the perceptions of things like the shape of a horse in the clouds which may go into unpredictable directions any moment. Or we could even just be Boltzmann brains.
If the nature of evolution is a change in spatiotemporal distribution, then a change could not be qualified as a meaningful one or as a change for worse or better.
When we reason on evolution, we reason on beings, their organs, their functions, relationships...; we do not consider the unknown and inaccessible ASBEs, nor ASBEs spatiotemporal positions. Therefore, claiming that evolution studies ASBEs and their spatial positions is irrelevant and unrealistic. 
If the atoms of a cloud form a bear does this give any effectiveness to that bear shape as a bear? What is the distinction between that which evolves and the mere change of spatial distribution? If there is no distinction, then the nature of evolution is just the change in spatial distribution hence just the movement of ASBEs. If there is a distinction of evolution, to be meaningful, this distinction must be for an irreducible property since it claims to explain life. 
Considering evolution just as a change in spatial distribution of particles is irrational, and undercuts the physicalist evolution itself, by making it undefinable, contradictory, and meaningless. There are irreducible wholes. Hence, it does not and cannot explain life through reduction to the spatiotemporal.
If the object of physicalist evolution is spatial distribution, then, the distinction of a living thing, its life span, its properties that relate to life, its distinction from a non-living thing disappears. Reduction basis cannot be points or regions of space but functions, relations like �if then� relationships that are obeyed by points and regions.
If we recognize the animals as new wholes just because of their spatial distance and distinctness, then we have also to recognize the wholeness of other layers, including ASBEs. But in this case, the animals would not be reducible to other things, since, as everything would be defined by space, then nothing would be superior to other things. So, even before unfolding, they are distinct and effective wholes; and therefore, we would not be able to explain anything by anything else, since in that case everything would be same in kind.
If spatial change is a new thing, then any combination or ordering of parts differently is a new and irreducible reality, not only the sovereign wholes.
If a team of students in a festival that constitutes some shapes of flowers are repositioned, do we say that they evolved? No, because their repositioning is in accordance with the conditions at the relevant moment, and the flowers do not have any effective existence. The students are same and their distribution is not an absolute, and absolutely better or worse distribution. It can be redistributed quickly with the new conditions. The overall potential of the team did not increase. If we say that the team evolved in this case, then it may be reversed in the next minute. The team is not an effective thing according to the physicalist evolution, and accordingly, when the team is repositioned, the improvement does not occur in the effective thing. A mere spatial distribution does not have anything to do with evolving. So, evolution cannot be defined in a meaningful way in the physicalist and determinist framework.
In the above team example, the space is also contained in the team members and their minds. Hence essentially it does not add anything. Likewise, earlier parts explained that each object may be considered as having its spacetime. And the spaces of parts of a whole come together in holism although each space of each part might be disconnected, but this coming together is not an element of evolution. So, spatial distribution is within parts and not an addition of evolution. So, that which is claimed to have evolved is already existent in the beginning, if reductionism and determinism are true and if evolution is no more than a change in spatial distributions.
If that which evolves does not have a distinct ontological distinct existence, then talking about its evolution is only a means to identify the positions and trajectories of ASBEs as we observe them in our limitations. The spatial change alternative is similar to horse in the cloud alternative. If physicalist evolution is true then we are simply like the horse in the cloud: the parts of the cloud of hydrogen or quarks right after the big bang keep following their trajectories and there is no reason to say that there are new distinctly effective wholes arising afterwards, all that appears must be aggregates of the dusts after the big bang or even inside the singularity. As the horse (shape) in the cloud does not have any effect on the movements of its particles, the apparent light sensitive cells and seeing of the organism has no effect either. According to reductionism neither our subjective perception of the horse nor the aggregate of the particles which constitute the horse shape has any distinct effect on what happens next. Hence there is nothing which evolves or which causes any change through evolution. Physicalist evolution is ultimately defined as change and what causes change are the ASBEs.
According to physicalist evolution, the evolution of effective things, would then correspond to the evolution of ASBEs. They would not be changing; else we would be talking about their acts and views. But their acts would not be equal to evolving things and they would not have potentials: If I walk, it is not evolution, because my walking is not a new effective organization or being. The movement of an animal is not an evolution of units as organisms, because otherwise every movement becomes evolution. Our forming a company is not evolution because it is an actualization, it is not the appearance of a unitary thing with distinct and autonomous potentials. 
Furthermore, if every movement would be considered as evolution then a reverse evolution because of the reversal of the direction of time, would also be equally evolution: For example, if the direction of time would be reversed and we ended up having the original cell or replicator from numerous species, in accordance with determinism entailed by reductive physicalism, this would also be considered as physicalist evolution, since according to physicalism and determinism, whatever happened in accordance with physicalist evolution would happen also when the direction of time has been reversed. In this case, evolution would be no more than movement. Some might argue that because of the second law of thermodynamics, such a time reversal would be impossible; however, such an impossibility is irrelevant since the point here is about the contradiction between physicalist determinism and physicalist evolution no matter whether we are in a universe with the principle of entropy or not.
If RNAs are considered as evolving under chemical evolution and if chemical evolution is considered as part of physicalist evolution, then evolution is defined by spatial change alone because spatial change that increases the number of similar aggregates would be a sufficient requirement to call something as evolved. If physicalist evolution excludes the chemical evolution then this exclusion will contradict the reductive aspect of physicalist evolution since the key element of physicalist evolution is at the level of RNAs and DNAs. If the definition of evolution covers only the spatial repositioning of molecules, or particles, or ASBEs, then the distinct properties of life are not explained by evolution. Hence, it does not explain the species, since it will be excluding some key properties of at least some species.
Can we say that the entire aggregate of ASBEs (our universe) evolves? No, this is studied by physics. And physicalist evolution itself reduces the wholes of life forms down to ASBEs and claims to explain the complex by the simple which is under the scopes of chemistry and physics. Physicalist evolution claims to not say anything about the movements of particles. So in one way there is an inconsistency between the claim that things are explainable by the simple, and ending its scope at the boundary of the layer of physics. There seems to be a faith in physics which is incorporated within the physicalist evolution: the physical entities are able to produce the complexity and properties of life forms. Physics does not say that, physics studies the simple movements in accordance with simple laws. So, the claim of the physicalist evolution of explaining the species at least some of which have consciousness, free will and so on by studying the simple is faith based. Physics does not say anything about the consciousness or free will. But physicalist evolution claims to have explained or to be able to explain the species some of which have those properties, yet it relocates the duty beyond a point to physics which does not assume that responsibility. One may say that the physicalist evolution attempts to explain only the physical movements of the species, and that it does not say anything about the properties like consciousness or free will or reasoning power. However, as human beings we know that at least our species has these properties and cannot be considered without them and that these properties are essential to survival and fitness which are essential to physicalist evolution.
1.4.2.2.8.5.1.2.4 Spatiotemporal Connections of ASBEs Would not Produce Sovereign Wholes with Sovereign Properties
Above, we saw an analogy of relations between the dynamics of an animal on the screen of a TV and the hardware of the TV. 
But one may argue that some wholes may be produced by some parts: For example, if we bring together an engine, wheels and so on, we may produce a car which is a new machine which did not exist when its raw materials were not given their specific forms and relative positions in space.
To explain this point, let us use our moving bit clips example: If I threw two specifically positioned clips in a specific way and they formed a whole, this whole was not formed by itself. So, if such a whole looks like running, similarly it does not run by itself. Or, if we have replicating clips then what is that which evolves? What is new? The connected clips? Do the aggregates constituted by these clips have new properties such as consciousness, identity, free will power...
Likewise, under physicalist evolution theory, saying that �life forms� reproduce, survive, and so on would be like saying that the shapes formed by the clips form themselves or run. So, the explanation that the clips moved, and a part opened by being thrusted by the other clip and then it got closed does not explain a distinctly effective cause and the rise of a distinctly new whole; it only describes what happens in the realm of the clips. What happens is reducible to a great extent129 to how the parts of a clip got bound together in the first place and happened to have initial positions and momenta.
If some moving bit clips in the earlier example got bound and constituted aggregates which look like bars after some periods, and bars look from a distance as if they move in a certain way, are these bars really definable as bars? Or in any case whenever we zoom in, shall will see that there is nothing which may be called a bar? If physicalist evolution is true, in supply demand relationships, if the demand changes according to price, shall we observe agents if we zoom in or shall we see particles moving according to alleged laws of gravity, electromagnetism... which just �look like� behaving in accordance with supply demand relations? 
In physicalist evolution, if parts behave so as it is possible to tell them from any other whole, then when we zoom in, we will not find precise agents, but aggregates of parts which from far look like agents. If when we zoom in, we see that it is impossible to tell the agent from the parts in his distinct effectiveness, then the parts are not more fundamental than the agent and the agent is not reducible to the part. 
If for example the agent conceives a perfect circle, then we can say either that the related parts have transcendence, or that the agent has an irreducible transcendence and unity130. We will not be able to see any objects constituting a perfect circle no matter how much we zoom in.
This also relates to free will power experiment in part 1.6.2.1.1.3 where the prediction of the experimenter E2 never overlaps with the act of the experimenter E1 who tries to negate the prediction of E2. If parts were real but the agent was just a fully reducible aggregate of parts, then the apparent agent's behavior could not differ from the behavior of parts. How can there be 100 percent overlapping between that which is reduced and the reduction basis? 
If physicalist evolution is true, then things at the reduction basis will allow for a completely accurate prediction. That which is considered as a whole at a higher level and allegedly reducible will not give a perfect prediction, because what looks like a pattern of what is reducible would be only coincidental if it does not have any distinct effectiveness; and such a pattern would be very short-lived.
If the moving bit clips get intertwined so as to look like a bird, when we zoom in, we will discover that we cannot make any prediction based on the behavior of that bird, but we can more reasonably and precisely predict based on the confirmed patterns of the clips. It is impossible to make a prediction based on the behavior of an alleged bar if it is in fact constituted by the clips and if it is allegedly reducible to the clips, since it is impossible that the clips whose entire details we do not know, overlap precisely with what we conceive as a perfect bar; the prediction can only be made based on the units and properties of the clips. Hence there will be no correct prediction based on a species if it is not distinctly effective, except if we assume that it is not distinctly effective and it only gives some idea about the things at the reduction basis. Any prediction based on a species may be negated by the ASBEs. If the species is considered to be another name for an aggregate of some ASBEs, then evolution will be a science of ASBEs not of species.
If the clips formed at a certain stage an approximation of a circle then would we say that the circle arose through the evolution of aggregates of clips? If the circle in a certain region divided in two circles through a process like natural selection and repeatable random events would we say it has evolved according to the definition of physicalist evolution? If yes then any such distribution would be an approximation including the process -of natural selection and random mutation- and would be evolution. Hence physicalist evolution would not be consistently and distinguishably defined, all movements would be physicalist evolution. Also our consideration of something as metabolism or reproduction would be inconsequential since those considerations would be no more than approximations as well since our brain also would be an approximation. If no, then the reason for the answer being no would be the lack of consciousness, free will... and the recognition of irreducible aspects of evolution. In physicalist evolution the answer must be yes, else it will be negating the reductive aspect of physicalist evolution.
If, while moving, billiard balls produced a square at a certain moment should we say that there was a square at that moment? And if the following shape was a rectangle should we say we had an evolution, that the square evolved into a rectangle, even though we may establish a special progress in some situations? Obviously we had totally distinct movements of balls which coincided with the square and rectangle. But if based on that we say the squares unfold into rectangles we are wrong.
If the ASBEs are the only effective things, then can there be physicalist evolution without an increase in the effective things? If yes, then physicalist evolution would be only a change in spatial positions. But what would make this change better than the previous state so that we can say that the initial state evolved, instead of saying that something just moved like the movement of a rock or of an animal? Note that we see the �improvement� in the definitions of evolution in words like �new� forms, new �physical characteristics� as a result of change inherent to physicalist evolution. If two atoms bind, is it evolution? If one oxygen atom binds with two hydrogen atoms, we do not say that there has been evolution. 
Hence, evolution is not simply the binding, or unbinding of particles.
If the evolution of an aggregate is just the movements of its parts then we cannot say that it evolves because it is not something on top of its parts and it is not distinctly effective and existent. Is not the physics like this? The gravity is assumed to apply to the atom or proton or its parts no matter how small they are. But in evolution consciousness is not necessarily applicable to protons or neutrons or electrons.
If the distinctly effective is the movements of atoms or other sub-atomic particles, then we need to take all atoms in the universe. Then we will see trillions of atoms which do not constitute life forms or parts of life forms and we see that some form life forms as in the billiard ball table example. There are particles which form RNAs, which form partial RNAs, and which form no RNAs. So why would we select those which form RNAs and assign a causality to the contingent patterns therein? The distinctly effective things do not cause always random mutations. Hence, it happens coincidentally only if certain conditions obtain like the conditions in the billiard ball example. This is the implication of seeing evolution as a change in spatial positions of the ASBEs or of the particles: if life forms or RNAs are not distinctly effective, then the physicalist evolution explains only the trajectories of ASBEs or particles in arbitrary regions. The adjective �arbitrary� is appropriate here since if the physicalist evolution is true, then our considerations are no more than accidental and epiphenomenal events that are reducible to the non-transcendent behaviors and trajectories of the particles.
1.4.2.2.8.5.1.2.5 If the Physicalist Evolution Would be True, Then the Effective Power Would Belong to the ASBEs, Predictions Would be Based on ASBEs, and ASBEs do not Exist.
The physicalist evolution attempts to explain the complex with the simple. The reductive aspect of physicalist evolution can be true only if there is a material reduction basis consisting of ASBEs. But as explained in part 1.1.2.2.6, ASBEs are impossible for many reasons.
If ASBEs do not and cannot exist, then the project of evolution to explain the life forms in terms of ASBEs collapses. There is nothing to which a human being is fully reducible. Then each human being is a new and distinct being with his distinct consciousness and irreducible properties.
Other factors such as consciousness prove the sovereignty at high layers. So, as noted in the following verse, sovereign wholes are formed and ended:
He brings the living out of the dead and brings the dead out of the living and brings to life the earth after its lifelessness. And thus will you be brought out.
(Quran: 30/19) 
Does physicalist evolution predict based on the survival efforts, knowledge, information, molecular structures, and other properties of living beings or based on the trajectories of the particles at the fundamental levels (ASBEs), their patterns, and their trajectories? If based on ASBEs, then how valuable is the prediction based on things at the life level other than their alleged being the representation of ASBEs? If things at the life layer are just giving us an idea about the behavior of ASBEs, and if in fact we predict based on ASBEs, then can there really be ASBEs? Part 1.1.2.2.6 demonstrates that ASBEs are impossible.
1.4.2.2.8.5.1.2.6 That Which Allegedly Evolves is Ambiguous and Distinctly Ineffective Under Physicalist Evolution
Since physicalist evolution needs to explain life, it needs to recognize that which evolves. But when it recognizes the distinct reality of that which evolves, then it contradicts its reductive aspect. Hence, it needs to reject the distinct reality of that which evolves, but if it rejects it, then it becomes like chemistry -which admits that it explains only the physical events as seen from another perspective- and it cannot explain life; then it can explain only aggregates in which case it will have explained only movements of parts and it will not have explained the distinct nature of life. 
If we take our (human beings') perception as the basis of the unity and distinctness of that which evolves, this perception will be useless as such a basis, because physicalist evolution rejects the unity and distinct effectiveness of human beings' perception as well.
What is that which evolves? Species? Organisms? Organs? Cells? Ecosystems? Molecules�? Under physicalist evolution, the distinction and borders between a life form and its environment would be arbitrary and arbitrary. Because after all, the particles behave according to the laws of physics no matter whether there are any living beings and their living components or not at some layer. Hence that which evolves would be just a change in spatial positions, which would make impossible its definition related to life. Hence, life would be reduced to just ASBEs and their behaviors.
Physicalist evolution entails the rejection of wholes. If we consider evolution at the level of life forms, why do not we consider it at the layer of atoms? Physicalist evolution says species evolve, it does not say that atoms evolve: Because they do not change and the change in their spatial positions is not and cannot be considered as an evolution. If I move from Istanbul to Paris, I will not have evolved. If I move to the left of my friend I will not have evolved, I and my friend will not have evolved. If a group of students simulate the evolution of bacteria, they will not have evolved. Physicalist evolution sees life forms like physical objects, yet it makes use of identity, survival, as if they are effective: it wants to have the cake and eat it too. 
Is there anything that happens differently at different levels? If the physicalist evolution is true, then the layer of atoms would give us more detailed info compared to upper layers like the layer of life. In tectonics or chemistry there is no such problem because these do not claim a different whole, they do not reduce an irreducible property to movement of parts, or they do not claim to explain different wholes like life forms, they explain just spatial relations at different layers like physics do, they do not claim to explain the rise of new distinct wholes. 
Upper layers can only be approximations in physicalist evolution. But for example, in chemistry they are not; in chemistry they are defined by lower layers and what is claimed to be explained are other properties observed of fundamental particles like protons and electrons at a higher layer like molecules which are not distinct new things that arise through independent distinct mechanisms like survival or being fit.131
Any whole allegedly defined by reduction basis is not well defined except as an ambiguous aggregate of the reduction basis. Does physicalist evolution explain things at the layer of life though they are not distinctly effective? If particles constitute a circle and we define it and call it a circle which goes left, but if one of the parts of the circle goes right while others go left, then our understanding about the circle that it exists is wrong. It is not a true circle, and it is not going left. So, our approximation is wrong. But if the circle has a distinct irreducible property and its irreducible existence, and if we recognize it as a distinct whole on top of its parts then even if that particle swerves, what we say is true; and we can say that that particle diverges from the �circle�, since that circle may have a distinct effect through being an ought or an ideal situation in certain contexts which we may use and we may change the states of things accordingly. This is also like a person who loses his arms and legs but who still is the same person. We can prioritize some of his attributes and say that those transcendent attributes constitute his whole and his distinctive elements.
1.4.2.2.8.5.1.2.7 There is no Principle Which Prevents the Higher-Level Wholes From Being Distinctly Effective Like ASBEs or Lower-Level Wholes.
Is there an evidence-based principle which says that only the parts can be distinctly effective?
Parts like the flagellum of a cell may look like forming a higher level complex structure like a cell; however, it is not in fact the flagella which form it; it is the parts of the flagella since a flagellum does not have zero complexity. But the same is applicable to each part of the flagellum as well. Hence, the parts of the flagella are not an explanation for the complex structure that they form. And therefore, the parts at a certain level do not intrinsically have the necessary properties for the formation of the higher level whole. If the parts of the flagellum (and ASBEs) do not have the properties and power to constitute the ASBEs and the flagella hence the higher level wholes, and if there are these wholes and ASBEs, this means that the power is owned by another being. We may imagine that some complex aggregates consist of ASBEs, and knowing the ASBEs and their general positions in space and time and their movements may give us �full knowledge� about the aggregates they form and the behavior of those aggregates; however, in this case the aggregates would not be distinctly effective. Yet, in this situation, we cannot say that there is some principle which prevents the higher wholes from being distinctly effective like ASBEs. 
Moreover, if there would be such a principle, it would prevent the ASBEs from being distinctly effective. Because if they exist, they cannot have zero extension; hence, they would have in any case some constituents.
1.4.2.2.8.5.1.2.8 Impossibility of Perfect Mechanistic Overlapping Between Layers
If we have an aggregate of legos which constitute a car, and if we say that the car moves in direction x, and if the component of this car moves in the direction y, can both be considered true unless we consider the car as a distinct whole? If it is just an aggregate, then obviously all components of the car do not move in the direction x. Therefore, the claim that the car (as an aggregate) moves in direction x becomes wrong. If the parts of an aggregate change, then the aggregate changes because an aggregate change is defined by its parts, and there is nothing else (holistic) which gives the aggregate its distinct existence; hence, any change in its parts makes it another aggregate and cuts the connection between the two states of the aggregate so that the next state becomes another aggregate. The only connection within our perception is just epistemological or it is just to facilitate our communication and it does not relate to any distinct ontological link between the parts of the aggregate. We might say that even when the aggregate or its parts do not undergo any change, there is no ontological connection between the parts such that to differentiate it as a distinct aggregate from other things. Therefore, we cannot use words like �this aggregate changed� or �this aggregate evolved�: if this aggregate changed, the aggregate after the change is no more the aggregate before the change.
If the aggregate moves in a direction x and its component moves in direction y, then there is a contradiction. If animal x behaves to survive, but its component y behaves differently, then there is a contradiction. Either its component is not its component, or it is just the component which is the distinctly effective. But if the aggregate is a whole not inferior to the component, and the component is also a distinct whole, then they may be behaving in opposite directions. Because then there would be a vertical new dimension in which they are related, like two animals are related within the space.
If the engine of a car works and the car moves, then is the car distinctly effective? No. When we say the car can move, we then mean that it moves as an aggregate. If we say it moves in horizontal direction x, in fact some parts in its engine may be moving also up and down in vertical direction. What we mean by the �car moves in direction x� is then not correct if it is just an aggregate. We mean then that what �we� perceive by a car moves in direction x, not the aggregate of the car. If we consider the car as an aggregate, then not all constituents of the car moves in direction x. Then if we mean that the car moves as an aggregate, we make an approximation which is just instrumental for communicating what we perceive. 
When we say that an aggregate grows we may only be meaning that the space between its parts are increasing, since, the word we use for that aggregate corresponds only to its parts and not a distinct whole on top of the parts. So when we say that an animal is a reducible aggregate, and we say that it survives, we may be meaning only that the sum of the parts that looks like that animal continues in that the relationships between its parts continue. The wording is just to transfer the meaning about what �I� perceive in my unity, in the unity of my consciousness; this meaning also contradicts the reducibility of the animal since I make a distinction between the aggregate of the parts which have no place as a unity within the universe that separates it from the rest of the universe.
Otherwise, if by that animal I mean an irreducible whole that moves, then its behavior must not be inferior to the behaviors of its parts; then again its behavior cannot be fully explained by its parts. If two layers are distinctly effective, then it is not the (spatiotemporal) shape of  the things that explain the behavior of the things because a shape is in any case a single shape no matter whether there are smaller details or not. Then there are some non-spatiotemporal things which manage things at different layers hence, there may be conflicts between those essences, and the resulting distribution of shapes along with other outcomes may vary. But if the bigger shapes are reducible to the smaller shapes, then we go to infinite regress. 
The presupposition of the physicalist evolution is that the life layer things behave but their behaviors are reducible to the bottom layer, hence the bottom layer is the distinctly effective. The physicalist evolution works on this presupposition where the bottom layer is the fundamental and distinctly effective. Other things are just our perceptions from a different perspective. But the physicalist evolution does not question the bottom layer -which according to physicalist evolution is the real and distinctly effective thing-, the physicalist evolution works just on the presupposition which is implausible. If the life layer would have any distinct effect, then there would be a conflict between the life layer and the lower layers -if any of the lower layers is/are considered as a reduction basis-. 
But if we say that certain relations at the life layer (including cell layer or molecules layer) hold true and are distinctly effective and have predictive power, then do we mean that there is a mechanistic correspondance between the ASBE layer and the life layer? Otherwise, if the ASBE layer has its own patterns, since it is at a different scale, it would be impossible that they overlap. For example, the running of an animal cannot correspond to any behavior of the ASBEs. Because the ASBEs are not animals hence, they cannot be ascribed a behavior which is considered as the running of the animal that they constitute. If physicalist evolution is true, then the relations between things at the reduction basis level cannot be the same with the relations between things at the higher level (like life level) because the relata are different; hence, if physicalist evolution is true, then we need to discard one of the relations. The animal has legs which move in a specific way. The ASBEs do not have legs, and even if they had legs, their running would not be the running of the animal they constitute. Even if they targeted the behavior of the animal, their behaviors, and trajectories would be defined differently since their sizes, their positions cannot be equal to those of the organs of the animal; if they would be equal, then the reductive aspect of the physicalist evolution would be false. If things at the life layer and ASBE layer are distinctly effective, then it is impossible that their behaviors overlap mechanistically. Hence the only way out for the physicalist evolutionist is that the life layer is not distinctly effective, but the behaviors of the ASBEs appear like running animals in certain regions and at some layers.
Can there be more than one deterministic layer, can all layers be deterministic? If the layer of the ASBEs is deterministic and have its own laws, and together with that can the layer of life and its molecules be deterministic and have its distinct laws? For example, can we say that all economic decisions will be in accordance with the laws of economics? If each layer is distinct, it will be impossible that both are deterministic within themselves, at least at some points there will be divergence. In a certain context, if the price goes up, the demand will go down, and at the layer of atoms this will have implications. Moreover, there are numerous layers. Hence, even if we grant that different laws at different layers will not clash, the predictability of all behaviors of all things at all layers will be an extremely low probability, close to impossibility. Because there are almost infinite points within the trajectories of all things in all layers. We cannot determine different laws for all layers and predict that all laws at all layers act in harmony. Then if there are laws of the ASBE layer, we cannot expect that it is deterministic, in other words predictable according to its laws while the molecules layer is also deterministic and obeys its own laws. Also considering that anything would have in any case components, we can conclude that no layer can be deterministic; because if one layer is supposed to be deterministic, then the layer of its components might also be theoretically deterministic, but then two layers would need to be equally deterministic while being distinct layers. So, even if one layer would be deterministic, we would not be able to know it. Of course, if we visit the idea that they may be indeterministic under a reductive approach, we will see that in that case, there will be no basis for a law at all except for probabilistic laws; but in the latter situation, the laws will result the same problems with the deterministic situation.
If determinism and indeterminism are impossible as demonstrated in part 1.4.2.2.8.5.1.8, then it is not possible to make a prediction based on the ASBEs, hence, whatever happens diverges from the default prediction -which is no action-, hence, there is always divergence. 
If the higher level diverges from the lower level, according to physicalist evolution, this is impossible and against the laws of nature and contradicts physicalist evolution and reductive physicalism. Therefore, physicalist evolution is impossible because then this means that the distinctly effective mechanisms of physicalist evolution including those used as explanations at its reduction basis, like mutations are not distinctly effective.
On the other hand, if ASBEs are complex but at the life layer there are distinct mechanisms then life layer processes would be randomly overlapping with trajectories of ASBEs: in this case, the physicalist evolution would not have been explained by the simple.
So recognizing both the effectiveness of the relations defined by the physicalist evolutionist at the life layer and claiming that they are reducible to the ASBE layers is contradictory unless these two overlap, and since this requires an overlapping between the two. But since this overlapping is impossible for the above reasons, either the relations the physicalist evolutionist defines at the life layer are false (and the reduction basis is effective); or the reduction basis is ineffective and the life layer is the effective hence reduction is false. Hence, in any case, physicalist evolution is false. 
If I am distinctly effective according to the distinct features of life forms as recognized by the physicalist evolution there is also a further inconsistency: For example, on one hand, I am going on my free will and control so that I survive in accordance with the effects tendency to survive recognized by physicalist evolution; but on the other hand, the effective process is the movements of the atoms according to laws of physics according to physicalist evolution. However, if physicalist evolution is true, then my prediction about my direction may contradict a true prediction according to ASBEs or atoms. Therefore even if there is an overlapping in a certain time interval, it can disappear in the next time interval. But if there is an interaction between layers and no separation between the whole interacting system, then there are no separated layers and there is a single integrated system, hence there will be no such divergence, separation, and contradiction. But maintaining that there is one reduced layer and one reduction basis layer creates a division and separation between layers and creates a contradiction and an unnecessary need for reconciliation between layers.
1.4.2.2.8.5.1.2.9 Impossibility of Perfect Coincidental Overlapping Between Layers
The previous part overlooked the need for simplicity of the distinctly effective things at the reduction basis layer in order to analyze the implications of mechanistic relations between layers assuming that there is no necessity of simplicity at the reduction basis layer, and that there is no problem of infinite regress. However, as explained with respect to the scenario 1 and scenario 2, the bottom layer of reduction basis must be simple and can only be coincidentally distributed and behaving coincidentally. If this is the case, then can we have a meaningful and coherent overlapping between the upper layers� patterns claimed by the physicalist evolution and the coincidental behavior of the reduction basis layer? In other words, can we have a situation like the horse in the clouds where the scientific experiments give consistent results that relate to biology while at the bottom, the ASBEs have coincidental structures and behave coincidentally? 
Theoretically this is possible although there is a low probability that is very close to zero.
However, as exphained earlier, if we consider the complex relations between the life forms and their components, it is impossible that simple ASBEs can cause this overlapping. 
Moreover, let us think a point in the spectrum of non-overlapping and full-overlapping where there is some deviation between the coincidental behaviors and the pattern-like processes at the life like the survival of the fittest or the processes of mutations and replications. Let us move in the spectrum gradually to the point where there is full overlapping. In the previous point of the spectrum, the distinctly effective layer was the reduction basis: a single true divergence makes us conclude that the higher layer is not the distinctly effective layer.
Let us suppose that there is full overlapping between the coincidentally obtaining things at the reduction basis level and the life layer patterns detected through experiments. If the life layer coincidentally overlaps with the events at the reduction basis layer, then the patterns at the life layer become ontologically no patterns, since the reduction basis layer is the distinctly effective layer. Even if there is full overlapping, ontologically the physicalist evolutions tools and processes become just coincidences that will only enable us to predict based on our luck, and presupposing our luck. A full overlapping does not show the existence of a law or of a principle -like reductive science claims-; unless we support it with logic.
Regarding the low probabilities related to life, often the physicalist evolutionists use the concept of multiverse. However, even if we are in a multiverse, even if we accept the anthropomorphic principle, it would be very unlikely that we are in a universe where these overlappings happened since under the assumption that there is a coincidental overlapping between the life layer and the coincidental layer, it would be much more likely that we would be existing in a universe where there is no such perfect overlappings and where the deviations would be detectable easily.
1.4.2.2.8.5.1.2.10 Overlapping Between Layers Renders the Reductive Aspect of Physicalist Evolution Redundant
In the previous two parts we saw that a mechanistic overlapping between the reductive basis layer and the layer of life is impossible, and that a reduction of the life layer to coincidentally behaving things at the reduction basis layer undermines the attempt to explain life layer through processes and entities related to life layer. In this part, we will see that even if those problems do not exist, the reductive aspect of physicalist evolution renders this evolution theory redundant.
If there is reduction and if the life layer and the reduction basis layer are the same as the reduction basis, then in fact, there is no reduction since they are ontologically the same and the physicalist evolution is part of physics. Then explaining full details of the higher layer means explaining the lower layer from a different perspective, if physicalist evolution is true. But this different perspective would be fundamentally incomplete since it is only a limited view that recognizes its own narrowness. Here fundamentally incomplete means that our study has no connection at all with and no grasp of anything distinctly effective: for instance, the human being and his desires are almost illusions and have zero effectiveness compared to what happens at the reduction basis layer; our observations are very distant from what happens at the reduction basis layer.
On the other hand, if there are no distinctly effective mechanisms at the life layer, then physicalist evolution does not explain the origin of something new when it explains something about a new species. It just explains spatial distribution of particles as physics do. So, it does not explain any transcendence, truth, free will and identity of human beings. But if a human being is a whole which is irreducible to the trajectories of ASBEs, then the overlapping between his behavior and the movements of its ASBEs is either true or not: if it is true, then either it is coincidental, or there is interaction between that whole and its ASBEs; if it is not true, then what physicalist evolution explains by the movements of ASBEs is only an approximation and it does not explain the human being.
Evolution tries to explain a layer by a different layer, while physics tries to explain things at the same layer with things at the same layer. If evolution tried to explain the layer of atoms within the life forms through the layer of atoms, then it might be consistent. But trying to explain a layer with another layer is problematic and requires saying that the higher layer is equal to the lower layer. Otherwise, to be coherent, it had to be recognizing the reality of the higher layer and its equality in terms of distinct effectiveness to the lower layer, and it had to be trying to find out interactions between the two layers equal in their distinct effectiveness. But then it would have left its reductive aspect. In this case, the distinct properties of the higher layer would be coming from another source, since they would not be coming from an ambiguous and undefinable lower layer. 
We should also emphasize that the redundancy explained above encompasses the reduction basis layer as well: If the effects of directly life-related layers are redundant, and if those layers are fully predictable by the reduction basis layer, then processes at the higher layer are not really and distinctly effective processes. So is there predictability at the layer of atoms? Or electrons? Or quarks? Does the physicalist evolution use the level of quarks? If it uses the level of atoms how can they be useful in predicting and forming rules for physicalist evolution?
Then, for example, if a life form has a more light sensitive cell, will it not give an influence on survival? No, because �light sensitive cell� is not a distinctly effective thing, it is also reducible to other things at another layer. If there is no ultimate distinctly effective layer, then what we have are things at different layers where none of them has superiority �nor inferiority�, but which interact with one another and which are equally sustained. ASBE is not superior since it is not simple. If it was simple, then we could not have the life layers as explained earlier. If the whole constituted by the ASBEs cannot be distinctly effective thing, then the ASBE cannot be considered as a distinct thing either since it would also be reducible to another thing, especially if it is complex.
Let us give another example: Let us suppose that we see in the clouds that the shape of a black polar bear goes extinct for being noticed by its prey. Or we may build a kind of a billiard ball universe where the color of the bear is reflected in its DNA molecules and the black color is noticed in the snow and the bear does not get food and dies while the atoms of the white bear move such that it is not noticed by its prey, it gets food, and it can reproduce and survive. In this bear example the bear is not distinctly effective. The atoms behave exactly the same way under any specific conditions no matter whether there is a bear or not. The bear does not have any distinct causal effect as opposed to God-fashioned evolution. But the bear cannot behave except as fully caused by the atoms, whereas according to God-fashioned evolution the bear is as real as the atoms -the atoms are also like the bear, since there is no superior, material reduction basis-. Here an important point is that all atoms do not have to be structured so as to allow physicalist evolution. So at best the atoms in our universe (or on earth) may only be allowing physicalist evolution. So physicalist evolution is not like a law. Only under specific conditions atoms may allow it. But even under these specific conditions could we say that there is a relation such that the black bears get noticed and we will see white bears more after some generations, while this relation overlaps with the physical behavior of atoms? Why would not an atom diverge from the black bear rule? There is no principle for this overlapping, there 'can be no' principle for this overlapping because we cannot say that an atom must comply with the black bear relation if physicalist evolution is true, and we cannot say that the black bear relation must comply with the laws of physics since there is no distinct black bear if physicalist evolution is true. If the black bear relation continues while a constituent atom diverged, then the black bear relation would be comprising the movement of the divergent atom as well. Then there is no distinction between the black bear relation and the laws and the black bear relation is defined as the physical law. Whenever the first powerful magic cell and its composition arises such that it allows physicalist evolution, we have physicalist evolution; whenever it does not arise we do not have physicalist evolution.
Let us have another example: We say that the engine produces the mechanical energy which moves the truck. But if a part in the engine is misplaced or does not work the engine may not produce its predicted function. So if reduction is true then explaining 'anything' by the engine in and of itself is wrong. Hence the function belongs only to the parts of the engine. But each part of the engine also has parts. So the trajectories of parts are that which is distinctly effective. But then there is a contradiction and divergence between the predictions based on the engine and predictions based on the parts of the engine. And in principle these contradictions may happen even if on certain instances there is 100% overlapping: even if there is an overlapping this is not because it has to be, it is because of luck if physicalist evolution is true. So if the trajectories of parts are distinctly effective, then physicalist evolution cannot use mutation or natural selection. Because it is not rational to claim according to physicalist evolution that mutation is more than the trajectories of particles or ASBEs. And since what we predict based on mutation may diverge from the trajectories of ASBEs, and since in a divergence the ASBEs must be taken into account and mutations must be discarded, then what we have as life forms are the products of the trajectories of ASBEs according to the laws of ASBEs. Hence the processes or mechanisms of physicalist evolution are contingent and can be no theory which is a candidate for being a law or pattern. And not even that, but nor can the physicalist evolution be a bunch of processes or mechanism which may be used to explain any life form. Because ASBEs follow their own trajectories no matter what happens at the level of life. In the absence of the holistic influence of the life layer, the probabilities of ASBEs forming aggregates which look like species or life forms or organs or cells of life forms come very close to 0. And even if they look like life forms, obviously this will be a matter of luck. Even the actual occurrence of these life form-like aggregates will undermine physicalist evolution since the ASBEs will not have followed the trajectories and mechanisms posited by physicalist evolution.
If ASBEs are highly complex then physicalist evolution is not a good explanation, it is just moving the goalpost, and it shows that evolution is no explanation because the bottom is already complex and needs explanation, without even causing the complexity of the things that allegedly evolved starting from �simple� things.
As a matter of fact, for the physicalist evolutionist it should not matter whether life layer and lower layers overlap or not because if there is overlapping it happens only randomly. But the consequence of this is the rejection of the processes used to explain evolution.
If we said that we mixed some chemicals and out of this mixture a frog appeared, would the physicalist evolutionist believe in it? Actually, those who work in the field of abiogenesis try to make this happen, maybe to a lesser degree by producing cells or at least complex proteins. In this case, the physical trajectories would comply with the behavior of the frog? One point is that we would look at the probabilities, and it would be very improbable, since the probability of even a cell appearing is very low. But the more important point is that how the trajectories of the particles would overlap with the behavior of the frog, even if the unlikely overlapping happened? If it happened, then of course this would lead to a conclusion that the reduction basis layer is complex enough and confirm that the physicalist evolution works in fact on the layer of physics; however, if such a thing happened, then the problems arising from the complexity of the reduction basis layer would invalidate the physicalist evolution in another way.
1.4.2.2.8.5.1.2.11 Divergence Between Layers Undermines the Reductive Aspect of Physicalist Evolution
If the life layer is reducible to the reduction basis layer, and if these layers overlap, then the explanations of the physicalist evolution related to the layers directly related to the life layer become redundant. 
On the other hand, if the layers diverge, then the attempt of the physicalist evolution to explain the complex with the simple fails. If we separate layers as one that is reduced and the other one as the reduction basis, and they are not the same then they can contradict each other as we saw earlier in the free will power example. 
Moreover, if the reduction basis layer is the distinctly effective and especially if coincidence takes some part in it, then we can expect any divergence at the higher layers. If one layer explains not one higher layer but many higher layers then the explanations by those higher layers will be redundant, because a more fundamental layer is sufficient as explanation due to reductive aspect of physicalist evolution. The explanations of the higher layers may be contradictory since they are redundant: The horse (shape) in the cloud may be running away from a lion but may also be running towards the lion. Because in any case there is a sufficient explanation at the atoms layer. So the higher layer explanation is impossible if reduction is true and if only the distinct effectiveness of the reduction basis layer is recognized. Hence, higher level explanations may contradict each other or those within lower layers.
1.4.2.2.8.5.1.2.12 According to Physicalist Evolution That Which Evolves is an Approximation.
Unless a structure has a distinct effectiveness, it is an approximation. This effectiveness may be by that structure in and of itself on top of its parts, or by another distinctly effective being or agent who conceives that structure transcendentally. There may be a degree of approximationness: if the ASBEs behave like billiard balls and with no intrinsic clear patterns and properties, then what they constitute as an aggregate is an almost totally unpredictable approximation; an example would be like the horse shape in a cloud; we cannot predict what the horse will do based on the distinct shape or properties of that horse. If the ASBEs are like clips which have some sophistication and properties which support to some extent the continuity of an aggregate, that aggregate is still "essentially" an approximation but to some extent: we can predict some of the behaviors of a whole, e.g. a circle, that the clips form, but for a precise prediction, we need to know fully the properties of the clips, not of that aggregate. This kind of approximation does not entitle us to claim to be doing science either. And we are not, and we can never be able to know that the ASBEs support hundred percent the higher-level wholes and patterns. We can never have sufficient evidence for this complete support which requires full knowledge at an infinitesimally small level. Only by a transcendent cause which encompasses that whole as a distinct whole we may say that it is a distinct whole and not a mere approximation. For the reasons explained in other parts of this book, something may not be an approximation only through a mind and only this may entitle us to make science; we cannot make predictions nor claim to have determined patterns at certain layers, based on approximations and aggregates at those layers. If we prove such a mind which interacts which reality with sufficient power, we can claim any prediction. And in any case, it is unlikely that lower layers overlap with what we see at our layer coincidentally through reduction. There will be deviations at multiple layers, but the adjustable, interactive, not unchanging, not absolute, not separated wholes at multiple layers may be adjusted for the intended outcomes at specific layers. The support cannot be a lucky overlapping. In a reductive approach, if there is an overlapping between layers in a certain instance, it will be the result of luck. Because if we recognize the distinct effectiveness of all related layers then statistically/ probabilistically they will diverge; even if they do not, this will be through coincidence and by their different natures, they will be divergent. If higher layers are reducible to lower layers than the lower layer things will be distinctly effective, and the higher layers will have no distinct effect on the lower layers except as coincidentally, which is not a true effectiveness. If the clips constitute a square, we cannot say that the square has an effect on the clips, since the square is fully defined only through its parts under the physicalist evolution. And to say that the clips are such that they must form a perfect square we need to have complete knowledge about the clips, and we can get this knowledge only by studying the squares at higher layers; but if we can get this knowledge that way, there will be circularity and ambiguity.
As may be seen in the above-mentioned definitions of evolution, that which evolves is ambiguous. Does something epiphenomenal evolve or does something distinctly effective evolve?
As a popular example, allegedly darker moths may be more difficult to be seen and eaten by birds in an environment which became darker because of pollution. Consequently, the moths which have genes which cause darker color may survive, and reproduce more, hence causing a population of black moths.
But what is here that which evolves: The species? Individual life forms? Their properties? Gene pools? Genes? Molecules? Atoms?
Or if we explain the genes by atoms, why should we stop by the atoms? Or why should we stop at any layer? Should we presuppose that the explanation is in an infinite regress whose impossibility is explained in part 1.1.2.2.7.
Or should we presuppose the existence of an ultimate layer of allegedly self-sufficient spatiotemporal basic elements (ASBEs)?
But if the ASBEs are the effective things, and other things are reducible to them, then how did the ASBEs appear? They cannot have appeared through evolution, because if they have appeared through evolution, then they are not the ASBEs. So, if we presuppose the existence of the ASBEs as the only effective things, then they must not have appeared through evolution, but their acts must be appearing through evolution. 
Let us do a deeper analysis about the distinct wholes, their layers, and effects through some examples:
i. Example 1: Flock of Birds
Let us imagine that there is a flock of birds which fly together, and which have the shape of a �big bird�; and upon noticing a hunter, the �big bird� runs away. Physicalist evolution is like studying the shape of this flock which looks like a big bird: It draws conclusions from the big bird, yet it says that the big bird is reducible to small birds.�If the big bird has a consciousness of its own and tries to survive, then saying that it is fully reducible to the small birds is contradictory. But if the small birds have a property of coming together under certain circumstances so as to produce a consciousness and other features of a big bird, then studying the big bird will be redundant, unless in an understanding that the big bird is studied just to discover the properties of the small birds which are the distinctly effective things.
By the way, we will focus on this example to understand whether physicalist evolution studies living organisms as epiphenomenal things like the �big bird� above, or whether it studies the small birds in the above example. And we will try to find out if it studies the small birds, whether they correspond to reduction bases such as molecules, or atoms, or rather ASBEs. We will also try to understand the related implications of physicalist evolution. 
So, if the big bird is reducible to small birds, then studying the big bird is not very useful because if it encounters an object or is subject to another effect, it is not possible to predict how it will behave based on that shape. But if the flock redirects to another place, it is because of the birds. If it runs away from a hunter, we do not say that it ran away but we say that the birds ran away. If we say that anything which looks like a bird, would run away from a hunter, this would be false unless the constituents of that shape are sensitive to hunters. 
So, as of now, it is not reasonable to set the big bird as the scope of physicalist evolution. But then if it should not study the epiphenomenal big bird, and it should study the distinctly effective individual birds, why does it claim to study the life forms? Since according to the physicalist evolution living organisms are reducible to their molecules, atoms�, and if it studies the life forms, does not it study what corresponds to the big bird in the above example? Or does it recognize that the life forms, such as human beings who have properties such as consciousness, reasoning power which are not reducible to the particles? Yet, if it studies random mutations in the molecules and natural selection subject to the physical behavior of physical entities, how does it ascribe distinct and irreducible effectiveness to the life forms?
In the bird example, the birds are effective, not the big bird shape they form. If we call the shape they form a bird, this would be an approximation unless we define that shape with all details contained in the constituent birds. 
The flock of birds may have the shape of a big bird, but this does not mean that a big bird was born or that it exists distinctly; hence, if the molecules and atoms are the effective things, and if a life form does not have a distinct existence, then we cannot say that it evolves, since it does not exist as a distinct thing, it is just epiphenomenal as the shape of the flock of birds. Moreover, studying an illusion as if it is effective, though it does not have any distinct effectiveness is contrary to our understanding of science. The big shape of the bird cannot be studied in a laboratory, we cannot communicate with it, we cannot assign distinct behaviors to it, we cannot even bind it or control it, it adds nothing to the individual birds, and it is allegedly just one aspect of the behavior of the individual birds. We cannot test that big bird since it does not react distinctly to our acts. Testing it is meaningless. According to the reductive aspect of the physicalist evolution, even if we test it, in fact we will be testing the birds which constitute it.
If we are reducible to our genes, atoms� then why does physicalist evolution claims to study the life forms which correspond to the big bird?
We can say that the size of this flock is bigger than the size of another flock; or we can say that this size and shape scares an enemy. However, such statements are mostly reducible to the birds. But saying this shape of flock will reproduce or eat something is incoherent, unless we recognize that it is a distinct sovereign whole. If we say that it reproduces while it is fully reducible to small birds, then, the small birds must have a property of constituting such a reproducing big bird.
If reductionism is true, then a flock does not have the unity, the identity, the consciousness, the will power� of a bird distinctly from its constituents. The shape of the big bird and the flock is an aggregate and it is not a sovereign whole according to the physicalist evolution. Hence it does not have a distinct causal effect. So, we do not say that the bird shape of the flock evolves, because that shape is not a distinct whole in and of itself; and as it is not distinctly effective it cannot evolve actively, it can only change for being supervenient upon the individual birds; hence the individual birds are active; without understanding the behavior of the individual birds we cannot predict the behavior of the shape of the flock. If we try to predict things based on the shape of the big bird, setting aside the individual birds, this will not be a useful study. If we can the contribution of the big bird in and of itself, then we will be contradicting the reductive aspect of the physicalist evolution. Consequently, if physicalist evolution claims that the species evolve, it is like claiming that the big bird evolves; so, claiming that for example the species of moths evolve contradicts the claim that they are reducible to their molecules. Because, if the physicalist evolution is true, moths are no more than like the big bird shape. On the other hand, the atoms or other more fundamental particles of the moths which correspond to the individual birds in the above example do not change, hence, do not evolve in terms of our context. So, according to the physicalist evolution, that which is distinctly effective does not evolve; but that which is allegedly epiphenomenal and reducible evolves. 
Does evolution have to be the study of sovereign wholes or epiphenomenal things? The study of epiphenomenal things does not increase predictive and effective explanation: if our consciousness is fully reducible to the particles, then we cannot say that a specific conscious experience may result in a certain event, except if it uses that experience indirectly as an indicator about the state of underlying particles which are allegedly the real effective things. Moreover, the epiphenomenal things are not even definable except in terms of distinctly effective things.
God-fashioned evolution has some practical benefits: An explanation based on the shape of the flock of bird will never be sufficiently predictive or explanatory under physicalist evolution, except as a hint about the ultimate underlying particles, since things in any intermediary layers are allegedly reducible to those underlying particles. However, wholes at many layers may have explanatory power, so the best way is to collect information about many layers that relate to a thing at a higher layer. But if we know the nature of birds which are distinct wholes, then we can make predictions. So, in theory, even if we do not know fully anything, a non-epiphenomenal entity or being may truly contribute to our predictions and explanations of all things, even if we do not know the ultimate supervenience basis. 
Note that in the above example I made some simplifications, since in reality, a flock of birds also has a holistic aspect, so essentially it does not correspond wholly to a deterministic reductionist framework, and this framework is much weaker than the structure of that example.
Question 70. 
For example, plate tectonics is reducible to the behavior of atoms and molecules, the plates of the earth crust are aggregates of smaller constituents, and the plates are not distinctly effective; yet plate tectonics and related theories can help us predict and understand earthquakes. So, why would not physicalist evolution be useful and explain things at the life layer through aggregates?
Answer 70. 
The present criticism about physicalist evolution does not claim that there are no aggregates and that no aggregates can be useful. Obviously transporting 4 people in a car will require more fuel compared to transporting 2 people. However, the criticism claims (1) that in any case there are multiple irreducible distinct wholes at multiple layers and (2) that the life layer contains such irreducible and distinct wholes. 
Point (1) is explained in parts 1.1.2.2.1, 1.1.2.2.6, related following parts of this section about physicalist evolution, and other related parts of this book. Physicalist evolution has common problems with reductive physicalism. A study of plate tectonics according to reductive physicalism will also have the same problems.
According to reductive physicalism, sciences like tectonics chemistry... all explain ASBEs under reductionism; they study trajectories of particles or or corresponding properties of waves, fields and so on. Physics study a certain layer of events based on reductionism, so it is not different than physicalist evolution in its reductive assumptions. It analyses the layer of atoms, protons, neutrons as well but it does not recognize that they have irreducible properties to their constituents, physicalist evolution makes the same assumptions, the common point is that they presume that things and events consist of the spatiotemporal properties as movement. Reducibility of higher layers to lower layers entails that the relations and patterns at higher layers gives us precise clues about their lower layers; hence there is precise relation between layers as supervenience, therefore higher layers are predictable precisely by knowing the lower layers. Hence there is no distinctly effective thing at the higher layers. 
Point (2) is already a contradictory claim of physicalist evolution: the struggle for survival, natural selection, species, life forms� are treated in physicalist evolution as partially or wholly distinctly effective wholes and processes. Point (2) is detailed in many sub-parts of this section and other parts relevant parts of this book.
     ii. Example 2: Moving bit Clips
In this sub-part, we will see an example to illustrate why life forms and other key elements of physicalist evolution can only be approximations, and what problems the physicalist evolution will face in this context. The example consists of imaginary bit clips which move, open, and close in the same homogeneously repetitive pattern. The clips will correspond to the alleged objects/ particles/ fields/ strings which are the things at the alleged reduction basis or supervenience basis layer of the life forms. Also, while they repeat the same opening and closing movements, they sometimes get intertwined with other bit clips so that they form some shapes which have some beginning, extension, and ending in time. They have ends which can connect with other clips� ends, so as to establish connections enabling kind of replications of certain aggregates. The shapes they form randomly and/ or through the progress of the shapes they formed will correspond to the life forms that we observe in accordance with a reductive physicalism and physicalist evolution. 
The clips in this analogy are like colored billiard balls whose random distribution looks like a life form, except they are used for a longevity of the structures by being bound, not just coinciding momentarily to specific positions. But they must be essentially like billiard balls, even simpler, because if they have differentiations and they are many, this means that they are not self-sufficient, and they cannot be the most fundamental things. But to understand the following points, we just assume that the most fundamental things contain some mechanisms.
This is an important similitude to which I will refer in later parts. A purpose of this similitude is to better understand the implications of physicalist evolution, the distinction under physicalist evolution between the life and the matter. Another purpose of this similitude is to make a comparison between these and the corresponding things with respect to God-fashioned evolution.
We will imagine that these clips get bound to other clips randomly and produce many shapes which look like doing acts in the living world, such as eating aggregates formed by other clips. On some other occasions, we will imagine them as bound so as to look like circles or rectangles. The similitudes about the clips in the following parts will help us understand better the reductive and God-fashioned evolution.
In the similitude of the flock of the birds, the more fundamental things were the birds, and the big bird shape constituted by birds was not effective. In the similitude of clips, the constituents, that is the clips are allegedly effective as the molecules and atoms of the physicalist evolution, and the shapes that they constitute or the acts those shapes will look like doing, will rather correspond to the real-life events. This is like the billiard balls example we gave in earlier parts; however, since it will be hard to imagine billiard balls binding one to another so as to form shapes which have duration in time, here the balls are replaced with the clips. 
Now let us suppose that a region within trillions of such bit clips, while moving in their monotonous way, randomly behaved as a replicator and started to copy a string. And then we observe shapes which look like simple life forms. According to the above definitions, what is that which evolves? Is it each clip? Or is it each aggregate which looks like a replicator? Or is it each aggregate which looks like a bacterium? Or is it the aggregate of the aggregates which look like bacteria? Obviously, each clip does not evolve, since they do not undergo any internal change; they always move the same way, the only thing that changes about a clip is its location. 
None of the other things above may be said to evolve either, since they are just aggregates and they are not distinct wholes. The shapes they form are just random spatial distribution of the individual clips.
However, a physicalist evolutionist may say that the replicating bacteria-like aggregates of the clips may be said to have evolved if they have been selected for: for example, aggregates of clips which randomly had two binding clips  might break the aggregates with one bond when they hit them. And through their endurance, they may have increased the probability of getting three or more bonds. And once such a competitive aggregate is too big, it gets divided, but the divided parts continue their growth since they have been effectively organized compared to other types of aggregates. Hence, some aggregates may be fitter, survive, and be naturally selected. And some aggregates which underwent some changes which cause them to have more numerous bonds may be more and more likely to exist as opposed to other types of aggregates. Consequently, since they became well defined structures, they should not be called aggregates anymore, but they should be called as life-forms which have evolved. 
According to the definitions of evolution given in part 1.4.2.2.8.4, in this specific example we have a true evolution. Because there are replicators, there are physical changes, there are new organisms, there is reproduction. Obviously, their metabolism does not have the high degree of organisms in the actual world, but this is only a difference in degree, not a difference in kind. The �organisms� (aggregates) in the above example do not have any effectiveness distinct from the clips which constitute them. However, the definitions of evolution and the physicalist evolution do not entail, necessitate, and allow any distinct effectiveness for the wholes that the particles form. So, according to those definitions of evolution, in the above example we have a true evolution.
The problem is that if this is true, then physicalist evolution is only about the spatial distribution of the ASBEs and nothing more. Hence, the product of evolution, would be only a change in the spatial position; and it is not any individual organisms or beings with distinct effectiveness. Likewise, for physicalist evolutionists, the human beings do not have distinctly effective free will power or consciousness.
However, a mere change in spatial position or distribution may not be a distinctive aspect of that which evolves, and it may not be a key aspect of evolution: For instance, let us assume that the soccer players form a shape. If the spatiotemporal change is an element of the evolution, then although the players are the only fashioner of the shape in a specific situation, then their positions will be an element of physicalist evolution. After all, the changes in the genes are no more than epiphenomenal spatial changes.
