If one says that this is different in that the spatial changes in genes cause changes in the features of certain life forms, we can reply that these features are no more than a spatial distribution of the particles.
Does the spatial distribution of the clips influence the clips, which are essentially the effective things? No, the clips influence other clips in accordance with how they must behave in the circumstances that correspond to a specific spatial distribution; these circumstances are intrinsic to the nature of the clips.
Assuming that evolution does not deal with the fundamentally effective things, but with the positions in space will result in absurd conclusions.
If evolution merely explains the spatial distribution of things as physics does, then it does not explain the life forms, because life forms and their properties explained in part 1.4.2.2.8.5.1.4 are more than spatial distribution. If the physicalist evolution claims to explain properties such as consciousness, knowledge, free will power, then it must set aside its reductive aspect. 
Physics explains the spatial distribution of things: How does an atom move? What is its trajectory over time? It does not study what it feels, or whether it feels, or whether it survives. In terms of space it studies moment by moment details; in this respect, evolution does not explain the details of the physics. So if its scope of study is moment to moment details of the movement of atoms, then it does not explain the life of beings since life starts and ends in accordance with certain processes. But if it explains the distinct extent of �life� of life forms, their identities, extension in time, the behavior and development of life forms, then it does not explain merely atoms, and its unit is not atoms. But if it explains atoms as �tectonics explain atoms just from a different perspective� then it will be denying the distinct existence of life forms except as a heuristic. The spatial distribution is about infinitesimal micro details which are mostly reflected through mathematical equations, not transcendently extended things through space and time, connected through identity, consciousness and so on.
Furthermore, physicalist evolution does not consist of any process distinct from deterministic processes of clips, since the only effective process in the clips example, is the monotonous internal movement of the clips. The only effective thing which makes a difference is where the clips are located initially. Hence, if in accordance with physicalism everything has been set at the beginning, whatever is seen as the result of physicalist evolution, existed unchangeably at the initial state if determinism is true; if determinism is false, again evolution does not add anything on top of the behavior of the particles. So, whatever was the cause of the initial state, was the cause of what unfolded from it, the cause of what unfolded cannot be physicalist evolution. 
An important question about the above example is about the identification of that which evolves. In real life, we have distinct things such as a dog, or a cat, or a fish� In the above clips example, what are the boundaries of that which evolves? One may say that the example was not well structured for the identification of that which evolves. However, if evolution is no more than a specific spatial distribution, then any shape will be only an approximation without any distinct essence or unity, unlike anything in any science or art, unlike an atom, an electron, a good sold, a price, a political party, a drawing�; and no aggregate or alleged whole will have any distinct value or identity compared to another one. This is especially important after the findings of quantum physics about the non-locality. Physicalist evolution deliberately avoids making sufficient reference to the factors that identify that which evolves such as consciousness, free will power, unitary extension in time. Because if it refers to those as distinctly effective properties of distinctly effective wholes, then it will need to find a sustainer for them, and it will need to quit the claim that the systems of life forms may be explained by reference to the movements of particles alone.
If the unit of evolution is an individual, then what are its boundaries? Are they that which is non-separably encompassed by the consciousness of that individual? If we cannot apply the definition and find the evolution in the example of clips, then this means that to define it and to apply the definition to an actual evolution we must have some units which have an extension and distinct unity in spacetime. There must be some features which are the basis of that distinction. So, things like consciousness, identity, ought to be states are necessary for the definition of evolution. Hence, if evolution would be true, it would be a God-fashioned evolution sustained by the SSC with the related properties.
If in the clips example these units are the clips, then we must accept that they do not change hence do not undergo evolution. If these are not the clips but only things that are fully reducible to clips, then again, they are in essence the clips together with their spatial positions; and as they are unchanging things, then the evolution would not exist. 
If that which evolves is defined within moments, but not with a beginning, extension, and ending in time, then everything evolves including atoms and other objects, since there is change in every moment's position/ state. 
On the other hand, the only things that are not approximations in the clips example would be the clips, assuming that they are the most fundamental indivisible entities. Anything and any shape they formed, could be defined fully only by reference to the related clips. Any identification outside this reference would be defective. The only thing that may raise such shapes from the state of being approximations to the state of being distinct realities would be distinct properties such as consciousness which are not reducible to the clips. Again, as explained in the earlier parts of the Fashioner property of Allah, the properties and positions of the clips would be elements of fashioning; and as they would not be self-sufficient, they would be the results of the Creation and Fashioning of Allah.
If that which evolves is any clips being bound one to another, then the constituents of every chemical reaction which results in binding would be a "that which evolves". Also, since being in the same space might be considered as a binding in different ways, everything would have evolved; but it is clear that evolution is not such a thing reducible to spatial positions and connections.
If life forms are not distinctly effective, then explanations built on them are insufficient and always wrong in principle since they are just approximations. So, if the aggregates in the clips example do not have any distinct effect on top of the effects of the clips, then building any explanations on them would not be useful except as using them means to have information about the reduction bases. Therefore, if for example we take some measures upon some findings of a depression in a person, and if we reject the distinct psychology of that person, then those findings will be considered as findings about the state of the particles of that person. Consequently, we will be causing an effective change in the state of his particles, not in his psychology, since his psychology does not exist effectively under physicalist evolution, and since the claim of the emergence of a property totally unrelated to the movements of particles out of nowhere is very fallacious.
     iii. Some Implications of the Ambiguity About That Which Allegedly Evolves
Can we say, �if the evolution defines only the acts of distinctly effective things at the reduction basis, and not the changes in the distinctly effective actors like life forms, and if the acts of the things at the reduction basis are deterministic and if they overlap with the actors� nature, then determining the acts of the things at the reduction basis equals determining the actors at the life layer�? Saying this is rejecting our -human beings�- reality, effectiveness, and creativity. If it was true, then our properties like knowledge would be inconsequential and void of truth value. It would contradict all empirical acts we do.
If the species/ life forms -hence human beings- are just the acts of ASBEs, and physicalist evolution theory is sufficient to explain the human beings in terms of the acts of the ASBEs, then we are epiphenomenal and ineffective. But it is obvious that this is false, since we believe in the usefulness of science, because of which we do science. 
If evolution theory studies the spatial positions of otherwise unchangeable ASBEs, then it does not explain and cannot explain the usefulness and distinct value of human beings and their activities including science. But obviously, science has value and we have free will power and consciousness as distinct powers. 
Therefore, the reductive nature of evolution theory collapses. The related problems will be further explained under the falsity of physicalist evolution in part 1.4.2.2.8.
So, does evolution study only the acts of the ASBEs? If evolution is applicable to their acts, then there is a contradiction: Are our acts outcomes of the acts of the ASBEs, hence evolution? Are our products outcomes of the acts of the ASBEs, hence evolution? But if we have free will power, then we are not acts of ASBEs; and we have free will power as explained in part 1.6.2.1.1.3. On the other hand, if all my (allegedly ASBEs�) acts are processes of evolution, what about my acts which have nothing to do with, which are neutral regarding natural selection and survival? What would be the criteria to distinguish the acts which relate to evolution? 
If our acts supervene upon the acts of the things at the reduction/ supervenience basis, then can these acts evolve? No, because our acts would be passive and supervenient upon the effective thing. So, we cannot talk of the survival of an act, as we cannot talk either of the survival of unchanging ASBEs. 
Changes in the spatiotemporal positions as acts exist; however, they are passive and they are not unified as an effective thing with a power to influence things. Whatever is the actual position of an ASBE, that ASBE should have an inherent potential of behaving in many circumstances; and these potentials are intrinsic to the ASBE. So, a specific position of an ASBE cannot correspond to an evolved ASBE, since in any case it has intrinsically those potentials; hence, its being in a specific position does not mean that it has evolved.
Saying that the spatial distribution of the ASBEs in a certain moment (or time bracket -as life-) after an alleged initial state of the limited universe, causes the future states, contradicts the determinism, since under determinism, all future states are contained causally in the initial state, and future states are causally redundant and ineffective. Similarly, saying that the distribution of things at a certain higher layer distinctly and effectively causes things contradicts physicalism and especially reductive physicalism. But the physicalist evolution has to say these things if it explains the origin of species, especially through survival, random mutation. Because it talks about the survival of life forms which has nothing to do with atoms or sub-atomic particles which are always atoms or subatomic particles, and which behave according to their laws which are sufficient to explain their behaviors and the behaviors of the aggregates they constitute. If the reductive aspect of the physicalist evolution is true, then the distribution of life forms in space does not distinctly cause anything, because it is the distribution of atoms (here atoms correspond to ASBEs) which cause things. 
A physicalist evolutionist may say that the �lion� is a name of a specific distribution of atoms in space. But an atom is an atom wherever it is in absolute or relative terms; and it does not evolve. The distribution in space is an effect of the atoms. So, if we explain the lion based on the distribution of the atoms, then through the lion, we will have explained an effect, not an effective thing.  
But this is fallacious, because an effect may be caused by many things, hence, it is ambiguous and taking the effects as the core of evolution, as if they are effective, will be fallacious. As a result, effects do not have any distinct predictive power in the following sense: if I say that the printer printed a certain text, hence the printer will print such things is fallacious; because the printer�s act is not the very cause of the text; the very cause is the author. If I do not recognize the author�s role, then I can say that the printer will print a similar text even if there is no author; or if I do not specify the specific author, I can say that any author will produce that text. However, every author will not produce the same kind of text. So, if I say that the struggle for survival of the lion causes anything, I will not have explained anything if the lion is no more than a distribution of atoms and other particles at the reduction basis.
Does not astrophysics also say that the stars move in a certain way, while what it means in fact is that it is the specific state of atoms and subatomic particles which move that way? Yes, but astrophysics does not reduce some other properties to the spatiotemporal properties. When it says a star, it uses the word �star� as a kind of aggregate of atoms. It does not have something that has a distinct reality in a time bracket like a living organism; it can use the moment, even if there may be periods, the periods are not considered any more than the sum of moments. But evolution claims to explain the species and life forms whose lives are different than aggregates of moments; a life constitutes a whole in a unity and is not separable as moments in a physical event. 
Yet, if evolution says that there is not such a unity and non-separability, then it will have explained something other than a life and a life form; because the very fundamental allegedly separable units it attempts to explain would then be things less than a life form and moments less than a life. Consequently, it would have denied life and life forms which it takes as its main object of study. Hence, it will have contradicted itself.
If tectonics explains some stages in the formation of some parts of earth, it admits that the wholes it takes in their unities are taken as such because of the benefits of classification, but in fact that which it studies is the moments. To give a better idea, it classifies some groups of moments under separate names. But to say the same thing, evolution must reject facts as consciousness, the identity of the agents, the free will power, the reason.
In this context, we may ask: what is that which is 'naturally selected'? Is it the �whole deterministic or indeterministic chain� or ASBEs? If the units of evolution do not have an identity and a unity, then the evolution does not have any effect on survival; just the particles follow their deterministic trajectories.
If that which evolves can be epiphenomenal, then evolution may be working on species, individual beings, their cells� at the same time. But none of them will be evolving. The essential thing it studies is then the ASBEs if it reduces things to them, and the ASBEs are not evolving, they are just being repositioned in space. So, it is not explaining life, but the trajectories of particles like physics does. Physics can be interpreted as reductive or non-reductive, and the reductive one faces the problems explained in part 1.1.2.2.1. Physicalist evolution faces these problems as well. The problems physicalist evolution will face in this respect is bigger, because even though reductive interpretation of physics wrongly reduces things to ASBEs, what it studies is allegedly changes in space, no matter whether the study is about planets, rocks, molecules, atoms, electrons� But the physicalist evolution by being reductive denies the distinctive aspects of life, such as the identity, consciousness, free will power of many life forms.
1.4.2.2.8.5.1.3 Relations Abolished Under the Reductive Aspect of the Physicalist Evolution
And they will say to their skins, "Why have you testified against us?" They will say, "We were made to speak by Allah, who has made everything speak; and He created you the first time, and to Him you are returned. 
(Quran: 41/21)

If there is a relation between different levels such that a thing in a certain level may have at least partial distinct effect on a thing at another level and vice versa, this relation is called holistic relation. Such a relation may also exist between a whole and its parts. If there are holistic relations between two levels, then the related relations among things at the higher level are also holistic relations since the things at the higher level are distinctly effective.
A relation where things at a certain level coincidentally give the impression that they constitute a distinctly effective whole or that they produce a distinctly effective process at a higher level is called illusory relation, because neither that alleged whole, nor that process exist and have any distinct effect: like the running horse in the cloud. If there are illusory relations between two levels then the related relations among things at the higher level are also illusory relations since they are not effective and they depend fully on the lower level things.
So, for example, a sharp stone may hurt a dog, or a radioactive event may cause some mutations which cause cancer and kill a being, or the being may act to prevent certain radioactive events. These may be considered as holistic relations.
On the other hand, the molecules of a cloud may be positioned such that it looks like a running horse. However, the feet of the horse are not distinctly effective on the molecules of the cloud or on where the horse will be going. These are illusory relations.
If physicalist evolution is true, then the only relations may be like those in the horse example above. Because the life forms would be reducible to the atoms and molecules. And not only that, a deeper analysis which relates physicalist evolution to reductive physicalism, will require that even the atoms and molecules would also be reducible to other things. Hence, there would also be the problems with the reductive physicalism explained in the relevant part of this book.
Therefore, the physicalist evolution abolishes the relations necessary to explain the life forms as it also abolishes the distinct reality of that which evolves.
Fodor and others argue that type-type reduction is empirically false based on multiple realizability132.  
However, such an argument is redundant since even if there is no multi-realizability, essentially reduction in biology does not work even if there would not be multi-realizability because the higher level relations are distinctly ineffective and are no more than approximations. Moreover, the higher-level entities are just illusions since there is nothing which unifies the higher (and the lower) level relata since our conception is also allegedly an illusion, hence, there is no realization. So, unlike Fodor's idea there is not even a multiply realized whole at the higher level, none of the different aggregates realizes the higher-level whole because there is no relation between the parts which results in the definition of the higher-level aggregate as a distinct higher-level whole. The parts are just distributed in space such that we have an illusion of a whole at the higher level. So, neither ontological nor epistemic reduction is possible.
Distinct relations at the higher layer cannot be fully explained by distinct relations, processes, and other things at the lower layer -except by coincidence but this is not a true explanation-. Then since the things at the higher layer would be approximations, the higher layer becomes redundant and false, not a true explanation. If the higher and lower layer relations are like a machine and its parts then the parts will explain better. If things and processes at both layers are same the condition of distinctness does not obtain. Furthermore, things or relations like space that explain both higher and lower layer things are higher level things and relations. When the relations that we will see are abolished under physicalist evolution, they become just arbitrary perceptions of the human beings; yet conflicting with this, physicalist evolutionists keep ascribing functions to these relations in shaping the future states of the universe.
Let us see the relations abolished by the physicalist evolution: 
1.4.2.2.8.5.1.3.1 Relations Between Alleged Aggregates and Their Parts
Physicalist evolution reduces for example the relations of human beings such as competing for resources, to the relations between his cells; and it reduces the relations between his cells to the relations between his molecules� 
For example, if the reductive aspect of the physicalist evolution entails that the behavior of a life form like competing for food is reducible to the behavior of its protons, neutrons, and electrons, then how can we relate the behavior of this life form with the behaviors of its organs and its cells? Even if somehow there are some overlapping relations between this whole and its part, as long as the only effective is the behavior of atoms, protons, neutrons�, the relations between the life form and its organs is just a happy coincidence; the latter relations cannot have an explanatory power except as explanations about the positions of the atoms, protons, neutrons and so on of that life form, and they will not be explaining the behavior, survival, or evolution of that life form.
If explanatory and/or ontological reductive aspect of physicalist evolution is true, then the explanations other than those within the ultimate reduction basis layer are ineffective and illusory.
This sub-part underlined the problems between the relations within a layer and the relations within other layers. 
The following sub-part explains the problems about the relations at the life layer and the relations at the ultimate reduction basis. 1.4.2.2.8.5.1.3.2 Relations Between Wholes at the Higher Layers and the Layer of ASBEs
The previous sub-part underlined the flaw about the relations between an aggregate at a certain level and its parts such as atoms, electrons, protons. Physicalist evolution which claims the lack of need for God for the rise of species would explain the rise of life starting from ASBEs. If two replicating circles consisting of clips cannot be defined as distinct things, through any of their inherent distinct properties, then the clips cannot be defined that way either. Because the clips is not fundamentally different than those circles. Evolution denies the distinct reality and effectiveness of the life layer. Then it undermines its reduction basis and does special pleading: if life layer or no property of life layer is distinctly effective, then why would the lower layer be distinctly effective? Hence the same will apply to ASBEs. Therefore if physicalist evolution is just a matter of spatial change, then it collapses because of infinite regress. As long as there are differentations at a higher layer, there are differentiated mechanisms at the lower layers. If one thing goes right and the other goes left, then there will be other causes which explain the difference. Hence there will be infinite regress at all layers, anytime there is complexity.
This point was explained in other related parts.
2. If we predict what will happen at the higher layer by things at the layer of reduction basis, then the explanation by things at the higher layer will be redundant. This point is explained in part 1.4.2.2.8.5.1.2.10.
3. To explain distinct things at the layer of life with the layer of reduction basis, the distinct things at the higher layer must have distinct effects as those claimed by the physicalist evolution, as things at the ASBE layer, but if they do then they must be able to diverge. Hence, there would be contradiction, unless they work as a system. 
4. If we do not have the requirement of distinct effectiveness of things at the higher layer, then there will be the arbitrariness: we can name any apparent formation (like a half dog, a leg shape�) or process at the higher layer arbitrarily at our wish. Hence our claim that there is anything with more than arbitrary naming at the higher layer will be wrong. But if there is something like consciousness or free will at the higher layer that are not predictable by the lower layer, then we can claim that there is a distinctly effective thing at the higher layer. These may arise because of another dimension irreducible to movement. This is against physicalist evolution. And if we reject the reducibility to movement or another single dimension then they will converge to God as the Sustainer of those dimensions; these dimensions cannot be self sufficient since they are many as explained in part 1.2. 
5. If they are accepted to overlap by coincidence, then physicalist evolution will not be able to predict the higher layer based on the lower layer hence physicalist evolution will not be scientific and moreover its reductive aspect and its consistency will collapse. This point was explained in previous parts, especially under scenario 2 in part 1.4.2.2.8.5.1.1.
6. Things at the reduction basis layer cannot have structures to produce distinct things at the higher layer like clips cannot come together to form a true circle at the higher layer. Because to do it they must be two dimensional or they must have a structure other than that of clips. We cannot build a ship by using just abstract numbers. Plus an ASBE does not contain the unity of the coordinate systems which are necessary for the definition and for the existence of the things at the higher layer. For example lower layer things do not have and do not produce nor sustain space and time. 1.4.2.2.8.5.1.3.3 Relations Between Wholes at the Same Level and Same Time Interval
The previous parts examined the relations between things at a certain layer/ level and things at the other layers. Obviously if the relations at the level of sub-atomic particles such as protons, neutrons, and electrons are sufficient to explain what the state of the universe at a time in the future will be, then the relations defined at the level of the human beings or life forms will be redundant and ineffective. Likewise, the relations defined at the level of molecules become similarly redundant.  Hence, the reductive aspect of the physicalist evolution which tries to explain the rise of evolution through natural selection at the level of life forms, and through random mutation at the molecular level, is on the other hand demolishing the relations at those levels. 
When I am driving a car, am I really driving it or is it my cells or my molecules which behave in relations such that I look like driving a car? Since my driving the car or my ability to drive a car are part of my survival activities and natural selection, this question is directly relevant to physicalist evolution. 
When I audit a paper do I do it, do I take note and write something effectively or are my atoms, protons, electrons moving in their trajectories? Do my acts just overlap coincidentally with the behaviors of my atoms? 
If a nation declares war to another nation for having access to greater natural resources in order to survive, is it declaring this war, or are the atoms of the military and political teams of that nation just move within their trajectories? 
If the reductive aspect of the physicalist evolution is true, then there is no reason for overlapping or interaction between the objects and relations between or within different levels/ layers.
A physicalist evolutionist may have concluded �those who ate survived those who have not did not, so we eat�. However, the relation between the survival and eating does not affect how the ASBEs behave, except if we define eating in terms of the trajectories of the ASBEs; but if we define like that, then we recognize the ineffectiveness of the things at the higher levels. The ASBEs behave allegedly in any case according to their trajectories and laws of physics. We may presuppose that higher level wholes and lower-level wholes and their behaviors overlap, although there are numerous things at numerous layers which allegedly overlap. However, there is no reason for this presupposition. Higher layer things and relations will be only approximations by default especially if reduction is true. If we are aggregates, we do not survive by what we do, but by what our constituents do.
Since the distinct effectiveness of the higher-level things are rejected, then there is no reason for any interaction or overlapping between the things at different layers except through coincidence, and the coincidence is not an effective thing but only a random result of the effective things.
Obviously, the reductive aspect of the physicalist evolution not only abolishes many distinctly effective dynamics at many levels, but it also undermines many related sciences such as political science, psychology, sociology. This way, the physicalist evolution also undermines its foundational relations at the level of life forms.
1.4.2.2.8.5.1.3.4 Relations Between Wholes in Different Time Intervals/ Generations
In the previous sub-parts we saw the vertical relations between different layers mostly as constituents of wholes/ aggregates and their implications regarding physicalist evolution.
A key focus of physicalist evolution is about the ancestral relations between generations, species, and life forms, in terms of macro evolution and micro evolution.
However, if we reduce the life layer to things such as molecules and atoms, then the relations between species, generations will be no more than epiphenomenal. So, if a physicalist evolutionist says that the bears evolved into whales, actually this evolution would be no more than an epiphenomenal reflection of the underlying trajectories of the atoms or waves or ASBEs. The bear and the whale would be no more than the shape of a horse that we perceive temporarily in the clouds. Hence, mechanisms like adaptation, variation, selection would be just epiphenomenal and distinctly ineffective events or processes which give us only some limited idea about the spatiotemporal trajectories and behaviors of underlying particles, waves, fields, or ASBEs. Similarly, neither a generation, nor a species, nor a life form would be distinctly real and effective; they would just be a mere perception or illusion experienced and named by human beings from a random angle which has no practical value. 
Let us give a few examples: 
If we say that the evolution is the change in the allele frequency of a population, what do we exactly mean? Let us say that there is generation 1 and the generation n. And the frequency in generation 1 was x, and then the frequency in the generation n became y. x for generation 1 has not changed, and y for generation 2 has not changed. The change is between generation 1 and generation 2. If we take the whole of the population, then the whole population consists of two parts each of which has its specific allele frequency. So we went from x in generation 1 to y in generation 2. Here we transcendentally differentiate between the two generations. But if the generations are reducible to their particles, what justifies our differentiation and groupings between the two generations? If the reductive aspect of the physicalist evolution is true, then is not it just the trajectories of the parts of  each generation which change their positions in spatial distributions? 
If a building was destroyed in an earthquake what is that was destroyed? If its parts� positions changed, they change all the time. So, was there no specific event related to the building?
If things at the life layer are reducible to a fundamental layer, then only the relations between life spans or processes at that reduction basis layer may be sequentially related. Sequential relations between things at the life layer will be epiphenomenal if physicalist evolution is true. 
1.4.2.2.8.5.1.3.5 Sequential Relations Between Non-Life and Life
In this part, we will see the problems that the physicalist evolution faces with respect to the transition from the non-life to life. What is the starting point of evolution? What is the threshold where we get something which starts evolving such that its more evolved forms will have properties like consciousness, free will, knowledge?
If there is such a threshold, then what makes the entity which may evolve able to evolve? What are the properties it acquired that enable it to evolve? What is the relation between the entity, the whole or the aggregate that is able to evolve, with its parts just before that aggregate has formed? Where did the ability to evolve and related abilities came from?
If there is no such threshold, then is evolution just how the movements of atoms are seen from a different perspective; then is evolution just the study of atoms in a different scale as the study of plate tectonics? 
This part confirms from another angle that the physicalist evolution abolishes the relations at the life layer and cannot make use of them in explaining the rise of new species. It does not and cannot explain and cannot incorporate in its definition the relations at the life layer. If the physicalist evolution cannot establish a threshold starting from which we have new relations not found in the chemical world, then it cannot make use of them. 
1. The problem of Threshold Between Non-Life and Life and Related Arbitrariness
General understanding is that evolution starts from the first cell. The trees of life according to physicalist evolution are generally built starting from a first cell aka last universal common ancestor (LUCA).  
However, the more complex is the first cell or the first life form as the starting unit of evolution, the less likely is the probability of its formation and the less likely is its survival. Therefore, it is not plausible in a physicalist evolutionist approach to start the evolution from a single cell. 
Therefore, some claim that evolution starts even before the formation of a cell; so there are proposals like the chemical evolution or the RNA world hypothesis. However, if physicalist evolution explains the rise of different species through random mutations, and the molecular and atomic relations, and if it claims that the life relations are reducible to the molecular and atomic relations, then what might be the justification for starting the physicalist evolution from a first cell, or an RNA, or any stage or point within the spectrum of physical stages or entities? What would be the threshold, the boundary starting from which we would say we have the physicalist evolution? If evolution is reducible to the behavior of atoms, molecules, or sub-atomic particles, then would not it be arbitrary to claim that from a specific point the evolution starts?
A physicalist evolutionist might say: The physicalist evolution starts with replication, because we need an increase in the number of organized aggregates that increase in number and in this increase, there would be variations within the aggregates, and some of the differentiated aggregates will randomly have superior or different properties, hence the aggregates with such properties that will give it a survival advantage will be more and more in number in the course of time, hence there will be an evolution of aggregates.
Let us take as an overly simplified hypothetical example of RNA in the early earth: Let us assume that when 4 nucleotides come together, they constitute an RNA which has some stability and when 4 corresponding nucleotides bind to it one after another, these new set of 4 nucleotides separate more easily to form another corresponding RNA. In this case, the RNAs with 4 nucleotides will be more in number and we may assume that they may break the RNAs with 3 nucleotides such that the RNAs with 4 nucleotides reproduce more and more.
Note that here whether we will have RNAs with 4 nucleotides or 3 nucleotides depend entirely upon the properties of the atoms which constitute the nucleotides. The atoms might be such that only two nucleotides may bind to each other at most, or they might be such that no nucleotides can bind one to another.
Hence, what we call evolution here will be only the specific distribution of the atoms and how they are initially directed and structured.
So, starting evolution from the RNAs will make it clear that evolution is no more than the study of how atoms behave.
Moreover, if the primitive life forms arise through the play of atoms, then we directly relate the life forms to the formation and properties of atoms. Then we must consider the direct relation between the properties of atoms and how they arose with the rise of life. Hence, the cause of the life directly becomes the cause of the atoms whereby the arbitrary distance between the life forms and the atoms is eliminated. Furthermore, the randomness that is used as a barrier and link between the atom and life forms also becomes eliminated since the structure of the atom is directly related to whether we can have life and what kind of life forms or species we may have. 
If there is no threshold that justifies the recognition of a process fundamentally different in kind than the processes prior to it, then what we consider as life or death or survival or constituents of life like life forms or species are no more than certain stages within the trajectories of particles or smaller constituents of matter.
Again, if the evolution is reductive, and if it makes use of chemical evolution or RNA world hypothesis and claims that the evolution is also applicable at the chemistry level, then it must be defined such that the properties of chemical entities are sufficient in the definition of the physicalist evolution. Hence, it cannot make use of relations such as survival, struggle for life, extinction. The details of the implications of such properties found in advanced life forms are explained in the following parts.
What is the physical and other boundaries of that which evolves? If there are no such boundaries, then what enables us to distinguish between newer species and older ones? If even the start of life cannot be identified, how is it reasonable to classify new species and older ones? Is it just an arbitrary classification, which is actually an identification of the trajectories of ASBEs? Regarding the distinction between that which evolves and that which does not evolve: what makes that which evolves evolve? What makes that which does not evolve not evolve? 
If a rock or aggregate of earth evolves and the other does not, why would we start it at the point they are rocks or aggregates of earth? Why not before when for instance they were just gas in the space? Does our subjective perceptions about any thresholds justify a clear distinction, especially if our perceptions are reducible to the interactions of particles colliding with each other?
If one aggregate of atoms behaves differently by displaying compliance with evolutionary processes, than another one, we can say that one of them evolves and the other does not. But if each atom in both aggregates behave the same way according its properties, since they constitute nothing more than just aggregates of particles according to the physicalist evolution, then we cannot say that. If an aggregate of particles evolves and the other does not, then why would not we start at the point we have these distinct aggregates? What evolved into these two distinct aggregates? If each atom in both aggregates behave the way it has to, then why would we ascribe evolution to the one and not the other? Why would we say one has evolved and the other has not, although all particles within both aggregates behaved the same way but one resulted let us say in an RNA or cell? If the answer is the special distribution of the particles of one aggregate within the space, is not this arbitrary depending on our personal subjective perspective? Yet, if we claim that a totally distinct thing arose, what is the threshold and benchmark to distinguish between the two aggregates? If there is a clear and effective distinction, does not this undermine the reductive aspect of physicalist evolution? If there is no clear threshold and distinction, then starting to use properties like fitness, struggle, survival, extinction beyond a certain point becomes inconsistent. An objection to this based on emergentism will be of no use since recognizing emergent properties will entail in similar flaws of ambiguity, arbitrariness, explanatory gaps, causal and sequential thresholds.
Let us note some popular points about the abiogenesis using some simplification: if a replicating RNA with two nucleotides can form, then a second RNA may also form independently from a replicating first RNA, if the first RNA may form on its own. Then in principle the magic is relocated to the basic elements of the RNA, hence the RNA becomes just an aggregate and non-special and non-distinct. If the first RNA can arise without evolution, then a second RNA may also arise without evolution, then it is the elements of RNA which are effective and replication is not effective or special. The atoms become already brilliant structures that may cause those replications, but then the question will arise about the atoms brilliance. If RNA is considered as part of life like this, then a life form may arise through replication or without replication just like the first RNA arose, therefore the distinctly effective is the basic elements (ASBEs) of RNA. Then the first RNA is not NECESSARY distinctly from its components, for the rise of species, hence the species arise just because of the properties and behaviors of ASBEs. Hence they arise totally randomly, not through random mutations which are combination of replication and randomness. Hence species are allegedly just distributions of ASBEs and just the movements and changes in spatial distributions of ASBEs. Hence species are like horses and their movements in the clouds. Then the first types of RNAs arise outside of replication hence mutation. Therefore in principle the mechanisms of evolution are not necessary elements of complex biological systems. Hence they are redundant. Hence the necessary elements are the things at the reduction basis.
If the first cell or RNA can form on its own / outside of physicalist evolution processes, then there is no distinct contribution of physicalist evolution to the rise of at least some life forms/ protocells/ complex RNAs if evolution starts before cells. Hence basics (necessary elements) of species resides in ASBEs and if there are additional aspects of physicalist evolution then these aspects are redundant hence this complies with the reductive aspect of physicalist evolution. However, if there is a transition from protolife to life with the addition of certain specific features, then the source of those features needs to be explained. Or, if there is an infinitesimally gradual transition, then how the life is different than the previous state needs to be explained; if not, then this will confirm the horse in the clouds framework for what is explained by the physicalist evolution.
Since physicalist evolution does not recognize a source other than the reduction basis, then there may be no source to create new species and life forms. Therefore, the matter which existed and behaved prior to the existence of the life forms and life-related things, is the only thing that will continue to act while we start to observe life. Hence, for physicalist evolution, there can be no relation between material relations, prolife, and life: in terms of sequential relations, the matter continues its existence and actions.
2. The problem of the Transition From Chemical Properties to Properties Like Consciousness
Other parts of this book emphasize the structural problem of having certain properties seen in certain life forms such consciousness and free will: for example how can our brains consisting of particles may underlie our unitary consciousness? The issue of abiogenesis confirm this problem from a different perspective: if the universe consisted at one time of colliding particles, then how did it transition from those particles to life forms that have properties like consciousness and free will -at least some of them supposing that not all of them have those properties-?
If abiogenesis would be part of physicalist evolution, then there would be no transition point or threshold from non-life to life, and physicalist evolution would be simply physics, hence, there would be either a denial of properties of life like consciousness, free will,� or physics would intrinsically have those properties. But since this would necessitate the recognition of these properties as fundamental properties of the existence, hence would naturally lead to the God133, the physicalist evolutionist who wants to explain the life forms with the matter alone, needs to reject that abiogenesis is part of physicalist evolution. 
This transition can be easily done but it is not done. Because if it is done, then evolutionary study will be like chemistry, hence, it will be far away from addressing the irreducible aspects of life, because it will be recognized like chemistry and tectonics that it is a sub-branch of physics just from another perspective and be deprived from its mission of explaining the irreducible properties of life, or these properties will need to be included within the physics. Hence, it is presented as an explanation for new species, not for life. But as a secondary problem, the atheist uses it as if it explains life.
Hence, generally the physicalist evolutionist tries to strongly separate the abiogenesis from evolution. 
3. Confirmation of the Distinct Ineffectiveness of Physicalist Evolutionary Processes
There is nothing within the stage where the life has started with its distinct properties, which can be 'related' to what was before the life started if physicalist evolution is true. There is allegedly always only that which existed before life or evolution started. If this relation cannot be established, then the start of physicalist evolution cannot be explained except as a random event accompanied with the magical physical words �emergence� or �emergent properties�. Plus if there is nothing additional after physicalist evolution started, then physicalist evolution is nothing more than what was before, and this confirms the abolishment of relations such as survival, natural selection that physicalist evolution necessarily uses. For example there is nothing naturally selected since it is just the particles well below the level of selection which follow their trajectories and keep always bumping upon other particles, hence natural selection is fully ineffective as a distinct process; what we see as natural selection is just a view of the underlying physical movements no matter whether there is natural selection or not.
4. Redundancy of Physicalist Evolutionary Processes as a Necessary Cause for Different life Forms, Because of the Possibility of Multiple Sets of First Cells or Protocells or RNAs. 
If the physicalist evolution starts from the RNAs, then obviously there will be many RNAs which are at the root of evolution hence tree of life. Why would evolution start from a single RNA if there might be numerous nucleotides? If we want to start from a minimum number of nucleotides, obviously one nucleotide cannot constitute an RNA which can be considered as the starting of life. Or if we assume that only three nucleotides can be considered as an RNA, then the question would be why there would be only three nucleotides at the beginning and why not more nucleotides in numerous places.
However, if we recognize the possibility of the formation of numerous RNAs in numerous places, and that evolution is defined like that at the level of RNAs, then evolution would be starting in many locations and instances. In this case, evolution becomes a non-necessary cause of different primitive life forms (of RNAs), since, different life forms may arise in multiple locations independently from each other. Then evolution becomes �one� of the many ways in which different life forms and traits may arise.
Plus, if life forms do not need to necessarily arise from a previous life form, and if the emphasis is given to the atoms, then there remains no reason to claim that different life forms may arise only gradually, since the primitive life forms arise abruptly. Because if the atoms and their properties are what enable the formation of life forms, and if the main process is randomness -though note that the structures of atoms are closely related to what arises and that randomness is often considered as purposelessness with respect to physicalist evolution-, then why would randomness be distributed through hundreds of millions of years? If a lion arose through numerous random lucky events through millions of years, why would not it arise through a single or a few random lucky events as long as we have the necessary and sufficient atoms? A physicalist evolutionist might argue that natural selection also takes part in physicalist evolution. However, natural selection does not explain why new traits arise, it only explains why the life forms with little survival advantage disappear; it only has a function of saving the fit by isolating the successful changes from mixing with the unfit through the elimination of the unfit.
If the first complex structures may arise without evolution thanks to the sophistication of the atoms or ASBEs, then later new species may also arise that way, as similar things arose without random mutation and natural selection or other elements of physicalist evolution. Does the physicalist evolution entail that all life forms necessarily arise through evolution, like saying all masses are subject to gravity? Or does it entail that it is one of the many processes through which some life forms may arise? Or does it entail that some first life forms like cells may arise in a single step without having evolved? Is it such that some changes may happen in leaps and not gradually? If in single step there are first cells or changes in leaps, then how big would be the leap, then again how complex would be the first life forms? After all, if a complex system arose while there was no such system and in the absence of replicating systems and natural selection and other mechanisms, then we can expect that after we have such a system, we would not be surprized to see creative changes without those allegedly physicalist evolutionary tools. Above, it is shown that there is no basis to claim that evolution is the only way for the rise of life forms. If separate rise of first life forms and leaps happen, then are they happening deterministically or randomly like in Copenhagen interpretation of uncertainty? If physicalist evolution is not the only way for the rise of life forms, then what is the evidence that it happened as opposed to the alternatives? Is one of the alternatives the creation by God outside of evolution? Is the physicalist evolution such that life forms 'arose' through physicalist evolution or such that life forms 'may have arisen' through physicalist evolution, or such that life forms 'may have partially arisen through physicalist evolution'?
The abiogenesis demonstrates that the physicalist evolution is not the only way through which complex life forms may arise; even if there is not a complex replication system, it is also possible that such systems may arise. The infrastructure for such systems is already in place.
If random mutations cause many new traits, why would not randomness cause numerous first cells and initial life forms? If through billions or hundreds of millions of years new traits might arise, then through those years new life forms without physicalist evolution might also arise.
If physicalist evolution concedes that it is not the only way for the rise of new species, then it should also concede that within the rise of new species that look like evolutionary ones, it is possible that processes other than those owned by physicalist evolution are active. 
1.4.2.2.8.5.1.3.6 Top-Down Distinct Causal Relations 
There are not only relations between things at the reduction basis level as entailed by the reductive aspect of the physicalist evolution, but also there are top-down relations. In this respect, physicalist evolution conflicts with the events where there are lots top-down relations: for example, we human beings design machines and benefit from them; or through medical practices and means we can improve the functioning of our bodies.
1. FWP and Other Top-Down Causal Relations
If we use our free will power upon our bodies, this means that the sub-systems of our bodies are not fully reducible to the ASBEs. Because our wholes influence our sub-systems. If the sub-systems were fully dependent upon the ASBEs, then we would not be able to influence our bodies. This means that the molecules and atoms are also influenced by our free will power. For example, we can remove an object from our bodies, or change the chemical composition of our body by using some medicine, or we can enhance the mechanisms of our body by eating high quality food in appropriate measures. Likewise we can also influence external objects through our free will power: we can ignite a nuclear bomb which may displace big objects. Hence, no object is necessarily fully dependent upon ASBEs. Since we are very similar to other animals, this shows that many animals may also exercise free will power. On the other hand, we can build using our free will power machines which may run in our absence as well. So if the machine is not fully dependent upon the ASBE, this means that the machine can in principle influence the ASBEs: in fact the ASBEs� movements also depend on how the ASBEs are distributed in space. Hence, we cannot say that there is only bottom-up causal relations.
2. An ASBE is not Defined Only Internally; it is Also Necessarily Defined Externally. Therefore, Higher Wholes Than Itself Have Influence on the ASBE.
Can the ASBE be forming and driving its constituents? An ASBE is not defined only internally; it is also necessarily defined externally. For example, if they are distributed in space in a contingent manner, there are necessarily spatial relations that extend beyond an ASBE. Therefore, wholes higher than itself have or may have influence on the ASBE. So, that the human being has influence on the ASBE is not an exceptional thing. It is not a matter of reducibility to the simpler, it is a matter of design and transcendence whereby things are defined and structured based on not only the smaller, but also on the bigger. Hence there is a power that defines not only the smaller but also the bigger.
If the ASBE is sophisticated, then we will have a key question on why it is that way. Again, the ASBE will raise other problems explained in part 1.1.2.2.6, so physicalist evolution fails. -But even without the ASBE problems in that part, it will be impossible to constitute a life form by using a structured ASBE for the other reasons. And it is logically and empirically impossible to have the allegedly distinctly effective elements of physicalist evolution consistently with its reductive aspect. On the other hand, any randomness will result in only approximations, which again will not be distinctly effective.
If an ASBE has a high degree of sophistication then it is not different than a higher level sophisticated entity. As an ASBE cannot be explained by lower level, the higher level thing cannot be explained by lower level thing either. If reductive aspect of the physicalist evolution is true, then the higher level whole (like an ASBE in this context) is as explanatory as its lower level constituent.
There are differentiations in ASBE since for example it connects to certain things certain times and does not connect some other times. So it must have constituents that have relations. It must have regions which are a certain way and regions which are not. Also, the ASBEs are also in relation with other ASBEs, so the same nonseparability also exists between ASBEs. If the relation between ASBE and its parts are like this, then the relation between ASBE, other ASBEs, and higher layer things must also be like this. Because the nature of the ASBE and its constituents are related to the constituents of other ASBEs, therefore, if physicalist evolution is true, then ASBEs cannot have any distinct effectiveness in and of themselves, but their constituents have, but then their constituents would be ASBEs; consequently, all is sustained, and not self-sufficient; consequenntly the reductive aspect of physicalist evolution which tries to build the complex upon the simple is invalidated. 
3. Probabilities is one Tool but not a Substitute for Top-Down Transcendent Causal Relations. 
If there are no higher level things which bind the lower level things then there is a need for higher degree coincidence being actualized even if we assume that probabilities work. But if higher level things bind and guide lower level things, then there is no need for lucky coincidence. On the other hand, even for the probabilities to work, we need a transcendent unifier and sustainer.
To debunk evolution, the apologetics of some religions emphasize the low probability of complex life-related systems. According to contemporary mainstream Christians god can die and while he is dead (or while a part or person of god is dead) the universe may continue to exist and function. According to them, if material or matter-like body of God may exist self-sufficiently, why would not the material substance of things exist by default? Hence they look as if they do not see a fundamental problem with physicalist evolution but only a problem as it relates to complexity and probabilities. The abolishment of the relata and transcendent power at the higher layers by the physicalist evolution aggravates the problem of low probabilities; because in that case, there is no foundation to work on probabilities ontologically and epistemologically.
This point is further detailed in parts 1.4.2.1.1.4.2.1.4 and 1.4.2.2.8.5.1.9.
1.4.2.2.8.5.1.3.7 Relations Between the Complex and the Simple
According to physicalist evolution, there can be no rule as: things at the higher layer must or can be explained by simpler things and processes at the lower layer. Because such a postulate encompasses all layers and can not be limited to the layer of the reduction basis. Things at a certain layer can be explained by more complex things at the higher or lower layer: for example, a group of students who simulate the behavior of flowers by their movements can transcend in their understanding the whole of the behaviors of those flowers and they can cause the spatiotemporal acts. So life forms are not necessarily always explainable by simpler things.
If I explain by mutation actually 'what' a �specific mutation� is, what I explain is essentially how the atoms behave. If physicalist evolution is true, then there is no specific and distinctly effective universal as mutation. If I call a specific behavior of specific atoms as mutation encompassed by those specific atoms, then it is as if each atom is a computer which is the real effective thing and which incorporates and embodies the higher level behaviors. But then we are defining each atom by mutation such that it requires that the atom transcends what is above itself, we are not defining a mutation or a life form; and this is against the reductive aspect of physicalist evolution that tries to explain the complex with the simple.
1.4.2.2.8.5.1.3.8 Relations Between Different Species and Life Forms
Physicalist evolution tries to explain the transitional life forms to demonstrate that there is gradual change between species. However, if its reductive aspect is true, then those relations become ineffective. Hence, life forms like tiktaalik become useless as explanations. Likewise, the relations between life forms or different genders of life forms become also useless since the effective relations would be between the ASBEs.
Further details of this point can be found in part 1.4.2.2.8.5.1.1, especially under the scenario 2.
1.4.2.2.8.5.1.3.9 Overall Spatial and Temporal Relations 
That the circle formed by the clips is reducible to the clips fails because even though we may assume that each clip has its spacetime, there is also the necessity that they are unified within the same spacetime or related coordinate system where each clip's spatiotemporal unit is comparable and summable. Certain properties are not necessarily addable. In this context physicalist evolution presupposes that there is only one spacetime. But even we grant that we can reduce certain aspects of the circle to the clips, each clip would be defined by its own spacetime. Therefore, it would not be possible to unify and relate one to another in terms of spatiotemporal relationships. Hence, it is necessary that there is an irreducible spatiotemporal whole that they constitute in any case. This invalidates the reductive aspect of the physicalist evolution.
1.4.2.2.8.5.1.4 Properties Related to Life are Abolished Under Physicalist Evolution: And Things Like Consciousness Show That Some Wholes Must be Irreducible.
Instead of predicting the future determining the past may be better to understand the parallel processes of physicalist evolution and other processes. Because the future is more ambiguous and random: the wolf evolving into a specific dog is a speculation; but if we have that dog and then the heat death of the universe, then by reversing we can say that it will rebuild that dog and than that wolf without speculation, if determinism is true. But since �now� is witnessed, we can project better to the past if determinism and reductionism of physicalist evolution is true. It is generally accepted that in a reversal of time, the laws of physics at the bottom would work perfectly in the opposite direction. So, if we know the present state of the universe, we can determine the state of one second before, without observing any distinct effects of the thought processes of the human being, wherein only the particles bumping one onto other according to the laws of physics are observed to be distinctly effective. Likewise we can also do it without considering the wholes, that is we can do it by considering only the trajectories of ASBEs/ atoms subatomic particles. If we can determine the past like this, then we can also determine the future like this. Hence the explanations of the physicalist evolution can have no effect on what happens if it is true. 
If physicalist evolution is true, then for example, the wires of a garden do not happen because of human beings� design, but because of the multitude of particles, their trajectories, and special positions at the big bang. If a human brain would not be existing, then maybe the wires would not be existing; but this would not be because the human brain had a distinct effect, but because the particles in that human brain would not be existing so as to make the other particles move in a causal chain between particles until the wires are where they are -this is supposing that the ASBEs do not have their inherent problems explained in the related parts-. If and only if the ASBEs are appropriately structured and sophisticated, we can say that without the human brain, the wires can be arranged as we see it. But if the ASBEs are sophisticated, then the reductive aspect of physicalist evolution becomes false, since they will have constituents more fundamental than themselves. If the ASBEs are fully simple and behave fully randomly, then the connection between the causal aspects of the brain and of the ASBEs would be vague and the wires might happen as approximations no matter whether there is the brain or not. So, we have to clarify whether we are talking of (1) a physicalist evolution where the ASBEs are sophisticated and connected causally structurally to the higher layers or of (2) a physicalist evolution where processes and aggregates at the higher layers appear randomly and coincide with the structures of wholes. In (1), reductive aspect of physicalist evolution collapses, since at the bottom there are wholes which are sophisticated where physicalist evolution is confronted with infinite regress and other related problems. In (2) the explanatory aspect of the physicalist evolution based on its key elements such as random mutation and natural selection and neutral mutation collapses; plus in any case simplest ASBEs are sophisticated.
The past oriented flow of events is exactly like the future oriented flow. It depends on the positions of ASBEs at any time and their trajectories. Hence the baby going back into the womb of mother, the sperm back into father would be happening equally likely as the opposite flow. If ASBEs' trajectories are the only distinctly effective, this is normal. So, by chance we are in a universe where exactly all happens perfectly. But the anthropic principle does not apply in this case. Because in this case, there would be infinite universes where humanity exists entirely, and universes where infinitely many outliers also exist: if the ASBEs follow their trajectories according to laws and their relatively initial positions, then in some instances they may look like perfect animals that eat, in some instances, they may look like 99% of an animal or half of an animal while the same happens to the human beings as well where some of them would be conscious.  Since the life relations are not distinctly effective at all, this would be expected.
In the above framework entailed by physicalist evolution, life forms� properties like free will power, design power, consciousness, morals, knowledge, pain and pleasure, our concepts and activities related to purpose, economics, psychology, sociology, family, politics, art, love lose their distinct effectiveness.  They all become just epiphenomenal, illusory, and reducible to and supervenient upon the behaviors of fundamental particles, fields, and/or waves.
What is that which evolves? If it is just the spatial positions, then evolution is only describing spatiotemporal change. If it describes only this change, and if this description is sufficient as an explanation, then the only explanatory things are the ASBEs, their initial states, and spacetime. Therefore, the new things, their survival or selection, their features like consciousness, reasoning, values, knowledge, ought to be truths are only epiphenomenal, in other words, illusory, and not distinctly effective. 
If reasoning is also like this, then it is arbitrary. But if it is arbitrary, we should not and cannot have or we are not having a pursuit of truth. But if I wrote this book and you read this book, both of us ascribe some truth value to some things. If we admit truth value and our ability to access the truth, then we recognize that things are not reducible to ASBEs; if they are not reducible to them, then the physicalist evolution which reduces us to ASBEs is false. In other words, if new and distinctly effective powers which are not reducible to ASBEs really exist, then there are sources other than ASBEs and their features.
If physicalist evolution by its definition describes spatial distribution, then it must explain the physical before evolution as well. And if it rejects that life has fundamentally additional properties on top of the spatial, then it must be explaining only the spatial distribution by the use of spatial distribution. By contrast, explaining and recognizing whole-to-whole relations recognizes at the beginning the transcendent and irreducible sustaining cause of the limited universe.
If we come back to the definition of evolution as the descent with modification, then we need to ask whose descent and whose modification it is? If it is the descent and modification of species and their members, then the evolutionist must use a definition of evolution based on consciousness, identity, and other transcendent unitary and distinctive properties of the "things that evolve", but for reasons explained in this book, the physicalist evolutionist has to recognize that those properties are ineffective and illusory, hence cannot be used as real things. Then a physicalist evolution becomes logically contradictory and incomplete.
Consciousness combined with free will power debunks physicalist evolution. Because with them there are new wholes, new boundaries, new actors, and new causal effects that cannot be within the ASBEs and their initial state. If a living being behaves as a multipotential cause irreducible to atoms and other particles, then there is a source other than these particles. Hence their physicalist evolution cannot produce these new actors. Emergence cannot be used to explain evolution. Because if the spatiotemporal elements are sufficient to explain all events, then there is no need for another type of cause; additionally, in such a case another type of cause would be impossible, since otherwise, it would be impossible that such numerous causes of different types at numerous layers would overlap. We should also note that an explanation based on emergentism and emergent properties is equal to non-explanation since using them we can also explain the dance of two mugs if they start dancing when brought together, without any need for further explanation and research.
On the other hand, physicalist evolution necessitates the existence of ASBEs. But ASBEs are impossible as explained in part 1.1.2.2.6.
A chemist does not need to clearly deny some things that he observes. When he says �if a carbon atom binds with oxygen atoms in a specific way, we will have carbon dioxide�,  there is nothing new, and when those atoms got separated, there is nothing that disappears. However, the physicalist evolutionist uses concepts like �survival�, �selection�, �life�, �non-life��, and hence, he reduces �knowledge�, �reason�, �free will�, �joy�, �pain�, �consciousness� �morals� to ASBEs. Therefore, he renders all of these properties, states, and powers ineffective, epiphenomenal, and illusory. And not only that, consequently, he also reduces the economics, art, finance, money, value� to ASBEs and ASBEs� behaviors. 
But, while a reductive physicalism, determinism, holism, and versions of emergentism are considered to be a world view and not a scientific theory, physicalist evolution theory is presented and considered by many to be a scientific theory. The transition from non-life to life hence to human beings without granting the fundamental reality of the irreducible facts related to human beings makes evolution theory a tool to propagate a world view under the disguise of science and scientific theory. While the world views are debated and not shielded by �science� and represented as �science�, the physicalist evolution theory is shielded by and represented as science and put in the science books.
Can we say �the physicalist evolution theory explains only the life forms as spatial distribution of their molecules, atoms and sub-atomic particles, but is indifferent and does not say anything about art, knowledge, free will, consciousness�; hence a person who accepts it, may still believe in the effectiveness of knowledge, reason, free will power��? We cannot say that, because if we accept the effectiveness of knowledge, free will, consciousness, then physicalist evolution theory will be partial and undermined since in this case, the future species, at least those that relate to human beings, will not be only the outcome of molecules, atoms and sub-atomic particles but also will be sustained by a source of knowledge, free will power, reasoning power; hence, the claim of physicalist evolution theory to explain things based on the spatiotemporal entities and relations will be invalidated. Furthermore, as physicalist evolution is presented as an argument against God, it is necessarily presupposing that free will power, art, knowledge cannot originate from a transcendent realm of God.
Physicalist evolution does not only contradict the facts directly related to its elements, but also it contradicts our obvious and immediate observations.
Random mutation makes morals unbased. Because, then the oughts, well-being, structure of human beings would just be random. Morals would be just built upon the random, subjective, and superficial emotions. In other words, they all might be equally otherwise. A human being would have no value, since it might equally not exist, there is no intention to make it exist, hence if he is killed, this negates nothing more fundamental than the act of the killer. There is no power who can correct any �wrong�, hence there is no �wrong�. Some physicalist evolutionists reject the word random, emphasizing natural selection which produces the idea of some kind of optimal or ought to be state. But then even if the process of natural selection would not allegedly have randomness, the initial state of the universe would be random. And in any case the conditions that affect natural selection could be otherwise since allegedly there is no purposeful higher goal or truth behind it. Yet, we observe at least regarding ourselves, that there is �ought to be states� and there is �value�. 
If we take the holistic aspects of space and time, then we can consider the aggregates also as sovereign wholes. If so, then spatial stability in an aggregate is a new thing each moment.
