1.4.2.2.8.5.1.4.4 Unified Nature of Life Forms� Irreducible Properties
Let us take the example of consciousness and free will: The agent as a life form, has an irreducible property of consciousness; this property is not separable between the particles of the brain. The same applies to his free will and other properties as well. On top of this non-separability within each property, all those properties are also strongly unified: For example the agent who is conscious is also the agent who exercises his free will. Hence, we cannot say that consciousness is instantiated within a sector of an ASBE, while free will is instantiated within another sector of that ASBE, and related ASBEs. Therefore, we cannot say that consciousness is reducible to that part of those particles, and free will is reducible to that other part of those particles. The same is applicable for the other irreducible properties of life forms.
Again, that we combine the free will power, consciousness, reasoning and other irreducible properties with the intermediary systems in the brain, cell, and nervous systems shows that none of them is reducible to the alleged bottom sophisticated layers. If there was separability between the intermediary layers, again the unity of the agent could not obtain.
On the other hand, if the ASBEs were intelligent as in a students example where they constitute evolving flowers, there would not be physicalist evolution because then the ASBEs would not be simple. Hence, complexity from simplicity would collapse as a principle.
1.4.2.2.8.5.1.4.5 Distinctly Effective Properties at the Life Layer Removes the Impossibilities Arising From Physicalist Evolution
The reductive aspect of the physicalist evolution entails that all relations at all layers are squeezed at an ambiguous alleged bottom layer. This also entails that nothing at the higher layers nothing at the life layer and no human beings are distinctly effective. While things at the bottom layer are considered somehow distinctly effective and irreducible at lower layers, they also are supposed to be full of coincidences such that simultaneously at numerous higher layers there are numerous wholes that behave in harmony. 
The unreasonable intralayer overlapping related unlikelihoods examined above, or the unlikelihood of the rise of the allegedly first cell, or the beneficial mutations, or extremely harmonious numerous systems within the numerous regions of life forms make the contemporary paradigm built upon randomness quite unreasonable and unacceptable. The irreducible unitary properties of life forms offers a reasonable paradigm: let us consider a beaver building a dam, or an engineer designing an airplane: If they do not have irreducible designing powers, then we need to accept that the protons, electrons, neutrons and so on in their brains arose randomly through the random unfolding of the random distribution of the matter at or right after the big bang. Even if we set aside the fundamental problems explained above and even if we recognize that a luck may save the day, it is even impossible to calculate the probability of such a lucky coincidence which relates to almost infinitely small probabilities.
There must be some randomness for physicalist evolution because otherwise the necessities at the bottom layer will make the bottom layer patterns necessary, hence, it will be impossible to even have partially evolutionary processes that align with the lower layers; the lower layers will override the higher layers. Then without randomness we will not get the life form layer relations. But on the other hand randomness will need to make us extremely lucky for a reliable overlapping between the life layer and at least some other layers based on which we try and succeed to detect patterns that luckily are useful for us for example in developing useful medicines. So, in one way, intelligence and divine creation even through evolution is much more plausible than supposing such luck.
However, the problem with randomness does not end there: if randomness has a key place like that, then this entails the existence of high contingency; then we need to recognize that things can 'be' or not 'be'. This in turn supports the existence of God, because it demonstrates the contingency and dependency of the limited universe as a whole since infinite regress and circularity are not possible.
If we observe that a painter repairs the paint on a wall, according to physicalist evolution, what happens is that the painter's particles come and move such that the wall's paint is repaired. The particles are the effective things while the painter �looks as if he plans, decides, prefers� things related to his painting. So, are the trajectories of the particles such that they repair the paint on the wall. Is it possible? Which particles? At which layer?
If we should believe that trillions of separate billard balls knew where to go, and could go there, then it is more rational to believe in one Being Who knows all. Moreover that a billiard ball encompasses all other balls, like each other ball does, and that they cooperate is impossible, especially if each appeared equally out of nowhere with no common transcendent origin.
When we say let us move according to these laws of economics we say something we cannot do because the particles rule. So economics should be is a useless practice according to physicalist evolution, or at best, it luckily looks useful. So why do we study it? The structures which study it survive. But if the effective is only the particles which move, then our study is an illusion and epiphenomenal. The precise graphs we draw are just approximations and epiphenomenal. They just overlap with trajectories of particles, like particles of the ink on a graph. But then we recognize that there "is" some thing that overlaps with the trajectories of particles. We have to reject that "thing" as well for being an illusion and epiphenomenal. But we can draw billions of such graphs. Will it be a coincidence that they overlap with random trajectories of particles? Physicalist evolutionist may say that once particles form a structure which produces lines, then from then on, the result is not coincidence. Then we have to recognize that the particles have some transcendence. Because abstract things entail transcendence. The billiard balls as we know them, do not produce transcendence. And without transcendence, the lines would only be approximations and there would not be beings who think they transcend the physical and above approximations. There may also be divergence between layers: a person may want to commit a sexual crime because of biology layer. But at the reason layer he may need to not do it. Should we deny that we have any control upon the temptations arising from the lower modules of our brains? 
If we are just particles, what we conceive of in the unity of our consciousness cannot be united within separate particles each of which receives just a part of what we conceive. If they are each so sophisticated as to contain the contents of our conscious experience in unity, then evolution must recognize that there is an irreducible but transcendent bottom which is so sophisticated but which cannot have evolved, since it is bottom and the permanently and distinctly effective.
If things just come mechanistically from the past, like a round rock that becomes rounder while rolling and that rolls more and does not break because it is round, hence, ineffective and illusory, then an effort to survive is like that. 
If physicalist evolution is used to replace God, then what we observe at the life layer must be of the same quality/ sophistication as the ASBEs, since there will be no source that may add anything on top of the ASBEs and their spatial distributions. If ASBEs are more sophisticated than things at the higher layer, then they will not have explained a key complexity because things at the higher layer will have no additional complexity compared to the ASBEs; the complex-looking distribution of ASBEs will be intrinsic to the ASBEs and the unfolding of their past will be in accordance with their nature allegedly reflected in the laws of physics. If things at higher layers are more complex than and irreducible to ASBEs, then at the higher layers there would be key properties that cannot be explained by lower layers. If they are of the same complexity, then they will not have explained anything by physicalist evolution.
The example of a cloud a part of which looks as if a tiger is eating a gazelle, corresponds to physicalist evolution. The tiger does not have any effect on the gazelle, the effect is by the particles of the cloud; what we perceive as the tiger and the gazelle are just one view of the particles of the cloud or ASBEs which constitute the clouds. The tiger and the gazelle are just our subjective perceptions and a small and ambiguous part of what happens at the layer of the ASBEs. Likewise if the physicalist evolution is considered to study matter and spatial change example, the light sensitive cells do not have effect of or contribution in making the organism to be scared from the predator or  run away from it. Hence, the effect is produced by ASBEs according to their nature. If in that cloud the teeth of the tiger was changing the gazelle, this would correspond to the randomly lucky overlapping of the harmonious position of one ear of the tiger with the position of its other ear. But if through that shape we could predict an event which could not be predicted by a complete knowledge about the particles of the cloud, then we could say that the tiger and gazelle shapes affect what is going on in the universe. Therefore, only in such a multilayered effective structures we could claim a true detectable and measurable, hence God-fashioned evolution. Therefore, the wholes are not defined just based on their positions in space and time, but also throughout their structures and throughout wholes and aggregates at many layers. 
Through a holistic approach and by denying the reductive aspect of the physicalist evolution, we can get rid of all these problems and have a consistent epistemological framework based on an consistent ontological framework based on empirical and logical evidence.
1.4.2.2.8.5.1.5 The Process of Evolution is Ill-Defined and Distinctly Ineffective
If that which evolves is ambiguously defined, then the process of evolution is also ambiguous. If �life� is not defined based on its distinguishing features like consciousness, extension in time, free will power�, in this case it is not defined as a process which explains these distinct aspects of life. And if it is defined with respect to its complexity, reproduction, digestion then why should not we define things that consume energy, that we produce as alive? 
There is no mutation as a distinctly effective thing. There is just the (aggregate of) atoms each of which bind to other atoms and get separated from other atoms under certain circumstances. These atoms sometimes coincidentally come together and give the impression that there is mutation and most of the times they do not come together in that way. Yet the same about mutations is applicable also to atoms hence we need to recognize only electrons and protons and neutrons; and similarly other subatomic particles and layers. So movements and laws of electrons... would be sufficient for the rise of species and there is no need for mutation. If we posit that the specific structures of the ASBEs cause certain structures at the higher layers, and that those structures at the higher layers may be useful in predicting what happens at that layer, those structures at the higher layers are contingent: if the ASBEs had not been positioned the way they did, then there would be no such structures at the higher layer. Likewise, the specific structures of the ASBEs would also be caused coincidentally since there can be no mechanism at the lower layer of ASBEs if they are ASBEs: So, the ambiguous and impossible lowest layer parts of the ASBEs would be causing the higher layer structures.  And like billiard ball horse example if balls (electrons) come together then there is horse if they do not there are not. In this situation the species are not different than a horse species forming in the billiard balls. Then all physicalist evolutionary processes appear randomly. Hence they are not explanatory, their predictions come true just because of luck. But since this is almost impossible physicalist evolutionists use the mechanisms, relations, relata, and properties related to the life layer. But those relations and relata do not have any distinct effectiveness if physicalist evolution is true. So, if the reductive aspect of the physicalist evolution is true, then its tools it uses to explain the rise of species become non-effective distinctly; hence, physicalist evolution becomes non-explanatory.
If we made robots which, based on the conditions of their environment, produced components and mounted them upon themselves to be taller, to be shorter, to consume less energy, to move faster, and which were able to copy themselves, would we say that they evolved, especially if those which are more efficient survived? We would not say that they evolved, because they would be just reorganizing themselves according to what is written in their software. Furthermore, �they� would not be anything additional to their circuits and other components and the software we wrote. The changes would be totally predictable, without any distinct free will power. They would be evolving only as much as their software allowed. The key issue would be their tendency to keep their unity no matter what changes. They would be just adapting to their environment. On the other hand, if we admitted that they evolved, then we would be admitting that evolution of something does not contradict its being fashioned.
If a robot was recoding itself according to the goal of �surviving�, depending upon the changes in the conditions even if the conditions were unpredictable, then would it be evolving? If the goal line in the code had appeared randomly, would it be considered as evolving? No. Because then all the forms it would be taking under different conditions would be the result of that initial code which contained the different conditions and the behaviors against negative conditions. It would have an inherent direction which would be transcending time and space. At the core, the randomness would have happened at the initial state, and from then on, the changes would be based on that transcendent �ought to be� code. 
Furthermore, saying that they would be evolving like life forms, would be reducing life to a spatiotemporal distribution of the particles and it would be considering consciousness, qualia, free will power, extension in spacetime, knowledge, identity, reasoning power as epiphenomenal and unrelated to life. Saying that, would be only a physicalist evolution, which would be rejecting these empirically observed facts. 
There are other problems with the processes of evolution as well: If the aggregates which are not transcendentally connected are defined just with the spatial positions of the ASBEs, then how can we distinguish one aggregate from another and say that one competes or survives as opposed to another? By the parts of an aggregate being stuck to another part of it? However, if we are realistic about it, we should consider that there are relatively big distances even between protons and electrons of each atom. So, it is clear that there are meta-spatial connections between things. 
If our hands are considered as an aggregate, then another ASBE can be bound by coincidence to the hand, or can be separated from it. Do these events add to or reduce from the hand? The hand is not a special sub-aggregate in the first place, each of its ASBEs can be separated any moment or be added at any moment. Defining it as a distinct aggregate is with no basis at all under reductionism, and evolution. 
Under these, we cannot say that our consciousness is a reality which binds the aggregates in space; especially, under physicalist evolution, our consciousness and perception have no implication at all; they are just epiphenomenal, and there is no other perception which may connect the aggregates. Therefore, according to physicalist evolution, only the ASBEs would be effective. Hence, the �hand� being just the spatial positions of the ASBEs, is not effective in that it does not change any ASBE and any other effective and distinguishable whole. So, if evolution is allegedly a part of science, it would not be useful if it was dealing with processes that relate to ineffective aggregates and distributions in space. 
Complexity requires layers of unities. Unities require distinguishability. Positions and spatial relations require a unity of the space. Each position in space (of the ASBEs or alleged distinguishable aggregates) require unities. But under evolution and reductionism, there cannot be distinguishable unities, since no life form can have a distinct identity irreducible to particles. Hence, there are no things which can be said to be evolving. No stability and no location of stability can be claimed.
When we make computers or castles, are they merely the ASBEs scattered at the big bang which are distributed according to the laws related to the scattering for a period of time? Or have they been fashioned and built? Are parts of the banknotes just ASBEs which scattered and got stuck as a consequence of the trajectories of ASBEs which appeared at the big bang? Or have they been invented as tools for exchange and store of value? How are these things different than the things which are claimed to have evolved if physicalist evolution and reductive physicalism are true?
If something allegedly evolves, is it distinctly that which evolves? Or is this evolution something epiphenomenal and supervenient upon its particles which move according to the allegedly fundamental forces of nature? If it is reducible upon such laws, then how is it different than a picture that I make? If it is not different then does my picture also evolve?
If evolution is a mere change in spatial positioning then it does not imply anything against God. In this case also it should be guided by God as explained in the relevant parts.
For the above reasons, physicalist evolution as a process is ill-defined.
1.4.2.2.8.5.1.5.1 According to Physicalist Evolution, There is no True Change or Adaptation.
According to physicalist evolution those who do x survive, and those who do y do not. However, according to the reductive aspect of physicalist evolution, those who do x can do neither x nor y, they do not have the capacity to do either x or y by free will power or truly randomly, hence there is no room and potential in life forms for any change in the future and for adaptation. If they have to do x already, then there is in it and in its future offspring already the requirements for survival. It does not gain anything on top of what its offspring already has. Quantum uncertainty undermines physicalist evolution more than it helps it, because if quantum uncertainty is distinctly effective, then all alleged gains of physicalist evolution will quickly be destroyed due to random events. So, variation and adaptation are not true variation and adaptation but only a comparison of already randomly arising different aggregates. The entire aggregate of the universe has whatever it has as unfolding trajectories. 
Again, if we are reducible to ASBEs, then there cannot be any changes or improvements to life forms. Like the billiard balls, the ASBEs just follow and have to follow their trajectories. There cannot even be other distinct wholes at higher layers with boundaries, which allegedly may be subject to change. There cannot be change at higher layers. There are no wholes and no change, in other words, the trajectories of ASBEs will not change at or for the higher layers. There can be no adaptation. If an approximation of a circle or square has formed randomly we cannot say or predict that it will behave a certain way, because how it behaves depends entirely on the properties and positions of ASBEs, and these and hence the trajectories of ASBEs do not change; they just unfold as they had to unfold since right after the big bang.
1.4.2.2.8.5.1.5.2 If Physicalist Evolution is True, Then Survival Becomes Meaningless.
If we come into existence randomly while we did not exist, saying that if we eat we survive loses its meaning. Because if we can come into existence randomly; survival becomes nonspecial. We can survive randomly, or we may disappear randomly. Plus then survival may also disappear randomly, hence, no reason to survive or make efforts to survive. This overlaps with the ineffectiveness of survival because of reductive aspect of physicalist evolution.
Natural selection is represented by physicalist evolutionist as a key process of physicalist evolution. According to physicalist evolution, the fittest survives: for example, random mutations produce a spectrum of progeny with spectrum of different levels of light sensitive cells; if an organism has more light sensitive cells, then the body lasts longer, because the organism detects a predator and has higher chances of running away from it; and those which have more light sensitive cells will live longer hence reproduce more and those with less light sensitive cells will be eliminated. Consequently, there will be an improvement in life forms. The bodies with more light sensitive cells reproduce more; the bodies with less light sensitive cells will be less able to detect the predators and will be eliminated; hence, there will be more and more efficient organisms, and the probability of bodies with more light sensitive cells increases. However, if a life form has a more light sensitive cell, will it produce an influence for survival? No, because �light sensitive cell� is not a distinctly effective thing, it is also reducible to other things at another layer. If there is no ultimate distinctly effective layer, then what we have is things at different layers where none of them has superiority �nor inferiority�, but that interact with one other and that are equally sustained. ASBE cannot be said to be superior due to its simplicity, since it is not simple. If it was simple, then we could not have the life layers as explained earlier. So physicalist evolution contradicts itself. 
So, let us take a very simplified example, if a generation has through random mutation an offspring of individuals with a distribution of 1, 2, and 3 light sensitive cells, those with 1 and 2 light sensitive cells will not be able to detect the predators well enough and they will be eaten by predators, and only the individuals with 3 light sensitive cells will reproduce; then the next offspring will have individuals with 2, 3, and 4 light sensitive cells from which those with 2 and 3 light sensitive cells will be eaten and those with 4 light sensitive cells will survive. So this way the better properties of the individuals will be inherited by the following generations and different species with different competences will arise. However, if physicalist evolution claims to explain the complex by the simple, it must not stop there: the small fish does not run away from the big fish in order to survive, just the atoms and other particles collide and bond with others, and they look as if there are fish and as if the small one runs away from the other, as if the small fish has a goal to survive and for this runs away, and the big fish has a goal to survive and it targets the small one as a food in order to survive. If physicalist evolution is true, then their particles simply follow their deterministic or indeterministic trajectories since the big bang, and these trajectories sometimes look like a gazelle running from a lion or a tiger, or a tiger targeting a gazelle. Hence, if the physicalist evolution is true, the motivation to survive is just a perception we have which has no effect at all on what happens. Under the reductive paradigm, the four fundamental forces about the particles and waves are sufficient to explain what happens and predict what will happen, and there is no need for any survival mechanism to explain or predict anything. A question may arise: Do not the aggregates of particles cause events distinctly effectively? For example, an iron bar cannot fly, but when it is used in an airplane it can fly; so like this maybe there are the trajectories of particles; but cannot their aggregates cause effects that their parts could not cause? If they can, then the aggregates of particles that appear like fish, and their behavior and motivations to survive may cause events that their parts could not. The iron bar and the iron atoms behave as their nature entails no matter where they are, whether they are in an airplane or in the body of a gazelle. An iron bar�s or an iron atom�s nature contains what it will do under any specific condition. Under physicalist evolution, if we know all about all particles, we can predict all including how the aggregates they will form will behave, even if these aggregates could be recognized as wholes under reductive physicalism. Hence, survival cannot add anything explanatory on top of the explanations based on parts.
If the physicalist evolution explains the changes in the molecules, atoms, and sub-atomic particles of a life form by reference to arbitrary aggregates at the life layer -since it does not recognize the distinct existence, reality, and effectiveness of the sovereign wholes at the life layer-, then the natural selection in the definition of physicalist evolution means something arbitrary and inconsistent, because what can be the natural selection in regards to those particles? If a molecule is divided and annihilated, we cannot say that it is dead, since it doesn't end its existence that would only be a non-distinct aggregate if reductive aspect of physicalist evolution is true. So, if a life form is dead, we cannot say that it has been selected against, since its effective constituents keep their existence and since the life form is an arbitrarily delimited thing. So, survival of the fittest and natural selection must assume that the evolution explains holistic things, since what would �not surviving� mean for the atoms and sub-atomic particles or for something which is not a distinct whole.
In physicalist evolution, questions like �what survives� or �what is the fittest� are only arbitrarily answered. If life forms, metabolism are reducible to particles, then they are just like the appearance of a horse in the clouds. That horse is not a horse even if by coincidence all atoms in the cloud behave as if the horse runs. If we reduce the life forms to particles, then the particles are moving in any case like the particles of the cloud no matter whether it is a horse with metabolism, reproduction or not. What we see as a horse is just like an illusion, where what we see as a horse which may produce some effects as a horse cannot produce any effects as a horse, nor allow us to make any predictions based on the horse. We cannot discover any objectively testable boundary for that horse, nor any connection which connects/unifies the horse distinctly. If for example the quarks are the distinctly and ultimately effective, then the relations of quarks would override any prediction we would make on the horse. Likewise, if we would predict anything based on the parts of the quarks, then again, the behavior of the parts of the quarks would override the behaviors of those quarks as well. If the behavior of the horse shape is defined as being equal to the quarks� behaviors, then we would not have a consistent behavior of the horse: its head might explode or scatter away at any point while each one of its constituent quarks would be going on to behave consistently in accordance with its properties, supposing that the quark is the distinctly effective thing. And in fact physicalist evolution would recognize and would not be surprized with the explosion since the real thing is at the reduction basis.
In a tornado we do not say this tornado behaved this way so it will survive, because the survival of the tornado does not depend on its distinctly effective behavior since it does not have its distinct behavior under reductionism.
If I say that �a circle consisting of clips goes to the right�, while some of the clips in it go to the left, my statement is wrong if I mean by that circle an aggregate, since all the clips constituting that aggregate do not behave accordingly and since a statement based entirely on the state of each clip will be the correct one. If the clips are about to break, a prediction based on the circle will be clearly irrelevant and false; under reductive aspect of physicalist evolution, the real thing is the effective thing. The circle is inconsequential.
For any prediction, and strong causal chain, all assumptions must be about the clips not the circle. If it is assumed that both the circle and the clips are of the same nature, we might predict based on both; but since according to physicalist evolution the circle is considered to be secondary and reducible to the clips, we cannot make that assumption. If physicalist evolution is true, then the circle does not exist distinctly and on its own. If the circle survives it is only because the clips survive and because they are in specific positions and because they are definable by space. Survival would be the survival of the clips not of the circle, and since the clips keep behaving on their own trajectories, arbitrarily combining and delimiting the trajectories of the clips for a reliable causal chain and good prediction would be wrong in principle. In physicalist evolution, the circle depends on the clips. The clips do not depend on the circle. If physicalist evolutionist says that when we talk about physicalist evolution we talk essentially about the clips, then the clips would not be evolving since they do not change and each of them just moves in space according to the laws of physics rather than undergoing inherent structural changes.
Let us consider another example: (1) I choose the same good whose price is 10USD instead of the same good from another seller whose price is 13USD, while (2) the trajectories of my atoms entailed my buying from the second seller, by say just hitting one atom another one from a certain angle. If (1) overlaps with better survival, this means that the movements of some of my atoms have nothing to do with it; they may diverge from a survival goal or pattern like in the circle clips case. And if physicalist evolution is true then the trajectories of my atoms are the only influencers of the future states of the atoms of the universe. How can I even unify in a definiton of reasonability the ununified behavior of atoms? My apparent choice of the cheaper good has no influence on those states, hence the survival of the fittest and natural selection allegedly some of the key causes of physicalist evolution have no real effect except an illusory one. 
Is the physicalist evolution an epiphenomenal thing but which can give us prediction? Is the physicalist evolution an epiphenomenal thing AND it cannot give us predictions -like in the billiard ball example-? Are the spatial positions of particles which look like evolving animals/ life forms and do they enable us make predictions? If the layer of life forms is just epiphenomenal, if it does not have any distinct causal effects on what we observe, then should the physicalist evolution be considered as just a spatial change of particles which gives us the impression of life forms being real though not effective? 
1.4.2.2.8.5.1.6 No Fundamental Layer of Reduction
While physicalist evolution abolishes the relata, relations, and properties of life, it cannot substitute them with a fundamental layer of reduction. Relocating the explanation to the things in the reduction basis layer is useless. Because as the things at the reduction basis cannot have zero simplicity, they show that reduction is not a useful explanation in principle. If these things require an explanation other than reduction, and a holistic explanation, then why would it be useful to use a reductive explanation for the life forms? Especially if we consider that life forms have irreducible properties like consciousness, free will power, reasoning power, knowledge.
So, let us examine the key reasons for the falsity of a bottom layer to which things at the higher layers are allegedly reducible.
1.4.2.2.8.5.1.6.1 Infinite Regress Problem Related to the Things at the Alleged Reduction Basis Layer 
Can all things be fully reducible to their constituents, in an infinite regress? If they all are fully reducible then it will be like infinite regress in copies of book in infinite regress, since because of infinite regress, there will be no layer that has things sufficient in and of themselves for the upper layers. Because, according to the principle of reduction, those things at the alleged reduction basis layer would also be reducible to other layers. Therefore, in principle there would be no layer that has an intrinsic power to sustain upper layers.
Can things at the reduction basis evolve? Physicalist evolution claims to explain the complex by the simple.
Things at the reduction basis do not evolve; if they do, then there will be infinite regress and there will be no allegedly "naturalistic" explanation. If the physicalist evolution is true, then there will be a reduction basis which is the only effective, and the physicalist evolution will happen because of the properties and behaviors of that reduction basis. If that reduction basis evolves, then it will need another basis. If (1) the ultimate basis evolves, then it needs another basis. If (2) it does not evolve, then there is no change, hence no evolution at the effective layer. So, either there is infinite regress, if (1) is true; or there is no evolution at the effective layer. Infinite regress is impossible for reasons explained in part� Hence, physicalist evolution is incoherent.
That which is allegedly explained by physicalist evolution is no more than aggregates, in other words random distributions of things at the reduction basis. There is nothing which is reducible to that basis. A life form is only an aggregate of the reduction basis if physicalist evolution is true.
Hence there is only reduction basis which is not explained. The complex wholes are just aggregates and random distributions of things at the reduction basis. These random distributions may appear occasionally as wholes, but these appearances are not distinctly effective, and add nothing to any predictions done on complete knowledge about the reduction basis if such knowledge might be possible.
If only parts' behavior is effective, then physicalist evolution rejects the wholes, for example a female as a distinct whole at the life layer. There is no reason to say that parts behave as a whole, under that physicalist evolution, because those parts would also have parts if reduction were true as a principle. If we are reducible to other things then why those other things would not be reducible to other things?
Something evolves either actively by doing certain things itself, like trying to survive, or passively without doing any effective acts itself. If it evolves without doing anything distinctly effectively, and if nothing behaves distinctly effectively, then there will be infinite regress. If there is something which behaves distinctly effectively, then only the changes in that thing causes the survival and only that thing may be surviving, since epiphenomenal things will not be influential on a survival or natural selection and will not be surviving since they are just a collection of the distinctly effective things and they do not have their distinct existence as distinctly effective things distinguishable objectively from other things. 
If something �evolves� only as a result of the act of another thing, then it is not evolution but it is just an arbitrary segment of the �act� of that other distinctly effective thing: it may be making the epiphenomenal thing look as evolving, it may change it, it may reverse it any moment depending on its own properties that makes that allegedly evolving thing (epiphenomenal collection of the distinctly effective thing) allegedly evolve. 
We do not say that for example an aggregate of a flower formed by a group of students evolved, because any moment the students stop it the evolution ends hence that aggregate of a flower has nothing distinctly effective of itself. That alleged evolution continues as long as the constituents behave the way they did. All we see are the students in that group and their acts. That thing that looks like evolving is nothing more than that group of students and their positions. And those students have not changed at all. Their potential has not changed. They were the same at the beginning and at the end. That which allegedly evolves in this example is no more than an approximation. If they form a flower or a circle it is not a perfect circle. If it is a circle it is only in the minds of the members of the group. Whatever allegedly evolves is best understood through the members. Not through that thing since it does not have anything of its own. One may ask �are not the students agents already that are subject to evolution? The answer is that according to physicalist evolution, they are no more than aggregates of particles. If something was made, it cannot have evolved as in physicalist evolution.
To be true evolution the life forms in darwinist evolution must be sovereign wholes and they must apply irreducible powers such as free will power, knowledge, reason... Moreover they must have distinct identities so that we can identify that which evolves as a distinct thing rather than a part of an arbitrary aggregate which is allegedly an aggregate just because of a subjective perspective of some observers. Otherwise, all elements of physicalist evolution used to explain its mechanisms collapse and it loses all of its effective power.
The evolution is the evolution of that which is effective. The student may change the progress in the opposite direction or stop it. He may negate the evolution. He may do something weird. So this is not a repetitive systematic behavior, and unless we have evidence that there is a necessity for a repetitive pattern at the reduction basis, we cannot posit that there will be any repeatability. If the behavior of atoms look like evolution at a layer, then there is nothing at the higher layer which makes it repeatable, it has been just random. If students change their mind the alleged physicalist evolution instantly ends. So, also to defend physicalist evolution, there must be a basis that will make the process continual, hence there must be the distinctly effective ASBEs and physicalist evolution must be built on them; else, anything at a higher layer will be unpredictable and will not allow a predictable and repeatable process like evolution. Without evidence supporting these claims (on top of other necessary evidence to justify other claims of physicalist evolution), the allegedly reducible upper layer has no added value regarding the progress of things. If the nature of atoms (or other parts) contrdict physicalist evolution, then the evolution instantly ends. So if evolution at a higher layer is reducible to atoms, then we cannot predict anything based on that higher layer, because anything at the higher layer would be suspended or stopped by the lower layer. Again, anything in the upper layer used to predict would be only a name of an arbitrary collection of the things at the lower layer. Whatever we say based on the higher layer is an approximation in nature compared to what we say based on atoms, assuming that atoms are fundamental. We cannot say "what if something unexpected at the layer of life happens, but we say what if something unexpected at the layer of atoms happens, because if life layer is reducible, then we can have the unexpected only within the distinctly effective layer. These apply to the atom as well, since in reality they are not at the self-sufficiently bottom layer. 
Let us remember the example of clips� square formed randomly because of clips, and through that random square hole clips pass forming a long and orderly bar-like aggregate of clips? And let us suppose that this way randomness causes cumulative orderly aggregates which also results in physicalist evolution. The problem with this scenario is that the clips do not behave on their own. They are reducible to their parts if physicalist evolution is true. So, the clips� square cannot be explained based on the positions of clips. Same is true for any reduction basis. But even if clips behaved on their own, it would be impossible for them to fill a structure gap for certain actual or thinkable higher level wholes and their behaviors. There may be some thinkable wholes which cannot be obtained by a certain type of clips. But can we get any distinctly effective whole at a higher layer by any clips if the higher layer thing is reducible to those clips? Any clips that would make the clips� square possible would not be simple and would require parts and would need to have transcendent abilities. Any clips which are fully simple would not be able to constitute clips square which would be instrumental in the rise of sophisticated wholes at higher levels.
On the other hand, a randomly formed circle of clips may behave in a repetitive way or do something for the first time like an evolutionary step. This may be caused by the environment. But it cannot arise of itself because ASBEs do what they do according to their behaviors. If the environment makes the ASBE split, there will be infinite regress since there will be no ultimate reduction basis. 
1.4.2.2.8.5.1.6.2 The Properties of ASBEs Would Not be Different From the Properties of the Wholes Constituted by the ASBEs.
According to physicalist evolution, life forms or species are aggregates, and whether an aggregate will survive does not depend on the aggregate, but on the ASBEs. Because how an aggregate will react to an effect depends entirely upon the properties of the ASBEs. Because any property of an aggregate is epiphenomenal and depends upon the properties of the ASBEs. Hence claiming that the properties of the aggregate changes or evolves is false. 
How an aggregate will react to change depends entirely upon the properties of ASBEs. If the properties of ASBEs, including their spatial positions, do not change, the properties of the aggregates will not change. If an aggregate binds to another one, this is because its ASBEs allegedly have the necessary properties or are in the appropriate spatiotemporal positions.
If one says that the spatial positions of ASBEs evolve and that these positions are beyond the ASBEs, this would be false, because change in spatial positions is called movement and not evolution.
If the redistribution in space would be considered as evolution, then the growth of the flower or the movement at the layer of atoms or electrons would also be evolution. In this case there would be infinite regress where there is no basic simplest layer that through evolution produces the new shapes, or there is a fundamental unchanging thing that does not evolve. In the latter case, movement of shapes is no evolution. And there is a bottom element which does not change. Hence physicalist evolution becomes invalidated. Likewise, replication would be no more than a kind of movement according to some spatial distribution.
Therefore, if the wholes are reducible to things at the reduction basis layer, then those wholes cannot have properties that their constituents do not have. So, if the ASBEs do not have a free will power such that to give it in a unity to the wholes that they constitute, then we cannot have free will power. However, we have free will power, therefore, we cannot be reducible to the ASBE.
What does it mean that the TV set is not distinctly effective, but that its components are distinctly effective? Is the TV set different in nature from its components? It is not. If the screen of the TV set is distinctly effective as opposed to the TV set, then we may argue that the screen is not an ultimately indivisible whole either. The same applies to the atom. Hence, why would a part like the atom be distinctly effective and a life form would be reducible to them? Does not the atom consist of other things?
On the other hand, the constituents including the ASBEs must have some organization and complexity as the wholes or aggregates that they constitute. In order to produce the effects the effects that we observe in our layers, the ASBEs cannot be so simple as to go through each other without interaction and they must not be point-like. Because they must have certain definable relations and interaction patterns. If they are so simple, then they will not produce effects and systems from that simplicity and their effects cannot be combined to reach high complexity. Though they can display coincidentally some orderly distributions at certain instances -if we overlook the requirements for a definable movement within space-, these instances would be meaningful only under unity and unitary order. So, to cause certain distributions and aggregates,  they must have certain properties as opposed to other properties, and those properties would entail the existence of further properties. Hence, in any case things at the alleged reduction basis would have a high level of complexity. ASBEs will have certain contingent properties like having a shape like pyramide or cylinder or like the properties of the fields, and they will have some extensions, hence, they will not be maximally simple. Moreover, these properties would have to be fully random and in harmony with the properties of other ASBEs. 
1.4.2.2.8.5.1.6.3 Change in Spatial Positions is not Evolution 
As explained above, reducing the life forms or species to the behavior of the particles or ASBEs in accordance with physicalist evolution annihilates the distinct wholes or aggregates and their irreducible properties like consciousness, purposefulness, and free will. This also annuls the key things used by physicalist evolution like natural selection and survival of the fittest. Then can we say that the physicalist evolution explains only the spatial distribution of the parts of the aggregates called life forms or species? Hence, can we say that physicalist evolution is essentially certain patterns of changes in spatial distribution of aggregates called life forms or species? Can we say that physicalist evolution explains essentially the changes in spatial distribution?
Is physicalist evolution movement? If not, what is redutive evolution on top of movement? If it is just movement, then can movement be evolution? Physicalist evolution claims the rise of new things other than new spatial positions, since it uses the terms as natural selection, struggle to survive. Just change in spatial positions is movement. If physicalist evolution explains only movements, it is no more than inventing names certain movements. Unlike the example of the horse shape in the cloud which is ineffective, if physicalist evolution is true, then the spatial positions  of things at time t1 may tell us what will happen next, what will be the next set of spatial positions at time t2. But that same thing might be predicted from the spatial positions at time t-1, prior to spatial positions t1 if physicalist evolution is true. In fact the positions at t-1 are redundant for a prediction for the same reason, because it is ineffective since the same thing can be predicted by spatial positions at t-2. But the same applies to to the positions at t-2 as well for the same reason; hence we get an infinite regress: none is distinctly giving us prediction; none is sufficient in and of itself to enable us to predict what the future will be; all of them depend on the previous states. And in this respect, none of the spatial positions is able to constitute sufficient data for us to predict the future. In the same way, a life form or a species at a certain time slice does not give us any predictive data, because a state of the universe prior to that species� time slice already give us all information necessary for the prediction of the future, even though prior to the existence of that species there was no mechanism related to biology or evolution. And the information or the patterns related to that species is redundant and even before that species existed we can predict a future state of time after that species and after its effects. The information about the positions of the particles of the universe and the patterns of those particles would be sufficient for us to predict the state of the universe at a time after the existence and maybe extinction of that species. Hence, if evolution is change in spatial positions, then the processes of physicalist evolution are not distinctly effective and they do not give us any information useful for prediction. But under a God-fashioned evolution, if the life forms and species are not reducible to their particles and ASBEs, then for example, the choice of a human being based on his free will power is distinctly effective and therefore a complete knowledge about the states of all particles in the universe is not sufficient to predict all things that is depends on the choice of that human being.

A movement or spatial distribution cannot have evolved because it is not a distinct whole on top of ASBEs and it does not have a distinct duration. Darwin claims to explain the origin of species, which have boundaries; however, if reductionism is true, then species is meaningless, it is arbitrary. In physics objects and their movements are explained. But movement is explained with a lasting speed as a relationship defined in equations. The change of spatial positions of points or infinitesimal entities cannot be called evolution, because it is allegedly governed by laws of physics, and it continues homogeneously through trajectories according to certain equations; and if evolution explains them and the way the laws / forces of physics are influenced by physicalist evolution, then this would be outside of the scope of physicalist evolution, and then evolution would be a branch of physics which would be absurd. The thing that changes as an object of physicalist evolution is a being or life form that extends in time and which is outside the domain of physics. Without distinguishing boundaries of life forms within time and within space, we cannot have something which may be claimed to have evolved. But movement is uniform and continuous at lower layers according to certain equations if physicalist evolution is true, so it cannot be explained as an evolution. In certain contexts, the elements of physics may look like different beings like a horse shape in the clouds, but that horse shape has nothing effective of itself on top of its constituents. It is just our perception from a certain angle, which cannot have a distinctly effective existence on top of the behaviors of things at the alleged reduction bases. 
Movement is also the movement of infinitesimally small things, it is just a change in spatial position. We can never say that the whole moved but its part did not under reductionism. So the change in spatial position is not the definer of wholes but of parts if reductionism is true. Parts may change spatial position but the whole may not or the whole may change it but some parts may not or may change in different directions in certain situations.
If what evolves are atoms or ASBEs, they are already there even before the start of evolution and they are there while species look like evolving, and after they went extinct. Hence, they do not undergo evolution. If the really effective things at the reduction basis layer do not evolve, but their spatial positions change, can we say that there is physicalist evolution? If the flower that grows that the clips formed in our clips example is that which evolves and if evolution is the change in space, then the parts of the clips also change in space. Then we need to search for the starting point of evolution. But if evolution is reducible like that, then we will need to continue our search infinitely and infinitesimally. Then there is the starting point of evolution if it starts, be it within an RNA world hypothesis or a chemical evolution hypothesis, or in protocells, and if its true nature is the change in space. So, abiogenesis is a fundamental problem. To get rid of infinite regress, the physicalist evolutionist needs to have something different in kind in order to claim the truth of physicalist evolution. So they cannot get the complex from the simple. If they want to get rid of infinite regress and the complex from the simple they need to get a start of something different in kind. And they also need to get new individuals, new wholes. But if for example they get new wholes, like new consciousnesses, then new things are not and cannot be just changing spatial positions, because spatial positions and their changing patterns were already there. Hence change in spatial positions cannot be physicalist evolution. If it is a mere spatial change, then they will bump into infinite regress, because z will be explained by y which is its part, y by x, x by v which is its part... Or they will recognize that there is a fundamental ASBE which is the cause and the distinctly effective, while spatial change not being the physicalist evolution; because if spatial change is physicalist evolution, then only the ASBEs may be the effective things, not survival, nor the spatial change in ASBEs because then there will be a part of ASBE which changes. But then they will need to recognize the ASBE as not evolving. So, either spatial change is evolution, hence there is infinite regress, hence, no physicalist evolution; or spatial change is not evolution and therefore there is an ASBE which does not change, which is the only noteworthy and distinctly effective while other things are just the passive distributions of the ASBEs, hence there is no physicalist evolution. If things at the life layer are reducible to the spatiotemporal, then there is the problem of infinite regress. If they are irreducible and they have irreducible properties like consciousness, free will power, then there is no physicalist evolution. 
Something may change its position while being the same thing since space is not absolute and change in that position in and of itself does not change the abilities of that thing. One may argue that for example, iron cannot fly in and of itself, but if it is brought together with other material, we can get an airplane and it can fly. However, here iron does not do anything other than what it does as a single iron atom: it has its mass, inertia, interaction with other things. It does not change itself, it unfolds its already existing potentials just because the conditions for its specific potentials to those conditions are actualized, like being in a specific position within within an airplane. The same applies for its subatomic parts.
Change in spatial position relatively to something else is also meaningless unless the relations and implications are transcendently defined. Hence, even if physicalist evolution would be explaining spatial changes, it would contradict its reductive aspect because space is not reducible to parts, since each part, point, or region of space, in and of itself, does not have the capacity to constitute an aggregate and the space itself.
On the other hand, the things that change their positions in space do not evolve, since they behave as they always did. The change in their spatial positions does not change their nature or the nature of any aggregate they constitute. That which undergoes a change in its spatial position, and the change in its spatial position is within the scope of physics. Even if a movement is complex it is still movement even if it is defined as physicalist evolution or even if relates to a complex aggregate. 
If the movement is completely defined based on physics, then defining them as evolution is redundant and just a heuristic. It is also an overdetermination especially if the mechanics of evolution are considered as distinctly effective. Likewise, things bumping and binding onto each other is also a physical event and not an instance of physicalist evolution.
In this context, let us revisit the example of the rounder rock rolling more and getting rounder. The positions of ASBEs that form the rounder rock are accidental, and they go back to the big bang. Their nature is fixed and does not change. No matter whether there is such a rock or not, or its following structures, the rock�s parts are not defined by an explanation like rounder rock becomes rounder. The initial states of the rock�s parts were determined at the big bang. Roundness is nowhere. No matter whether the rock is round or not, the ASBEs hit and bind with each other as their nature entails, independent of roundness of the rock; in the roundness of the rock obviously the ASBEs will have positions next to each other and these positions will determine how they collide and bind with each other. But an explanation based on roundness is ineffective. Hence, there is no evolution as physicalist evolution claims. Likewise, if light sensitive cells are considered as what causes the organism run away from a predator, this explanation is useless since the ASBEs of the organism will hit one another according to their positions in accordance with the alleged fundamental forces of nature. And their nature does not change. Likewise, the light sensitiveness of the cells that allegedly give a survival advantage would have in fact no effect again on the new species if reductive aspect of physicalist evolution is true; because according to it, what is effective is how the ASBEs behave and their nature.
If the object of the study of the physicalist evolution is approximations at the life layer and not irreducible wholes, then we must be analyzing the parts that are distinctly effective. Then physicalist evolution would be studying just the changes in spatial positions. Then even randomly behaving billiard balls must be considered as evolving, since they undergo spatial changes. If the objects of the study of the physicalist evolution are not approximations and if they are wholes, then there is a transcendent unity on top of these wholes or aggregates that brought them into existence at least as parts of the same space. So whatever makes an ASBE distinctly exist, is also what makes a sovereign whole like a human being distinctly exist at a higher layer.
Why would not we say that things that existed before species or RNA world arose also evolved if evolution is change in spatial position and if it is not related to things like identity, consciousness, free will? Why would not we start evolution of species before those species existed? Did anything that was not happening about species effectively started to happen by these species, especially if evolution is nothing more than change in spatial positions? If there were already things like consciousness and if these things were irreducible to spatial change, then we would ask where these things came from. 
On the other hand, spatial change is not structurally caused by another spatial change. The shapes of the wheels, trunk, and other components do not cause the shape of the car; they are the shape of the car if physicalist evolution is true. Shape does not have a relationship beyond itself. So, if we consider the wheels and the engine as parts of the car, they actually are the car itself; they do not cause anything beyond their own existence or contribute to its functionality. They do not cause anything other than them to move or exist if physicalist evolution is true. But what if I push the car to make it move? In this situation, it's different because I am not part of the car. If my hands make me push the car, my hands are part of me. Therefore, if we break things down into their parts, according to the previous examples, the wheel is the car, and parts of the wheel make up the wheel. Similarly, my hand is part of me, and my fingers are part of my hand. Consequently, if physicalist evolution is the explanation for spatial change, it leads to an infinite regress and through infinite regress to the annihilation of all upper layers. And if it is nothing more than spatial change, then this reduction would apply to any bottom layer as well, hence, it will annihilate its own basis as well. Therefore, it is inconsistent and non-viable. 
1.4.2.2.8.5.1.6.4 Physicalist Evolution Would Necessitate That the Reduction Basis has Been Fashioned and Sustained
Saying that something is not fashioned is equal to saying that its reduction or supervenience basis is not fashioned, since according to reductive physicalism, at the higher layer there is no effective addition to the reduction basis. But in any case, if reductive physicalism is true, then the ultimate reduction basis is going to have the features of that which is reduced to it. 
If the allegedly self-sufficient spatiotemporal bottom elements (ASBEs) of the alleged reduction basis are like billiard balls, then we can say that they cannot produce the chemical reactions we observe. Hence, we can say that evolution will be false in our universe if the ASBEs are like billiard balls.
So, is it possible that there are ASBEs onto which the actual life forms we observe are reducible?
Definition of evolution must implicitly contain the statement "under a specific set of laws and under a specific set of initial conditions and type of matter". Because without such an implicit part, we would be assuming a framework where evolution is no more than trillions of billiard balls which look like animals moving, reproducing, dying� 
When such a statement is included in it then it assumes a necessary fashioning element at its alleged reduction basis.
1. Physicalist Evolution Requires a Well Organized and Fine-Tuned Infrastructure
If genes are too changeable, then there will be no stable species. If they are too fixed, then there will be no mutations. Hence the DNAs, related systems, and things upon which the physicalist evolution depends, must have just the right changeability. Genetic mechanisms that protect from unwanted changes must also be appropriately established.
So, as any layer has specific values and contingencies, the physicalist evolution in and of itself is not a replacement against the fashioning property of Allah.
Let us now see an example where we will zoom in and try to see the path between the complexity and simplicity. This example shows that the aspects of fashioning in life forms cannot be traced back to a background which does not need fashioning:
In this analysis, we will take first a complexity, and then we will try to pass to, find out an unbiased materialistic simple ground upon which that complexity may be built.
So, let us first consider some complexity:
Any degree of change/ mutation is not sufficient for the evolution. The degree of change must be above a certain threshold so that the change may give its possessor a survival advantage. If the degree of change for the functioning of physicalist evolution is above a certain threshold, then it will be unlikely that this change occurs. Therefore, rather than gradual change through allegedly random mutations, holistic and big changes may be influential in the changes in the species.
Hence, the main problem with physicalist evolution is not whether some probabilities actualize, but rather what is at the origin of that specific set of relations: So, if we trace back the change, can we go to randomness or necessity?
So, let us give a concrete example: An animal who has one more cell in a part of its body which will develop into a different organ randomly does not have more survival advantage than the one who does not have this extra cell. Whatever makes an improvement, has many components. If as claimed in physicalist evolution the �graduality� is key of evolution, then we have to analyze the degree of graduality: a cell has approximately 100 trillion atoms and 2 million molecules. An improvement in a function, like the wings which will give a flying ability, or bigger teeth which will give more competitive power will entail change in millions of internally and externally organized cells. So, in any case, even if we talk of small organisms, and their small parts, to give a survival advantage, there needs to be a big jump. Does one cell make a meaningful difference in terms of survival capacity? If no then beings must have differences of significant number of cells simultaneously so that natural selection may work. If the cells and their components depend on hereditary material, then corresponding hereditary changes must also accompany those changes.
So, can we trace back these jumps ultimately to the spatiotemporal events and entities? In other words, as it is impossible to trace back a laptop to merely spatiotemporal things, but to transcendent beings; is it impossible to explain those jumps with the spatiotemporal? Or do we necessarily need to infer some transcendence? To find out, let us consider an objection from the physicalist evolutionist to the above line of thought:
The physicalist evolutionist may say: The above consideration of millions of cells and trillions of atoms is flawed, because there are systems like bacterial flagellum which is already complex but which does not need millions of cells or so many atoms or so many molecules. Such small systems may well have been differentiated randomly so that some parts became legs, some wings in the course of tens of millions of years without any need for jumps. 
Setting aside some problems with this view, let us examine the above point: 
The above counter-argument assumes that there is a crucial difference in kind between the small and the big, between the advanced life forms, and the small life forms; between the matter and the life. Hence, the small does not have the properties of the big at the higher layer, therefore it does not need sustaining and guidance. It also assumes that we will get the �kind� that we observe at higher layers, from something at the lower layers which does not have that �kind�.
If Allah makes things like simple billiard balls move at the most fundamental level, and if billiard balls are not sufficient for the formation of complex life forms, then this means that at the most fundamental layer, there is not things like billiard balls but complex things which behave selectively and transcendently. Let us suppose that at the most fundamental layer, billiard ball 1 (B1) would behave differently toward billiard ball B2 compared to billiard ball B3. Like pulling B2 but pushing B3. And not only that, but it would do it if billiard ball B4 would go up, and do the opposite if B4 would go down. 
Let us call B5 �the whole of balls B2, B3, and B4 where B4 structurally would go up�; and let us call B6 �the whole of balls B2, B3, and B4 where B4 structurally would go down�. Saying that B1 would pull B2 and push B3 in case B4 would go up, is equal to saying that it would do it if B2, B3, and B4 constituted B5. And saying  that B1 would push B2 and pull B3, if B4 would go down, is equal to saying that it would do it if B2, B3, and B4 would be constituting B6. Hence, if we do not know the internal structures of B5 and B6, we would be observing that B1 has an effect E1 on B5 and effect E2 on B6. In essence, these effects would depend on how B4 �would� behave. Here, going to the smaller layer does not give us any simpler explanation. Furthermore, the simpler case explained by B1, B2, B3, and B4 is equal to the less simple case explained by B1 and B5 or by B1 and B6. This is no different than a transcendent and future state dependent behavior seen more clearly by studying the simpler. This indicate that at the very bottom there is a purposeful activity even if we consider simplest cases, because in the above example event v happens if event x will happen, and event y will happen if event z will happen: The structures of the balls are fashioned so that certain future events happen in accordance with certain specifications. 
Also, the pulling and pushing would be with some specific force and speed; these amplify the implications of the above. 
If we assume that these allegedly self-sufficient capacities exist at the simplest layer, then we can see any complex structures self-sufficiently possible. But if this happened at that layer, then why would not it happen distinctly at higher layers? If the lower layers are sustained by Allah since they cannot be traced back to anything else spatiotemporal, does not this mean equally that the higher layers are also simultaneously sustained and guided by Allah? Even if the higher layers had been supervenient upon the lower layers, this would be so, since in that case there would be no reason to distinguish the supervenience basis from that which supervenes on it.
Yet, there is no reason to claim that the higher layers are necessarily supervenient or fully reducible upon the lower layers, since we have distinct powers and identities at higher layers as clearly observed in our powers like free will power, fashioning power, knowledge, and consciousness.
The atheist may say 'it is ok that we do not know the cause of the most fundamental but we will learn'. Yet they presuppose that it will be ultimately something non-transcendent, though the transcendence of the ultimate cause is clear.

Ascribing more attributes to ASBEs increases the probability of more organized-looking spatial distributions of parts of aggregates up to a certain point since there is a structural gap that will be examined in the following parts, which cannot be filled by the shapes of ASBEs.
But the properties of ASBEs are not a matter or result of necessity. They are also a result of probability if physicalist evolution is true; plus we cannot grant properties to ASBEs for free. If they have those properties, then they are not ASBEs. If ASBEs have same and compatible properties with the properties of other ASBEs, this also is not for free. And they also entail unlikelihood and low probabilities being actualized, even if we somehow presuppose that there is a bottom layer where there are ASBEs which have extension but nevertheless which are fundamental. 
ASBEs also create contradictions like being aggregates without having parts, if they are fundamental. Plus there is the structural gap. Yet in any case aggregates at the higher layers are aggregates, and they are not distinctly effective, hence the ASBE would not be a solution to the problems of reduction of the physicalist evolution and the real explanatory power would belong to the ASBEs not to the aggregates.

And there are many other problems with ASBEs examined in the related parts of this book. If we say that a circle as an aggregate caused something, it would not be a true circle, and maybe not even a circle maybe it has disconnected parts at lower layers or disconnected ASBEs.
The structure of ASBEs 'may' increase, but also may decrease the probability of organized aggregates. Even if evolution had been shown to be true, it would not be any argument against Allah, unless it was shown that it is a physicalist evolution. The same problem happens for any component of a life form. Each part of a whole is also a whole, even a simplistic part of a whole consists only of two distinct points in space. So, there is such a fundamental irreducibility. 
If the whole is rejected, and if the claim of physicalist evolution that there is something that evolves is true, then the things at the layer of reduction basis, in other words the ASBEs must be evolving. But the ASBEs cannot evolve because if they evolve, then they are not ASBEs, since their physicalist evolution entails that there are more fundamental things and that the ASBEs are not the ASBEs.
If an ASBE is sophisticated, then there is no reason to say that they are and must be all sophisticated the same way and that they all have the same structure. If there are hundred Lego pieces and if each piece has 3 parts (protrusions) and if we make a house with those pieces, then have we explained the house with a simple thing if we explain it by analyzing one piece? No. Because other pieces are also parts, even though they are all the same each in and of itself. In fact in that case we have explained nothing, since the parts of each Lego piece is the distinctly effective and we have reduced all to parts of each Lego and we have explained nothing about the parts of a Lego.) If an ASBE is sophisticated, then it has parts. Then its parts are removable. Hence it is not the parts that explain. It is the  transcendent Sustainer.
ASBEs move at the ASBE level, and at our level we see human beings animals objects doing things as wholes. There might be some overlapping. Again, then there would be some things intrinsic to ASBEs that make one ASBE different than another ASBE; in this case, again the ASBE would not be the most fundamental as a reduction basis. Then we would have again an infinite regress of overall physicalist evolution: The need for some things at the reduction basis, but because of the complexity at the life layer, another need to have sophistication of ASBEs, and due to this necessary sophistication the need for a more fundamental layer than that of the above ASBEs.
If ASBE is sophisticated then there will be the above problems. If it is not sophisticated, then there will not be anything simple and spatiotemporal which can do distinctly effectively the requirements of physicalist evolution as a reduction basis.
If the ASBE is little sophisticated, then, setting aside the problem of the structural gap that will be explained in the following parts, there is a high luck component at the higher layer. If the bottom is simple like billiard balls then can we have the actual wold? No. Because in that situation we cannot have higher level things like atoms. Then the bottom must be also transcendentally designed and sophisticated. So the bottom or the simple cannot be used to explain the sophisticated. If the bottom is sophisticated then the higher level would be contained in it, but this is not possible because physicalist evolution allegedly explains the complex by the simple. If ASBEs move like with their wings, like life forms, then why atoms cannot do the same?
If the ASBE is highly sophisticated then there is high luck component at the ASBE layer.
Furthermore, To have the molecular relations how sophisticated the ASBEs must be? How many parts and sytems they need to have? Hence, reduction, explaining the sophisticated by the simple, and physicalist evolution collapses fully. All needs to be explained transcendentally.
If the space in the ASBE does not separate the constituents within the ASBE, then it does not separate the constituent of one ASBE from the constituent of another ASBE. Else, the space would be something at least equally fundamental as the ASBE, hence, the ASBE would not be ASBE. The molecules, the atoms, and the ASBEs, all have or would have design elements.
For the above reasons, ASBEs cannot be the reduction basis of evolution. These reasons are not exhaustive and further reasons have been given in the related parts of this book.
3. The Alleged Reduction Basis Does not Have any Superiority Upon That Which is Explained by it.
An ASBE would have parts, hence it is not fundamental and does not have any explanatory power which is superior to the thing for which it allegedly constitutes the supervenience basis.
ASBEs in any case would do things that their parts cannot do. In this  sense, ASBEs are like living things. If physicalist evolution is an explanation for complex things, then it would be an explanation for ASBEs as well. But then the ASBEs� parts would be unable to do things done by their parts, in other words, the problem about the ASBEs would apply to the parts of the ASBEs. Hence evolution cannot apply to ASBEs. So another actor must be active.
If we remember the example of the clips, the geometry of space time of the clips was holistic in any case like the geometry of consciousness. The laws of clips are not superior to the wholes they partially constituted. Even if they constituted mere aggregates, the clips are not superior to those aggregates; for instance the spatial relations encompass all of them.
Even moving in a linear way requires a whole above. Spatial position cannot be sufficient to explain a circular movement of an ASBE. So like clips need a top down causation, the behavior of an ASBE would also need a top-down causation, at least so that it may have a specific shape and parts. 
Consciousness shows that a being or a life event cannot be a mere explanation of the progress of spatial positions of ASBEs. Otherwise, the spatial positions would not be what is understood by spatial positions. Because otherwise, for example, being in a certain spatial position would correspond to pain and another one to joy; and this would entail identity and mental life being non-separable property of the spatiotemporal. This would be against a physicalist evolutionist approach, since life related properties which it tries to explain would be at the very foundation of the spatiotemporal already.
A simple ASBE cannot cause a new complexity in kind. It cannot cause a new complexity in degree either because a new complexity in degree necessitates many ASBEs sharing the same manifold according to a specific set of rules which  would be applicable to many ASBEs in the same time. This entails a new and distinct top down transcendent causation.

1.4.2.2.8.5.1.6.5 An Essentially Top-Down Understanding, That Also Recognizes the Bottom-up Influence is the Only Rational One.
If we have particles/ parts moving on their own at the smaller layer, then how can we build spirits at the higher layers (like life wholes); whence would it come?

As the gravity comes from top down, the life also comes from top-down under certain conditions. Once we have a correct understanding about the gravity and similar physical patterns, then it will be easy to get a correct understanding about the source of life.

Physicalist evolution must recognize irreducible wholes in any case. One crucial problem of reductiveness of the physicalist evolution is that if the reduction basis has parts and it is differentiated, then it is not the true reduction basis since its parts will be more fundamental; on the contrary, if it does not have parts and it is not differentiated, then it may not undergo change.
