1.4.2.2.8.5.1.7 Structural Gap Between ASBEs and Higher Level Beings
Pulling and pushing between aggregates entails a certain simplicity of the allegedly self-sufficient spatiotemporal bottom elements (ASBEs) that may be the things at the reduction basis of physicalist evolution. If there are wholes like flagella which rotate at 100.000 rotations/ minute, then  this requires a higher degree of complexity of ASBEs. An ASBE like a billiard ball cannot produce the events and entities instantiated within the flagella. Hence, in the case of ASBEs like billiard balls, there will be a limitation to what complexity we can get at a certain level reducible to those ASBEs. Simply put, the difference between the complexity that is actually observed in a universe and the highest complexity allowed by the structure of ASBEs is called the structural gap. This gap may be in degree like in the spatiotemporal complexity in the above example, or in kind like the free will power or reasoning power that is claimed to be reducible to the ASBEs that may only move in accordance with physics. The gap may also be in the form of a contradiction: for example, if the ASBEs have the property of pushing other ASBEs, but if at the higher layers there are behaviors of binding and or pulling between aggregates, then we can say that there is structural contradiction. Certain necessary properties of the ASBEs are examined in the parts of this book related to ASBEs.
If physicalist evolution is true, then it is impossible and against the laws of nature that the higher level diverges from the lower level. And this contradicts physicalist evolution and reductive physicalism. Hence it is impossible according to physicalism, and this invalidates physicalist evolution because such a divergence means that the distinctly effective mechanisms of physicalist evolution at the life layer such as survival, and mechanisms such as mutations at the life related layers are not distinctly effective. If the things at the reduction basis are distinctly effective, and if there is that divergence, then there will be contradiction. Because particles will entail something, and the whole will entail another thing. But the whole is irreducible, then we can define some acts of the whole and acts of parts differently and recognize an interaction.
According to physicalist evolution, when we define the act of a whole we define by parts. For example the bird flies: it moves its wings such that there is pressure under its wings which move the wings and in turn the body upwards. If it is reducible to parts, then the definitions will consist only of the behaviors of parts even though different names may be given for aggregates at the higher layers. Hence the whole's acts as movement, struggle, ... will be fully defined by the behaviors of parts and the physicalist evolutionist mechanisms, and behaviors of life forms will be distinctly ineffective and redundant.
To explain the structural gap, let us take the turtle on the fence example: masses do not go up against gravity, hence if we see a turtle on the fence, it cannot have gone up even if trillions of years passed. Because under normal conditions and according to the laws of nature of a certain level, it creates a contradiction if it is not put there by a human being. But physicalist evolution claims something like the turtle being on the fence without any being having put it there. So this contrast is important to show the contradiction in physicalist evolution, hence to show structural gap, structural contradiction/ incompatibility. Here we have an impossibility of the claim. Likewise if the beings and events like survival of the fittest, trying to survive, effort to survive, mutation, natural selection are real and distinctly effective, then this means that beings and events that contradict the very fundamental patterns -of ASBEs- happened, like the rise or hovering of the turtle. The physicalist evolutionist must either give up the effectiveness of his physicalist evolutionary mechanisms' reality and effectiveness, or recognize the contradiction they entail. If there is distinct higher level mechanisms, wholes at the higher levels, this means that they are not produced by/ reducible to the lower level entities and mechanisms, hence they must be sustained by a transcendent and irreducible Sustainer. If the square hole examined in parts 1.4.2.2.8.5.1.4.3 and 1.4.2.2.8.5.1.6.1 is distinctly effective, then it must be contradicting the ASBEs to which it is allegedly reducible. If it is not distinctly effective, then only ASBEs are distinctly effective, hence any explanatory power, any distinct ontological effective power ascribed to the square hole is non existent. If we recognize that the higher level138 and lower level are equally real by assuming that physicalist evolutionist mechanisms are true explanations, and by overlooking the above contradiction and if we recognize that they consistently overlap, then there must be a unitary basis for their overlapping that sustains equally wholes at different layers. Otherwise if they are equally real without the higher level being reducible to the lower level, then there would not be only an issue of small probability or unlikelihood, but a contradiction with multiple different levels being really distinctly effective. Because their being distinctly effective, no matter whether they overlap or not, means that there is a thing that behaves in a way x and in a way y simultaneously, instead of that thing being under the influence of different wholes at different layers, but that both ways are different -unless one is secondary and or supervenient to the other-. 
Let us explain this with a simplified example of different structures at different layers. If circles replicate at the layer x, while triangles that constitute the circles replicate at a layer y and squares that constitute the triangles replicate at a layer z, where y is one of the sub-layers of x, and z is one of the sub-layers of y. Here we have three possibilities P1, P2, and P3: P1. This is organized by something that transcends all three layers. P2. The overlapping happened coincidentally. P3. There is no reduction between any layers -though there may be some interactions- and distinctly effective things in each layer have caused the different replications; this may be supported by P1 as well. 
The first question here is whether the squares can constitute triangles that behave in accordance with the triangle behaviors. The second question is whether the squares can constitute circles that behave in accordance with the circle behaviors � note that the behaviors are not just the geometrical implications of each shape, for example circles may be harder and the triangles may be softer �? If the circles behave in a way that is unpredictable by and incompatible with the behavior of the behavior of the squares, then the difference between the �predicted behaviors/processes/states of the circles based upon the behaviors/processes/states of the squares� and �the actual behaviors/processes/states of the circles� is called the structural gap.
Physicalist evolution rejects P1 and P3.  Hence, there cannot be any divergence between the three layers, hence whatever happens at the layer x, is reducible to what happens at the layer y and z. Then the question is �if the layer z is simple, can it cause the rise of the processes at the layer x?�. 
If there is no structural gap, then whatever is explained by the processes at the layer of life, has no explanatory power since it must be equal to the fundamental layer. But it is clear that the relata and relations of the life layer are not the relata and relations of the fundamental layer. This shows that physicalist evolutionist explanation based on molecules or atoms would be false in essence, if reductive aspect of physicalist evolutionism is true. For example if we define a pattern under a specific condition that "when a tip of a triangle touches the middle of a second triangle the second triangle will dissolve", this may be just because of the orientation of the touched square; and under the condition that that the square is in a different orientation, the triangle may not need to be dissolving. Unless we grasp the ultimate reduction basis layer if it exists, we may not know whether we grasped such a condition. So, the defined pattern is false without that latter condition. This is a fundamental error. Unless we encompass such a condition at the alleged ultimate layer, there is no justification for a pattern as the above. This is like an engine of a car: we can say it will work, the engineer may have designed it that way, but a pipe of the engine may be broken and the engine may not run any more. So, saying something based on the engine will not be correct if its parts are the distinctly effective things. 
If the triangles move at speed s and if there is a whole which moves/ rotates (like in bacterial flagellum) at a corresponding relevant speed of 3s, then the triangles cannot be the reduction basis of that rotation. So, these ASBEs cannot produce that rotation. Is there such structural gap between ASBEs and life forms? Or is it possible that there is zero structurally reductional gap between ASBEs and life forms? Likewise if the ASBEs have no property of binding to other ASBEs, then there is again a structural gap between ASBEs and life forms. The same applies for free will power and consciousness. Can we detect such gap between life forms and ASBEs regarding testable uncontroversial properties? If we do not know ASBEs and we define ASBEs tautologically as ultimate reduction bases, then we cannot find such a gap. In any case, we can say that ASBEs are smart, all-capable beings that simulate the life forms at their higher layers. But this, beyond a certain point, would undermine the raison d'etre of physicalist evolution because then at the very bottom there would be unevolvable beings.
If God-fashioned evolution is true, in other words, if at different layers there are distinctly effective beings or entities, then the distinctly effective things will have partial distinct effectiveness since the other things at different layers will also have influences on other layers. But if this is true, then there will be at least some degrees of freedom/ uncertainty, unpredictability due to the irreducibility to other layers and due to the impossibility of determinism. So, the physicalist evolutionist will need to reject his patterns and explanations at any level. Ultimately, to be consistent, God-fashioned evolution will reject determinism at all layers; since determinism is not valid for God-fashioned evolutionist, this is no problem, for example, we may want to do something but it may not happen. Yet, instead of deterministic relations, there are holistic relations and holistic centers of wholes that behave on a command-based system and a design-based system, where wholes at any layers have designs, oughts, and purposes, where atom is a command based system, cell is like that and other sovereign wholes are also like that. Ultimately, there is no empirical contradiction between wholes at different layers, for the God-fashioned evolutionist. This invalidates both deterministic points of view.
Once an ASBE, or a triangle or square in the above example is positioned in space, we can allegedly know how it will behave, but we do not know why it is positioned that way and we have no rules for that. And the behavior perceived at the higher layer depends on the positions of relata of the lower layer. If the God-fashioned evolution is true, then the degree of freedom will be the potential of the divergence of the higher layer from the lower layer. Also, it can be defined as the degree of divergence of the lower layer from what we predicted based on upper layer. If the higher degree relations do not have any distinct effect, then what appears like a pattern at the higher layer has appeared only randomly; the lower layers were only randomly distributed and lower layer relations happened to be as if they produced and complied with higher layers just randomly, though they might be equally otherwise. If the positions of the relata of the lower layers were different, then the law of the higher layer might look different. Laws at a certain layer, depend on positions of the relata at a lower layer and the relations at that lower layer. Even though the relata of the lower layer have been distributed randomly, their future state may be consistently predicted with their patterns of their layers; but to predict their future states in accordance with the higher layer laws would be possible only coincidentally except for homogeneous universes where there is no differently defined relata and relations between higher and lower layers. For example, in a cloud we may see that there is a shape that looks like a running horse. Lower layer relations are not higher layer relations. Even if there is a tiny divergence, the case is settled against physicalist evolution and its reductive aspect. If there is no divergence, again, if things are claimed to be reducible to lower layer things, then it is only a coincidence that the higher layer things overlap with lower layer things if the higher layer thing is not equal fully to the lower layer thing. If the triangles always form circles, then this would be related not to a process at the layer of the circles, but to the properties and processes at the layer of the triangles. It is always possible to devise a test like this example that will show the fallacy of physicalist evolution. It is logically problematic, so any empirical event cannot save it, but any experience to the contrary will debunk it. Relations between subatomic particles are not equal to relations and relata of life layer.

1.4.2.2.8.5.1.8 General Problems With Reductive Physicalism Adopted by Physicalist Evolution
One may say that all sciences including physics and chemistry are reducible to an ambiguous reduction basis and that that basis is not reachable by the human beings; hence, that grasping some reducible relations may still be useful. However, grasping certain relations are important no matter whether they are fully reducible or not. But claiming that they are fully reducible is a redundant and unsubstantiated claim; moreover, this claim is against the evidence we collect at numerous layers: for example, are the supply and demand relations in economics just illusions caused by particles bumping one onto other? 
As explained in part 1.1.2.2.1, reductive physicalism is irrational. Hence, the reasonable way to follow is that biological things including some processes related to evolution are not fully reducible to another layer, and that they are sustained by Allah not only indirectly by sustaining a reduction basis, but also in direct ways. Here, by �direct ways� I mean through unitary dimensions and mechanisms that relate to irreducible aspects of life forms, though ad hoc involvement of Allah is always possible.
An obscurity regarding the distinction between physicalist and God-fashioned evolution is to the advantage of materialism and disadvantage of theism. Because overlooking the reductive aspects of an allegedly physicalist evolution, prevents one from sufficiently considering the big problems of reductive physicalism. On the other hand, this obscurity prevents the theist from being aware of the tools provided with by the necessarily holistic aspects of an alleged evolution.
Problems with reductionism and reductive physicalism are applicable for physicalist evolution as well.
A reductionist understanding relocates the requirements of what it observes to an ultimately lower layer and assumes that things at the ultimately fundamental material layer satisfy and supply all the requirements of our observations at the higher layers. We observe gravity, and the reductionist approach assumes that the ASBE layer fulfills the requirements of gravity. We observe consciousness, and the reductionist approach assumes that the ASBE layer fulfills the requirements of consciousness. It ambiguously defines ASBEs based on our observations at higher layers. Then it assumes that ASBEs are definable based on higher layers and higher layers are definable based on lower layers; and that the complex is explicable based on the ASBE layer. However, unless we have evidence about the ASBE layer, these are just ambiguous assumptions without any evidence.
Physicalist evolution tries to explain the complex with the simple. Hence, it is in parallel with reductive physicalism: It presupposes that the new life forms, the new species arise because of physical events such as random mutations, which are within the scope of chemistry and physics.
If there was a distinctly effective thing at the higher layer whose behavior could not be predicted even by �complete knowledge of its parts for all conditions�, then this property of the higher layer would be coming from somewhere other than the parts/constituents, and this would entail a power other than the constituents of a thing, of a change, of an event. This would be against the approach of explaining things based on the matter and its behavior. So the reductionist approach and in parallel with this the physicalist evolution essentially reject the distinct reality and effectiveness of the things at the life layer. Hence, they do not explain the evolution of anything, but the unfolding of the trajectories of matter in accordance with the laws of physics. Through this approach, they recognize that the matter, the reduction basis and things in it, in other words the ASBEs are same and do not change. Hence, they study the movement of things, not their evolution, since an evolution at the bottom layer would be against explaining the complex through the simple, such that the matter is explained in and of itself, and magically starting from zero. They do not try to explain how a new whole will behave unpredictably and independently from its parts: this would allegedly be against reductive science, since it would not be explainable by the laws of physics that claims to explain things through spatiotemporal relations and results. 
To evolve, a thing must be a whole; otherwise the changes of evolution cannot be united; hence we cannot talk of a change of a whole. But evolution allegedly explains how a whole like a species, or a life form, or a gene� evolves. Hence, it also claims to explain  the properties other than movements such as consciousness. However, other sciences allegedly try to explain movements of things at different layers and the relations of movements at different layers, so they do not downplay anything or state that something is lesser than what it is or appears to be; they explain movement by movement, and how the movement is explained metaphysically is left within the scope of other disciplines. Here the claims of physicalist reductionism are excluded since it is a world view, not a science. But physicalist evolution makes the claim of explaining a kind with something of another kind, in other words, it tries to explain the properties of life forms through movement and comes with a religious baggage. So, it is built upon a contradiction. If it claims to explain only movements, then it is the area of physics; but certainly, there is more than movements within the layer of life.
Life forms are considered as aggregates by physicalist evolution, and an aggregate, cannot evolve because its contents are not united in a distinct whole. When there is no whole, and its boundaries, then there is no distinct thing that may be claimed to evolve. Its ambiguous parts can only be subject to changes in spatial positions.
So, the physicalist evolution tries to reduce a kind into another kind in a reductionist physicalist world view. Therefore, the contradictions and deficiencies of physicalism and reductionism will also invalidate physicalist evolution. Once reductive physicalism is debunked, a big part of evolution is also debunked to a great and fundamental degree. The contradictions and deficiencies of reductive physicalism is explained in detail in part 1.1.2.2.1; therefore these will not be repeated in this part.
However, in this context, determinism and indeterminism are key implications of reductive physicalism, and they are closely related to physicalist evolution. Because, both determinism and indeterminism, and physicalist evolution relate to the unfolding of the states of the universe and its contents with respect to time. Therefore, this part will examine in detail determinism and indeterminism and their implications related to physicalist evolution.
Physicalist evolution requires and presupposes either determinism or indeterminism. Reductive physicalism that underlies physicalist evolution and presented as an alternative to Allah, offers us two alternatives: Determinism and/or indeterminism. 
Either all is contained in and unfolds from the initial state and features of ASBEs, or some new and distinctly effective things arise in the course of time. If the first situation is true, then there is no evolution. If the second situation is true, then materialism, determinism, and indeterminism are false, and each life form is a distinct sovereign whole with some patterns and some freedom.
If physicalist evolution is true, then either determinism or indeterminism must be true. Because if life forms are reducible to the spatiotemporal, then there are no transcendent powers such as free will; and therefore, the only explanation left is the fundamental material entities and events which allegedly may be either deterministic or indeterministic.
If determinism is true hence there is no process which adds value on top of the initial state, then physicalist evolution is false, if physicalist evolution is considered to have its own dynamics such as natural selection, survival of the fittest at the layer of the living things. If determinism is rejected in favor of evolution, then the living things bring in new events and beings, hence again, physicalist evolution is false.
1.4.2.2.8.5.1.8.1 Determinism is False, and Even if Determinism Would be True, It Would Negate Physicalist Evolution.
In this part we will see the implications of determinism139 for physicalist evolution. In the next part we will see the implications of indeterminism140 for it. Their incompatibility with physicalist evolution, will show us that physicalist evolution is false both in its foundations, and in its empirical entailments.
At the lower layers it is important to know if determinism, or indeterminism applies. Maybe we cannot know all details at the lower layers but if we find out really or allegedly all-inclusive alternatives, then we can see the corresponding implications. So we need to find out the implications of �what if scenarios�. 
In the following we will see �what� if the alternatives are determinism and indeterminism? �What� if there are other alternatives are explained essentially in other parts, but the following also will consider them to some extent in the present context.
If determinism would be true, it would not just undermine physicalist evolution, but it would also undermine God-fashioned evolution, because then no wholes of evolution would be effective and everything would be precise consequences of the initial state and allegedly self-sufficient spatiotemporal bottom elements (ASBEs) of the limited universe.
The evolution criticized here is mainly the physicalist evolution which is put forth as an argument against fashioning of God. However, physicalist evolution cannot be put forth reasonably as an argument against fashioning because as a reductive position it entails determinism (or indeterminism, which will be addressed later). But if determinism is true then all processes and factors of evolution unfold from the initial state of the universe. And fashioning can be made at the beginning, and the reasons in this part show that there would also be fashioning at the beginning. 
If determinism and indeterminism are rejected then there will be the sustaining and guiding power of Allah. 
1. Under Determinism all That Will Happen is Contained Within the Initial State of the Limited Universe.
In a fully deterministic universe we cannot talk of physicalist evolution. The universe might start with plenty of life forms; an allegedly deterministic start of our universe contains already the information about how it will unfold into different life forms through a reasonable developmental process. Under determinism, every development depends on the initial state and the alleged laws of nature related to the ASBEs. Life forms would not have any effect on future life forms. Only physical patterns would be distinctly effective. And there is no necessity that the physical patterns would cause any new life forms.
So, all universes do not entail evolution. The universes which entail evolution, would entail reversal of evolution if time runs backwards and if determinism is true; hence evolution is not a necessary or law-like thing. Otherwise, under determinism, if the direction of time was reversed, the natural selection would apply again and some life forms would arise because of the �laws� of evolution; however, if we play backwards the video recording of our allegedly deterministic universe, human beings will become monkeys, and end up in the initial cell, and then the primordial soup; in other words, the backward running laws of physics will override any alleged dynamics of physicalist evolution. 
Therefore the events where pieces of puzzle get stuck one into another or get closer deterministically in any kind of universe which contains change, do not produce evolution unless sovereign wholes form. However, what I say here is an overall problem of reductive physicalism; what I say here about sovereign wholes in the biological world, applies also to the atoms: if our universe would be deterministic and if we would run time backwards, and if the atoms would disintegrate predictably, then this would mean that what is at the lower layers, namely the ASBEs, are effective and the atoms are not effective, and that they are epiphenomenal. 1. If Physicalist Evolution is True, Randomness is its Necessary Element, Natural Selection is not its Necessary Element.
Because the transcendence is rejected in physicalist evolution, its only remaining non-random element is the natural selection. But natural selection is not a necessary element of physicalist evolution. Hence, physicalist evolution may be happening in the absence of natural selection, but if it is happening, it is happening only based on the existence of random events such as random mutations. For reasons explained in the parts related to determinism and physicalist evolution, in a deterministic universe, physicalist evolution becomes impossible and empty; those parts also explained the impossibility of a deterministic universe. So, random mutations and randomness are necessary for the truth and for the working of physicalist evolution. If that randomness element is debunked, then physicalist evolution is debunked. But is that randomness possible?
True pervasive randomness debunks natural selection and all evolutionary processes. An occasional randomness is impossible, because recognizing that the fundamental events at the reduction basis happen sometimes randomly, sometimes deterministically is illogical. If those �sometimes� are happening randomly, then all the deterministic segments would also be random, since they can be disrupted any time; if those �sometimes� and their internal segments are happening deterministically, then they are not random. 
Let us also briefly explain why natural selection is not a necessary element of physicalist evolution: For this, let us ask how much is the effect/ contribution of the natural selection on the speed of evolution? For example, if all life units died just after a specific length of life -without producing any survival advantage for those who have advantageous traits- , or if the next weak generations� offspring also produced a variation such that some of its offspring has higher traits so as to offset any loss in gene pool, would not there again be any rise at least locally of any superior traits that had not existed earlier? If we protected all new organisms from predators, and assured that they all had the same life times, would not there arise organisms with higher traits? If physicalist evolution is true, then due to random mutations alone and their random alignment through some members of generations, those higher traits would arise at least in some circumstances. So, the natural selection only facilitates the physicalist evolutionary developments, hence it allegedly accelerates them. So, we should be able to find the contribution of the natural selection on the speed of the physicalist evolutionary developments. If there are other factors which influence the speed of evolution their amount of effects also may be calculated. But in any case it will be said that the influence of natural selection has been for example 8 percent or 20 percent... Or in total the influence of factors other than random mutations has been let us say 50 percent. This means that instead of the same life forms arising in 200million years this would happen in 400 million years if there was no positive contribution of natural selection: 
So, the claim of physicalist evolution is that the randomness alone may produce sophisticated life forms and their systems, the natural selection just blurs the picture and does not add anything else. Natural selection is not a necessary condition of evolution. Even if there is no natural selection, there may be some evolution. 
Therefore, randomness and random mutations deserve special attention.

If determinism undermines physicalist evolution, and if physicalist evolution rejects transcendent properties through which the effective wholes of life forms may be effective, then physicalist evolution needs a randomness like this. 
Gregory (2009) explains the �random� in �random mutation� as follows: �In particular, mutations are known to be random (or less confusingly, �undirected�) with respect to any effects that they may have. Any given mutation is merely a chance error in the genetic system, and as such, its likelihood of occurrence is not influenced by whether it will turn out to be detrimental, beneficial, or (most commonly) neutral.�144
In the context of "random mutation" in evolutionary biology, the term "random" refers to the idea that mutations occur without any specific direction or purpose. It means that mutations arise spontaneously and are not guided by any predetermined goal or intention. It means essentially �without cause� or �without the involvement or control of any agent� or �unpredictable (by �anybody�)�.
Note that if evolution and its key component random mutation are understood in parallel with the above definitions of randomness, then physicalist evolution becomes a religion rather than a science, and its key component has a key religious-related implication. Because it states clearly that the mutations are random, hence, purposeless, hence, it claims that there is no involvement of God in the creation of any living thing and their forms; and it loses its impartiality with respect to God. Obviously, this is a religious and atheistic component; and it is not a scientific claim since according to key principles of science it adopts, there is no valid scientific evidence for the claim of the non-existence of purpose and transcendence related to the creation of living beings. Carlin, J. L. (2011) says: �Evolution is simply not possible without random genetic change for its raw material.�145 A fundamental randomness obviously would not recognize the involvement, control, fashioning of Allah. Hence, it is essentially reductive.
However, Stoltzfus (2021) says: �In fact, claims of evolutionary randomness typically fail for obvious reasons. Mutation in a particular locale is not walled off from the rest of biology, but is sensitive to conditions such as gene expression and the concentration of DNA precursors, and this leads to nonindependence with conditions and even with fitness.�146 One may claim that the randomness is not entirely rejected in this quote but only relocated to those conditions. Such an inclusive randomness is addressed in this work.
Obviously, if something is random, it is not explainable by a known cause which gives that thing a direction. If the car moves because I push the gas pedal, then we do not say that the car moved randomly. If an atom unpredictably decayed without being acted upon, then we say that there was some randomness. However, no act and no direction of an act can be caused by nothing, since that nothing would not be nothing if it had caused that direction or that behavior. When the atom decayed, there was already the atom as a cause. Since nothing cannot have an effect, and since the decay occurred in a certain time and location, instead of another time and location, and since the elements of decay have a unitary extension, we cannot say that nothing caused it. Therefore, a truly random event is impossible. 
For example, there is nothing which might cause the initial state of the limited universe to be the way it is. But since that which caused it could not be nothing, for the above reason, the initial stage of the universe cannot be random. The same applies if it is assumed to be past eternal and caused by infinite regress, since the contents of the infinite regress would not contain any self-sufficiently effective cause for the specific state of the limited universe. 
Randomness in physicalist evolution and mutations are invalidated if determinism is true, if the universe is not contingent, and if the initial state of the universe was necessarily the way it was, because in that case the mutations would not be random since they would be entailed fully by the structure of atoms and other particles. But if indeterminism and the Copenhagen interpretation or Heisenberg uncertainty are true, then any accumulation of order will easily collapse back to disorder, physicalist evolutionary processes and patterns, including our reasoning will fail and lose their bases due to the reductive aspect of the physicalist evolution.
